    II = math.min( 2.5, II + .12 )
end
if WI( II ) > OI then
    dO = false
else
    II = aI( OI, DO.flightTime, II )
end
local function BI( SV ) local mR = ( SV - VV.center ):Dot( VV.lateral ) return mR >= VV.rawLeft + RI and mR <= VV.rawRight - RI and SV.Y >= VV.rawBottom + RI and SV.Y <= VV.rawTop - RI
end

    local mV = II * XI / mI local SV = VI( mV ) KW[ # KW + 1 ] = SV if mV >= Xa and not BI( SV ) then
        dO = false
    end
    if op.boundaryWorld and SO.GetGroundRestingY then
        WO() local XR = SO.GetGroundRestingY( SV, nR, op.boundaryWorld ) if XR and SV.Y < XR - .05 then
            ZO = false
        end
    end
    tS = math.min( tS, bS( SV, YS, mV ) )
end
if not BI( VI( Xa ) ) or not BI( VI( II ) ) then
    dO = false
end

    dO = false
end

end
) if not FO then
    DO.success, DO.scoresGoal = false, false DO.groundSafe, DO.sweptSafe = false, false DO.budgetExhausted = pI == VO if pI ~= VO then
        bO = tostring( pI )
    end
end
DO.clearance = tS DO.score = ( DO.success and 100 or 0 ) + tS * 2 + xS.bias - DO.error * 10 - DO.flightTime * 2 DO.trajectory = KW if not oS or DO.score > oS.score then
    oS = DO
end
local AS = xS.high if AS == nil then
    AS = xS.target.Y >= VV.center.Y
end
if AS and( not yO or DO.score > yO.score ) then
    yO = DO
end
if not AS and( not fO or DO.score > fO.score ) then
    fO = DO
end
end
if not YO() then
    break
end
end
if not oS then
    return nil, bO or "No forward free-flight crossing within 2.5 seconds"
end
if not oS.scoresGoal and not op.fixedDirection and not op.constraintRetry then
    local YI = {} if op.mode ~= "Low" and yO then
        YI[ # YI + 1 ] = yO
    end
    if op.mode ~= "Top" and fO then
        YI[ # YI + 1 ] = fO
    end
    for Fp, hI in ipairs( YI ) do
        local tI, UI, lI = hI.target, hI.goal, hI.candidate local lW = tI.Y >= lI.mouth.center.Y local sI = lW and { - .25, - .5 } or { .25, .5, .85, 1.2 } for Fp, kO in ipairs( sI ) do
            local wI = eS - os.clock() if wI <= .001 or not YO() then
                break
            end
            if not op.preferredTarget or math.abs( kO ) <= .5 then
                local HI = table.clone( op ) HI.preferredGoal, HI.preferredTarget = UI, tI + Ma * kO HI.initialDirection, HI.constraintRetry = hI.direction, true HI.timeBudgetSeconds, HI.deadline, HI._solverWork = wI, eS, FS HI.maximumEvaluations = math.min( 16, RO - FS.evaluations ) local DO = ca.Solve( HI ) if DO then
                    DO.verticalAdjustment = kO if op.preferredTarget then
                        DO.target = tI local CI = DO.crossing - tI local Fa = lI.mouth.lateral DO.error = math.sqrt( CI:Dot( Fa ) ^ 2 + CI.Y ^ 2 ) DO.success = DO.error <= .8 and DO.scoresGoal
                    end
                    DO.score = ( DO.success and 100 or 0 ) + DO.clearance * 2 + lI.bias - DO.error * 10 - DO.flightTime * 2 - math.abs( kO ) if DO.score > oS.score then
                        oS = DO
                    end
                    if DO.success then
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if oS.success then
            break
        end
    end
end
oS.evaluations = qO() oS.elapsedSeconds = os.clock() - LS oS.budgetExhausted = oS.budgetExhausted or os.clock() >= eS if not op.fixedDirection then
    local Ja = Ta[ oS.goal ] local AI = Ja and math.abs( Ja.curve - DS ) < .05 and( Ja.target - oS.target ).Magnitude < .1 and oS.error >= Ja.error - .02 and Ja.stalls + 1 or 0 Ta[ oS.goal ] = { character = op.character, target = oS.target, start = La, curve = DS, charge = ZS, direction = oS.direction, at = LS, error = oS.error, stalls = AI }
end
oS.candidate, oS.ex, oS.ey, oS.yaw, oS.pitch = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil return oS
end
function ca.Evaluate( uS, rI, qS, ua ) if not rI or rI.Magnitude < 1e-6 or not qS or not ua then
    return nil, "Fixed evaluation requires direction, target and goal"
end
local JR = table.clone( uS ) JR.fixedDirection, JR.preferredTarget, JR.preferredGoal = rI, qS, ua return ca.Solve( JR )
end
return ca
end

    Hp.kick = H
    if sU then
        sU( H )
    end
else
    Hp.kick = nil
end
return Hp.kick
end
local
function DU()
if not Hp.alive or not Hp.ready or not Hp.enabled then
    return nil
end
local JI = LU()
if not JI then
    return nil
end
local u, ZU = pcall( function() return JI.IsCharging() and not( JI.IsHeadbuttCharge and JI.IsHeadbuttCharge() ) and not( Hp.modules.ClientShoot.IsForcedClearCharging and Hp.modules.ClientShoot.IsForcedClearCharging() )
end
)
if u and ZU then
    local Sp = JI.GetLocalCharacter()
    local nB = Sp and Sp:FindFirstChildOfClass( "Humanoid" )
    if Sp == TI.Character and nB and nB.Health > 0 then
        return JI
    end
end
return nil
end
local
function dU()
local Sp = TI.Character
local nB = Sp and Sp:FindFirstChildOfClass( "Humanoid" )
local SB = Sp and Sp:FindFirstChild( "HumanoidRootPart" )
if not SB or not nB or nB.Health <= 0 then
    return false
end
if nB.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
    return true
end
local u, e = pcall( function() return nB:GetState()
end
)
return u and( e == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or e == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall )
end
CU = function()
return Hp.enabled and( not Hp.airborneOnly or dU() )
end
local
function FU()
return CU() and Hp.targetGoal and Hp.targetGoal.Parent and Hp.targetPoint and not Hp.acquisitionSkipped
end
local
function pl( ta, fW ) fW = fW or {} fW.kind, fW.at = ta, os.clock() table.insert( Hp.trace, fW )
if # Hp.trace > 50 then
    table.remove( Hp.trace, 1 )
end
end
local
function Rl( JI, ES )
local Sp = JI.GetLocalCharacter()
local nB = Sp and Sp:FindFirstChildOfClass( "Humanoid" )
local sR = JI.IsLocalOwner()
local dI = JI.IsBicycleKickCharge and JI.IsBicycleKickCharge() or false
local Vl = Hp.modules.ClientShoot.IsVolleyCharging and Hp.modules.ClientShoot.IsVolleyCharging() or false
local Wl = ES and ES.IsAirborne == true or Hp.nativeAirborne or dI or Vl
if nB then
    if nB.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
        Wl = true
    end
    local u, H = pcall( function() return nB:GetState()
end
)
if u and( H == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or H == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall ) then
    Wl = true
end
end
local al = sR and not Wl and not dI and not Vl
return { autoPower = al, curve = sR or dI or Vl, airborne = Wl, key = tostring( sR ) .. ":" .. tostring( dI ) .. ":" .. tostring( Vl ) .. ":" .. tostring( Wl ) }
end
local
function Sl( JI, ES )
local UK = JI.GetChargeStartedAt and JI.GetChargeStartedAt()
if UK ~= Hp.session then
    Hp.nativeAirborne = nil
end
if ES then
    Hp.nativeAirborne = ES.IsAirborne == true
end
local Ol = Rl( JI, ES )
if UK ~= Hp.session then
    Hp.session = UK Hp.nativeRelease, Hp.curveTestedSession = nil, nil Hp.actualCurve = 0 MU() Hp.acquisitionAttempted, Hp.acquisitionSkipped = false, false Hp.scopeAirborne = nil
    local Il = wU and wU() or ES Hp.selectionRay = Il and table.clone( Il ) or nil pl( "charge_started", { profile = Ol.key } )
elseif Hp.profileKey and Hp.profileKey ~= Ol.key then
    local Ja = Hp.lastGoodPlan
    local Bl = Hp.desiredCurve
    local zt = JI.IsAimLocked and JI.IsAimLocked()
    local qS = Ol.airborne and Hp.targetAirPoint or Hp.targetGroundPoint
    local ml = not zt and qS and Hp.targetPoint and( qS - Hp.targetPoint ).Magnitude > 1e-6
    if ml then
        Hp.targetPoint = qS
        for Fp, ZK in ipairs( Hp.cornerPoints or {} ) do
            ZK.target = Ol.airborne and ZK.airborneTarget or ZK.groundTarget or ZK.target
        end
        Hp.steeringPlan, Ja = nil, nil
    end
    MU( true ) Hp.lastGoodPlan, Hp.desiredCurve = Ja, Bl
    if zt and Ja then
        local Xl = JI.GetChargeAimRay() Hp.lastGoodPlan = Ja Hp.lockedDirection = Xl and Xl.Direction or Ja.direction Hp.desiredCurve = JI.GetLockedCurve() or Hp.actualCurve
    end
    if ml then
        HU( Hp.cornerPoints, Hp.targetId, false, Hp.targetPoint, false )
    end
    Hp.nativeRelease = nil pl( "profile_changed", { profile = Ol.key } )
end
Hp.profileKey, Hp.profile = Ol.key, Ol
if AU then
    AU( JI )
end
return Ol
end
HU = function( Kl, bl, ql, Yl, eI )
local JX = {} tU = nil
for Fp, ZK in ipairs( Kl or {} ) do
    local aR = ZK.id
    if aR and( aR == bl or( eI and Hp.showOtherPoints ) ) then
        JX[ aR ] = true
        local c = UU[ aR ]
        if not c then
            c = Instance.new( "Part" ) c.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball c.Anchored, c.CanCollide, c.CanTouch, c.CanQuery = true, false, false, false c.Material, c.Parent = Enum.Material.Neon, nU
            local hl = Instance.new( "Highlight" ) hl.Adornee, hl.Parent = c, c hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded UU[ aR ], lU[ aR ] = c, hl
        end
        local Ph = aR == bl c.Name = Ph and "GoalAimLocalPoint" or "GoalAimCorner_" .. aR
        local nK = Ph and Yl or ZK.target c.Position = ZK.normal and nK + ZK.normal * .5 or nK
        local Z = ( Ph and .65 or .4 ) * Hp.markerScale c.Size = Vector3.new( Z, Z, Z ) c.Transparency = Ph and .05 or .45 c.Color = Ph and( ql and Color3.fromRGB( 65, 255, 130 ) or eI and Color3.fromRGB( 80, 205, 255 ) or Color3.fromRGB( 255, 170, 65 ) ) or Color3.fromRGB( 205, 220, 235 ) lU[ aR ].Enabled = Ph
        if Ph then
            tU = c
        end
    end
end
for aR, c in pairs( UU ) do
    if not JX[ aR ] then
        c.Transparency = 1;
        lU[ aR ].Enabled = false
    end
end
end
local
function tl( DO ) HU( Hp.cornerPoints, Hp.targetId, DO.success, DO.target, false )
end
wU = function()
local Ul = Hp.modules.Reticle
if Ul and type( Ul.GetCameraAimRayWithoutHit ) == "function" then
    local u, ES = pcall( Ul.GetCameraAimRayWithoutHit )
    if u and type( ES ) == "table" and ES.Direction then
        return ES
    end
end
local ba = workspace.CurrentCamera
if ba then
    return { Origin = ba.CFrame.Position, Direction = ba.CFrame.LookVector }
end
end
AU = function()
if not Hp.airborneOnly then
    Hp.airborneWaiting = false;
    return CU()
end
local al = CU()
if not al then
    if Hp.targetGoal or Hp.steeringPlan or Hp.lastBend or Hp.lastGoodPlan or Hp.feintFound or Hp.feintSide then
        MU( false )
    end
    cU() Hp.scopeAirborne, Hp.airborneWaiting = false, Hp.enabled Hp.acquisitionAttempted, Hp.acquisitionSkipped = false, false
elseif Hp.scopeAirborne ~= true then
    local Il = wU() Hp.selectionRay = Il and table.clone( Il ) or nil Hp.scopeAirborne, Hp.airborneWaiting = true, false Hp.acquisitionAttempted, Hp.acquisitionSkipped = false, false
end
return al
end
local
function ll()
if not CU() then
    cU()
    return
end
if os.clock() < ( Hp.nextPreviewAt or 0 ) then
    return
end
Hp.nextPreviewAt = os.clock() + .08
local Sp = TI.Character
local SB = Sp and Sp:FindFirstChild( "HumanoidRootPart" )
local ES = wU()
if not SB or not ES then
    cU();
    return
end
local o = nI.GetGoals( Hp.modules, TI )
local uS = { startPosition = SB.Position, goals = o, aimRay = ES, mode = Hp.mode, capturePosition = SB.Position, maxTargetDistance = Hp.maxTargetDistance, captureAngleDegrees = Hp.captureAngleDegrees, previewGoal = Hp.previewGoal, airborne = ES.IsAirborne == true or dU(), Physics = Hp.modules.Physics, goalApertures = nI.BuildGoalApertures( o ) }
local rX = Ea.SelectTarget( uS )
local sl = rX and rX.goal or Ea.SelectPreviewGoal( uS )
if not sl then
    cU();
    return
end
uS.preferredGoal, uS.mode = sl, "Auto"
local Kl = Ea.GetTargetPoints( uS ) Hp.previewId, Hp.previewGoal = rX and rX.id, sl HU( Kl, Hp.previewId, false, rX and rX.target, true )
end
local wl, Hl = .035, .003
local Cl = { 0, - .45, .45 }
local
function Al( DS )
local JI = Hp.kick
if not JI then
    return false
end
if not JI.IsLocalOwner() then
    return true
end
local rl = JI.GetWindupSeconds or JI.GetHeldSeconds
local u, nl = pcall( rl )
if not u or type( nl ) ~= "number" then
    return false
end
local Rb = Hp.modules.KickCore.Constants or {}
local yl = JI.GetChargeSecondsFromPower( 1 ) - ( Rb.AimLockSeconds or .1 )
local fl = math.abs( DS - Hp.actualCurve ) / math.max( 1, Rb.MaximumCurveChangePerSecond or 18 )
return nl + fl + wl * 2 + .01 < yl
end
local
function Ql()
if not Hp.feintFound and not Hp.feintSide then
    return
end
local gl = Hp.feintFound Hp.feintFound, Hp.feintSide = nil, nil Hp.desiredCurve = Hp.actualCurve or 0
if gl then
    Hp.lastGoodPlan, Hp.releaseSeconds, Hp.powerSeconds = nil, nil, nil pl( "feint_suspended", { reason = "Native player curve restored" } )
end
end
local
function Pl()
if not FU() or not Hp.feint or not Hp.profile or not Hp.profile.curve or not Hp.modules.CurvedKicks.IsEnabled() then
    return nil
end
local Sp = TI.Character
local nB = Sp and Sp:FindFirstChildOfClass( "Humanoid" )
local SB = Sp and Sp:FindFirstChild( "HumanoidRootPart" )
if not SB or not nB or nB.Health <= 0 then
    return nil
end
return Hp.targetGoal
end
local
function Jl( JI )
if not Pl() then
    Ql();
    return
end
if JI.IsAimLocked and JI.IsAimLocked() then
    return
end
local HS
if FU() then
    local La = Hp.plan and Hp.plan.startPosition
    local SB = TI.Character and TI.Character:FindFirstChild( "HumanoidRootPart" ) La = La or( SB and SB.Position )
    if La then
        local xl = Hp.targetGoal.Position - La xl = Vector3.new( xl.X, 0, xl.Z )
        if xl.Magnitude > .01 then
            local kO = ( Hp.targetPoint - Hp.targetGoal.Position ):Dot( xl.Unit:Cross( Vector3.yAxis ) )
            if math.abs( kO ) > .1 then
                HS = - math.sign( kO )
            end
        end
    end
end
if not HS then
    return
end
local lq = HS * ( Hp.feintStyle == "Center" and .45 or 1 )
if Hp.feintStyle == "Reverse" then
    lq = - lq
end
if Hp.feintFound and math.abs( Hp.desiredCurve - lq ) < .001 then
    return
end
if not Al( lq ) then
    return
end
Hp.feintSide, Hp.desiredCurve, Hp.feintFound = HS, lq, true Hp.lastGoodPlan, Hp.releaseSeconds, Hp.powerSeconds = nil, nil, nil pl( "feint_started", { style = Hp.feintStyle, curve = lq, aimEnabled = CU() } )
end
local
function El()
return not Hp.feintFound or( Hp.lastGoodPlan and math.abs( ( Hp.lastGoodPlan.curveInput or 0 ) - Hp.actualCurve ) < .03 and math.abs( Hp.actualCurve - Hp.desiredCurve ) < .03 )
end
local
function cl( JI, ES, Ml, j, DS, eS )
local VV = Hp.modules
return { character = JI.GetLocalCharacter(), aimRay = ES, startPosition = Ml.startPosition, kickerVelocity = Ml.kickerVelocity, boundaryWorld = Ml.boundaryWorld, goals = Ml.goals, chargeSeconds = j, curveInput = DS, Shoot = VV.Shoot, Physics = VV.Physics, KickPowerups = VV.KickPowerups, mode = Hp.mode, airborne = Hp.profile and Hp.profile.airborne or false, defenders = Hp.planningDefenders or {}, goalApertures = Hp.planningApertures or {}, deadline = eS, timeBudgetSeconds = math.max( 0, eS - os.clock() ), maximumEvaluations = 12, preferredGoal = Hp.targetGoal, preferredTarget = Hp.targetPoint, initialDirection = Hp.steeringPlan and Hp.steeringPlan.direction }
end
local
function kl( ES, Ml, j, DS )
local ia = Hp.targetPoint - ( ES.Origin or Ml.startPosition )
if ia.Magnitude < .01 then
    ia = ES.Direction
end
return { goal = Hp.targetGoal, target = Hp.targetPoint, direction = ia.Unit, chargeSeconds = j, curveInput = DS, startPosition = Ml.startPosition, flightTime = 0, error = 999, success = false, scoresGoal = false, steeringValid = true, provisional = true, clearance = 0 }
end
local
function Tl( zl, eS )
local DO, DS, La = zl.plan, zl.curve, zl.start
if DS == 0 then
    Hp.arcBestCurve, Hp.arcBestScore = 0, DO.clearance * 2
    return true
end
if not zl.tuning then
    if os.clock() >= eS then
        return false
    end
    zl.tuning = Hp.modules.Physics.GetCharacterTuning( Hp.kick.GetLocalCharacter() )
end
if not zl.right then
    local xl = DO.goal.Position - La xl = Vector3.new( xl.X, 0, xl.Z ) zl.right = xl.Magnitude > .01 and xl.Unit:Cross( Vector3.yAxis ) or Vector3.xAxis
    local kO = ( DO.target - DO.goal.Position ):Dot( zl.right ) zl.wanted = math.abs( kO ) > 1 and math.sign( kO ) or 0
    local Gl = ( DO.crossing or DO.target ) - La zl.chord = Vector3.new( Gl.X, 0, Gl.Z ) zl.lengthSquared = zl.chord:Dot( zl.chord ) zl.index, zl.bow = 0, 0
end
while zl.index < 3 do
    if os.clock() >= eS then
        return false
    end
    local jl = ( zl.index + 1 ) * .25
    local nK = Hp.modules.Physics.GetAirFlight( La, DO.velocity, DO.spin, DO.flightTime * jl, zl.tuning )
    local il = nK - La il = Vector3.new( il.X, 0, il.Z )
    local vl = zl.lengthSquared > .001 and il:Dot( zl.chord ) / zl.lengthSquared or 0 zl.bow = zl.bow + ( il - zl.chord * vl ):Dot( zl.right ) zl.index = zl.index + 1
end
local Nl = zl.wanted == 0 or zl.bow * zl.wanted > .1
local ol = DO.clearance * 2 + 2
if Nl and ol > ( Hp.arcBestScore or - math.huge ) then
    Hp.arcBestCurve, Hp.arcBestScore = DS, ol
end
return true
end
local
function ul()
if Hp.arcIndex and Hp.arcIndex >= # Cl then
    Hp.desiredCurve = Hp.arcBestCurve or 0 Hp.curveTestedSession = Hp.session pl( "arc_selected", { curve = Hp.desiredCurve } )
end
end
local
function Ll( JI, ES, Ml, eS )
local Ol = Sl( JI, ES )
if not CU() then
    return
end
local zt = JI.IsAimLocked and JI.IsAimLocked()
if Hp.airborneOnly and zt and not Hp.targetGoal then
    Hp.acquisitionAttempted, Hp.acquisitionSkipped = true, true Hp.lastError = "Jump detected after aim lock. Start the next shot in the air." cU()
    return
end
local DS = JI.GetLockedCurve and JI.GetLockedCurve()
if DS == nil then
    DS = Hp.actualCurve
end
Hp.currentPower = JI.GetCurrentPower()
local el = JI.GetChargeSecondsFromPower( 1 )
local Dl = Hp.autoPower and Ol.autoPower Hp.planningApertures = nI.BuildGoalApertures( Ml.goals )
if not Hp.defendersAt or os.clock() - Hp.defendersAt >= .1 then
    Hp.planningDefenders = nI.GetDefenders( TI, Hp.modules, Ml.goals ) Hp.defendersAt = os.clock()
end
if not Hp.targetGoal then
    if Hp.acquisitionAttempted then
        return
    end
    local Zl = cl( JI, ES, Ml, el, DS, eS ) Zl.selectionRay = Hp.selectionRay or wU() or ES
    local SB = TI.Character and TI.Character:FindFirstChild( "HumanoidRootPart" ) Zl.capturePosition = SB and SB.Position or Ml.startPosition Zl.maxTargetDistance, Zl.captureAngleDegrees = Hp.maxTargetDistance, Hp.captureAngleDegrees
    local rX, rW = Ea.SelectTarget( Zl ) Hp.acquisitionAttempted = true
    if not rX then
        rW = "Aim near a corner within capture range." Hp.acquisitionSkipped, Hp.lastError = true, rW cU() pl( "capture_skipped", { reason = rW } )
        return
    end
    Hp.targetGoal, Hp.targetPoint, Hp.targetId = rX.goal, rX.target, rX.id Hp.targetGroundPoint, Hp.targetAirPoint = rX.groundTarget or rX.target, rX.airborneTarget or rX.target Zl.preferredGoal, Zl.preferredTarget, Zl.mode = rX.goal, nil, "Auto" Hp.cornerPoints = Ea.GetTargetPoints( Zl ) Hp.plan = kl( ES, Ml, el, DS ) Hp.steeringPlan = Hp.plan pl( "target_selected", { goal = rX.goal:GetFullName(), corner = rX.id, pending = true } ) tl( Hp.plan )
end
local dl = false
for Fp, ua in ipairs( Ml.goals ) do
    if ua == Hp.targetGoal then
        dl = true;
        break
    end
end
if not dl or not Hp.targetGoal.Parent then
    MU( false ) Hp.acquisitionAttempted, Hp.acquisitionSkipped = true, true Hp.lastError = "Goal changed. Aim again and start a new shot."
    return
end
if os.clock() >= eS then
    return
end
if Hp.arcPending then
    if not Hp.autoCurve or zt then
        Hp.arcPending = nil
    else
        if Tl( Hp.arcPending, eS ) then
            Hp.arcPending = nil ul()
        end
        return
    end
end
local j = el
local Fl, ps = DS, false
if Hp.autoCurve and not Hp.feint and not zt and Ol.curve and Hp.lastGoodPlan and Hp.curveTestedSession ~= Hp.session and Hp.modules.CurvedKicks.IsEnabled() then
    Hp.arcIndex = ( Hp.arcIndex or 0 ) + 1 Fl, ps = Cl[ Hp.arcIndex ], true
end
local Rs = cl( JI, ES, Ml, j, Fl, eS )
local DO, rW
if zt then
    if not Hp.lockedDirection then
        Hp.lockedDirection = ES.Direction
    end
    DO, rW = Ea.Evaluate( Rs, Hp.lockedDirection, Hp.targetPoint, Hp.targetGoal )
else
    DO, rW = Ea.Solve( Rs )
end
Hp.plannerCalls = ( Hp.plannerCalls or 0 ) + 1
if ps then
    if DO and DO.success then
        Hp.arcPending = { plan = DO, curve = Fl, start = Ml.startPosition }
        if Tl( Hp.arcPending, eS ) then
            Hp.arcPending = nil
        end
    end
    if not Hp.arcPending then
        ul()
    end
    return
end
if not DO then
    Hp.lastError = rW or "Target locked. Refining the full-power trajectory."
    if Hp.plan then
        Hp.plan = table.clone( Hp.plan ) Hp.plan.success, Hp.plan.scoresGoal = false, false Hp.plan.provisional = true Hp.plan.chargeSeconds, Hp.plan.curveInput = j, DS Hp.steeringPlan = Hp.plan tl( Hp.plan )
    end
    return
end
DO.steeringValid = DO.direction and DO.direction.Magnitude > .01 DO.startPosition = Ml.startPosition DO.provisional = not DO.success
if zt then
    DO.direction = Hp.lockedDirection
end
Hp.plan, Hp.steeringPlan = DO, DO
if DO.success then
    Hp.lastGoodPlan, Hp.lastError = DO, nil
    if Dl and not Hp.releaseSeconds then
        Hp.releaseSeconds, Hp.powerSeconds = DO.chargeSeconds, DO.chargeSeconds
    end
else
    Hp.lastError = "Target locked. Refining the full-power trajectory."
end
tl( DO )
end
local
function Vs( JI )
if not CU() then
    return
end
if Hp.airborneOnly and not Hp.targetGoal and JI.IsAimLocked and JI.IsAimLocked() then
    Hp.acquisitionAttempted, Hp.acquisitionSkipped = true, true Hp.lastError = "Jump detected after aim lock. Start the next shot in the air." cU()
    return
end
if Hp.acquisitionAttempted and not Hp.targetGoal then
    return
end
if Hp.solveBusy or os.clock() < ( Hp.nextPlanAt or 0 ) then
    return
end
local LS = os.clock()
local eS = LS + Hl Hp.solveBusy = true
local u, rW = pcall( function() local ES = JI.GetChargeAimRay() if type( ES ) ~= "table" or not ES.Direction then
    return
end
local Ml, Ws = nI.GetShotContext( Hp.modules, TI, JI ) if not Ml then
    Hp.directError = Ws if Hp.targetGoal then
        local as = false for Fp, ua in ipairs( nI.GetGoals( Hp.modules, TI ) ) do
            if ua == Hp.targetGoal then
                as = true;
                break
            end
        end
        if not as then
            MU( false ) Hp.acquisitionAttempted, Hp.acquisitionSkipped = true, true
        end
    end
    return
end
Hp.directError = nil Ll( JI, ES, Ml, eS )
end
) Hp.solveBusy = false
local Ss = os.clock() Hp.nextPlanAt = Ss + wl Hp.lastWorkMs = ( Ss - LS ) * 1000 Hp.maxWorkMs = math.max( Hp.maxWorkMs or 0, Hp.lastWorkMs )
if Ss > eS then
    Hp.budgetOverruns = ( Hp.budgetOverruns or 0 ) + 1
end
if not u then
    Hp.lastError, Hp.directError = tostring( rW ), tostring( rW )
end
end
local
function Os( MI, x, xB )
local Is, Bs = nI.Replace( Hp, MI, x, xB )
if not Is then
    error( x .. ": " .. tostring( Bs ) )
end
table.insert( Hp.restores, Is ) Hp.hooks = Hp.hooks or {} table.insert( Hp.hooks, x )
end
local ms = setmetatable( {}, { __mode = "k" } )
local
function Xs( JI )
if not CU() then
    return
end
local Pa = DU()
if Pa ~= JI or Hp.solveBusy then
    return
end
local ES = JI.GetChargeAimRay()
if type( ES ) ~= "table" or not ES.Direction then
    return
end
local Ol = Sl( JI, ES )
if not CU() then
    return
end
if Hp.targetGoal and not Hp.targetGoal.Parent then
    MU( false ) Hp.acquisitionAttempted, Hp.acquisitionSkipped = true, true
end
local zt = JI.IsAimLocked and JI.IsAimLocked()
if zt and not Hp.lockObserved then
    Hp.lockObserved = true pl( "native_aim_locked", { actualPower = JI.GetCurrentPower(), predictionPower = 1, corner = Hp.targetId } )
end
if Ol.airborne and not zt then
    ES.IsAirborne = true
end
Hp.directAimCalls = ( Hp.directAimCalls or 0 ) + 1
if Hp.directSession ~= Hp.session then
    Hp.directSession = Hp.session pl( "stored_aim_started", { profile = Ol.key } )
end
local DO = Hp.steeringPlan
if not zt and DO and DO.steeringValid then
    ES.Direction = DO.direction
end
end
sU = function( JI )
if ms[ JI ] or type( JI.UpdateAim ) ~= "function" then
    return
end
ms[ JI ] = true
local Is, Bs = nI.Replace( Hp, JI, "UpdateAim", function( EB, ... ) local gI = table.pack( EB( ... ) ) local u, xK = pcall( Xs, JI ) Hp.solveBusy = false if not u then
    Hp.directError = tostring( xK )
end
return( table.unpack or unpack )( gI, 1, gI.n )
end
)
if Is then

    return

    return

        return string.format( "%.1f", H / h[ 1 ] ):gsub( "%.0$", "" ) .. h[ 2 ]
    end
end

end

local function Ug( g, P ) if not ZX( g ) or not ZX( P ) then
    return math.huge

local function w( H ) return type( H ) == "number" and H == H and math.abs( H ) < math.huge
end
local function ln( H ) if not w( H ) then
    return "-"
end
for Fp, h in ipairs( { { 1000000000000, "T" }, { 1000000000, "B" }, { 1000000, "M" }, { 1000, "K" } } ) do
    if math.abs( H ) >= h[ 1 ] then
        return string.format( "%.1f", H / h[ 1 ] ):gsub( "%.0$", "" ) .. h[ 2 ]
    end
end
return tostring( math.floor( H ) )
end

function ER.SafeSpeed( tx, ia, lO, lq ) local IB = YQ() if oJ and IB - oJ.at < .075 and oJ.bike == cJ and( tx - oJ.here ).Magnitude < 4 and( ia - oJ.direction ).Magnitude < .05 then

            iR[ # iR + 1 ] = WV
        end
    end
end
if # iR ~= 3 then
    return iE
end
table.sort( iR );
return iR
end
return { xs = Ls( mU.XS, { 140, 400, 660 } ), zs = Ls( mU.ZS, { 660, 900, 1140 } ), half = w( mU.ROAD_HALF ) and za( mU.ROAD_HALF, 6, 30 ) or 12, y = w( mU.Y ) and mU.Y or 1.1 }
end
local function vE( SV, mV, ea ) local NE = mV.half - ( ea or 0 ) for Fp, qV in ipairs( mV.zs ) do
    if math.abs( SV.Z - qV ) <= NE and SV.X >= mV.xs[ 1 ] - NE and SV.X <= mV.xs[ 3 ] + NE then
        return true
    end
end
for Fp, mR in ipairs( mV.xs ) do
    if math.abs( SV.X - mR ) <= NE and SV.Z >= mV.zs[ 1 ] - NE and SV.Z <= mV.zs[ 3 ] + NE then
        return true
    end
end
return false
end
local function oE( SV, mV ) local oS, tQ for Fp, qV in ipairs( mV.zs ) do
    local xS = KV( za( SV.X, mV.xs[ 1 ], mV.xs[ 3 ] ), mV.y, qV ) local up = PS( SV, xS );
    if not tQ or up < tQ then
        oS, tQ = xS, up
    end
end
for Fp, mR in ipairs( mV.xs ) do
    local xS = KV( mR, mV.y, za( SV.Z, mV.zs[ 1 ], mV.zs[ 3 ] ) ) local up = PS( SV, xS );
    if not tQ or up < tQ then
        oS, tQ = xS, up
    end
end
return oS
end
local function uE( g, P, mV ) local wg = PS( g, P ) for dR = 0, math.min( 24, math.ceil( wg / 15 ) ) do
    local KB = math.max( 1, math.min( 24, math.ceil( wg / 15 ) ) ) local OV = dR / KB if not vE( KV( g.X + ( P.X - g.X ) * OV, mV.y, g.Z + ( P.Z - g.Z ) * OV ), mV, 1 ) then
        return false
    end
end
return true
end
local function LE( tx, qS, oB ) local mV = jE() local iR = { points = {}, index = 1, previous = tx, town = mV } if uE( tx, qS, mV ) then
    iR.points = { qS };
    return iR
end
local eE = {} for Fp, mR in ipairs( mV.xs ) do
    for Fp, qV in ipairs( mV.zs ) do
        eE[ # eE + 1 ] = KV( mR, mV.y, qV )
    end
end

    if math.abs( H - WV ) < 0.01 then
        return true
    end
end
return false
end
for Fp = 1, 11 do
    local Pa, oS for dR = 1, 11 do
        if not ZQ[ dR ] and fC[ dR ] and( not oS or fC[ dR ] < oS ) then
            Pa, oS = dR, fC[ dR ]
        end
    end
    if not Pa then
        break
    end
    ZQ[ Pa ] = true if Pa == 11 then
        break
    end
    for dR = 1, 11 do
        local mO = math.abs( eE[ dR ].X - eE[ Pa ].X ) < 0.01 and DE( mV.xs, eE[ dR ].X ) local BO = math.abs( eE[ dR ].Z - eE[ Pa ].Z ) < 0.01 and DE( mV.zs, eE[ dR ].Z ) if dR ~= Pa and( mO or BO ) then
            local xS = oS + PS( eE[ Pa ], eE[ dR ] ) if not fC[ dR ] or xS < fC[ dR ] then
                fC[ dR ], Ja[ dR ] = xS, Pa
            end
        end
    end
end
local ZE, mp = {}, 11 for Fp = 1, 12 do
    ZE[ # ZE + 1 ] = eE[ mp ];
    if mp == 10 then
        break
    end
    ;
    mp = Ja[ mp ];
    if not mp then
        break
    end
end
for dR = # ZE, 1, - 1 do
    local SV = ZE[ dR ] if # iR.points == 0 or PS( iR.points[ # iR.points ], SV ) > 0.1 then
        iR.points[ # iR.points + 1 ] = SV
    end
end
if # iR.points > 0 and PS( iR.points[ # iR.points ], qS ) < 0.1 then
    iR.points[ # iR.points ] = qS
else
    iR.points[ # iR.points + 1 ] = qS
end
return iR
end
local function dE( tx ) local TQ = MQ() if TQ - PE < 0.15 then
    return gE
end
PE, gE = TQ, {} local OE = MI( "HighwayTraffic" ) if not OE or type( OE.vehicles ) ~= "function" then
    return gE
end
local u, r = pcall( OE.vehicles ) if not u or type( r ) ~= "table" then
    return gE
end

    local T = r[ dR ] if type( T ) == "table" and T.active == true then
        local Za, fB = T.cf, T.vel local SV, xl = bK( Za, "Position" ), bK( Za, "RightVector" ) local wg, d, Rp = T.length, T.width, T.height if ZK( SV ) and ZK( xl ) and ZK( fB ) and w( wg ) and w( d ) and w( Rp ) and wg > 0 and d > 0 and Rp > 0 then
            local FE = T.ghostOffset if ZK( FE ) then
                local OV = KV( SV.X + FE.X, SV.Y + FE.Y, SV.Z + FE.Z ) if PS( tx, OV ) < PS( tx, SV ) then
                    SV = OV
                end
            end
            local pc, Rc = ef( xl.X, xl.Z ) if pc ~= 0 or Rc ~= 0 then
                gE[ # gE + 1 ] = { position = SV, velocity = fB, fx = pc, fz = Rc, length = za( wg, 1, 100 ), width = za( d, 1, 30 ), height = za( Rp, 1, 30 ) }
            end
        end

local function DA( tx, xS, zE, Vc, lO, r ) local Wc, ac, Sc = ef( xS.X - tx.X, xS.Z - tx.Z ) local oK = 0.9 local Zp = math.min( oK, Sc / math.max( lO, 0.01 ) ) local function Oc( Ic, Bc, mc, Xc, La, f, Kc ) local SV, bc = Kc.position, Kc.velocity local qc, Yc = Ic - ( SV.X + bc.X * La ), Bc - ( SV.Z + bc.Z * La ) local hc, tc = mc - bc.X, Xc - bc.Z local Xa, Uc = 0, f local function WB( nK, fB, CK ) if math.abs( fB ) < 0.0001 then
    return math.abs( nK ) <= CK
end
local g, P = ( - CK - nK ) / fB, ( CK - nK ) / fB if g > P then
    g, P = P, g
end
Xa, Uc = math.max( Xa, g ), math.min( Uc, P ) return Xa <= Uc
end
return WB( qc * Kc.fx + Yc * Kc.fz, hc * Kc.fx + tc * Kc.fz, Kc.length / 2 + 2.2 ) and WB( - qc * Kc.fz + Yc * Kc.fx, - hc * Kc.fz + tc * Kc.fx, Kc.width / 2 + 2.2 )
end
for Fp, Kc in ipairs( r ) do
    local SV = Kc.position if math.abs( SV.Y - tx.Y ) <= Kc.height + 5 and PS( SV, tx ) < 180 then
        if Oc( tx.X, tx.Z, Wc * lO, ac * lO, 0, Zp, Kc ) then
            return true
        end
        if Zp < oK and Oc( xS.X, xS.Z, zE * lO, Vc * lO, Zp, oK - Zp, Kc ) then
            return true
        end
    end
end
return false
end
function ER.Plan( tx, qS, oB ) oB = oB or {} local lO = w( oB.speed ) and za( oB.speed, 5, 500 ) or 60 if gH or not ZK( tx ) or not ZK( qS ) then
    return { position = tx, speed = 0, holding = true, avoidance = "stopped" }
end
local TE = oB.course == "Highway" and "Highway" or "Town" if oB.course == "Map" then
    local mV = jE() local function lc( SV ) return SV.X >= mV.xs[ 1 ] - mV.half and SV.X <= mV.xs[ 3 ] + mV.half and SV.Z >= mV.zs[ 1 ] - mV.half and SV.Z <= mV.zs[ 3 ] + mV.half
end
TE = lc( tx ) and lc( qS ) and "Town" or "Map"
end
local sc = ER.Nearest( qS, tx, TE ) local x = table.concat( { TE, tostring( oB.segment ), tostring( qS.X ), tostring( qS.Y ), tostring( qS.Z ), tostring( oB.laneZ ) }, "|" ) if not fE or fE.key ~= x then
    fE = TE == "Town" and LE( tx, sc, oB ) or { points = { sc }, index = 1, previous = tx } if TE == "Highway" and w( oB.laneZ ) then
        fE.previous = KV( tx.X, sc.Y, oB.laneZ )
    end
    fE.key = x
end
if TE == "Highway" then
    fE.points[ 1 ] = sc
end
while fE.index < # fE.points do
    local MA = fE.points[ fE.index ] local wc, Hc = MA.X - fE.previous.X, MA.Z - fE.previous.Z local Cc = wc * wc + Hc * Hc local Ac = Cc > 0.01 and( ( tx.X - fE.previous.X ) * wc + ( tx.Z - fE.previous.Z ) * Hc ) / Cc or 0 local rc = Cc > 0.01 and math.abs( ( tx.X - fE.previous.X ) * Hc - ( tx.Z - fE.previous.Z ) * wc ) / math.sqrt( Cc ) or PS( tx, MA ) if PS( tx, MA ) <= 5 or Ac >= 1 and rc <= 8 then
        fE.previous, fE.index = MA, fE.index + 1
    else
        break
    end
end
local MA = fE.points[ fE.index ] or sc local zE, Vc, wI = ef( MA.X - tx.X, MA.Z - tx.Z ) if wI < 0.05 then
    return { position = MA, speed = lO, holding = false, avoidance = "clear", waypoints = # fE.points }
end
local nc = fE.points[ fE.index + 1 ] if nc then
    local yc, fc = ef( nc.X - MA.X, nc.Z - MA.Z ) if zE * yc + Vc * fc < 0.75 and wI < 65 then
        lO = math.min( lO, 25 + wI * 0.5 )
    end
end
local r = dE( tx ) local iQ = ER.Nearest( fE.previous, tx, TE ) local Qc, gc, Pc = ef( MA.X - iQ.X, MA.Z - iQ.Z ) if Pc < 0.1 then
    Qc, gc = zE, Vc
end
local vl = za( ( tx.X - iQ.X ) * Qc + ( tx.Z - iQ.Z ) * gc, 0, Pc ) local Jc = KV( iQ.X + Qc * vl, MA.Y, iQ.Z + gc * vl ) local xc = lO / 3.6 * 3.571428571428571 local lx = math.min( wI, za( xc * 0.65, 14, 70 ) ) local IP = false for Fp, Kc in ipairs( r ) do
    local qc, Yc = Kc.position.X - tx.X, Kc.position.Z - tx.Z local wE, HS = qc * zE + Yc * Vc, math.abs( - qc * Vc + Yc * zE ) if wE > 0 and wE < 80 and HS < Kc.width / 2 + 12 then
        IP = true lx = math.min( lx, math.max( 8, wE - Kc.length / 2 - 5 ) )
    end
end
local Ec = w( oB.maxOffset ) and za( oB.maxOffset, 0, 11 ) or 11 if w( oB.gateRadius ) and wI < 65 then
    Ec = math.min( Ec, math.max( 0, oB.gateRadius - 4 ) )
end
if fE.town then
    Ec = math.min( Ec, math.max( 0, fE.town.half - 2 ) )
end
local lp = TE == "Highway" and mE() or nil local cc = lp and( tx.Z >= lp.centreZ and 1 or - 1 ) or 1 local HS = MQ() < xE and JE or 1 local sS = { 0, HS * math.min( 6, Ec ), HS * Ec, - HS * math.min( 6, Ec ), - HS * Ec } for Fp, kO in ipairs( sS ) do
    local Mc = math.min( lx, math.max( 0, Pc - vl ) ) local xS = KV( Jc.X + Qc * Mc - gc * kO, MA.Y, Jc.Z + gc * Mc + Qc * kO ) local kc = true if fE.town then
        kc = vE( xS, fE.town, 1.5 ) or kO == 0 and fE.index == # fE.points
    end
    if lp then
        local HS = ( xS.Z - lp.centreZ ) * cc kc = HS >= 2 and HS <= lp.halfWidth - 2
    end
    if kc and not DA( tx, xS, Qc, gc, xc, r ) then
        local Tc = math.abs( kO ) > 0.01 if Tc then
            JE, xE = kO > 0 and 1 or - 1, MQ() + 1.5
        end
        if IP then
            lO = math.min( lO, math.max( 15, lO * ( Tc and 0.65 or 0.8 ) ) )
        end
        local zc = IP and PS( tx, Jc ) > 1 return { position = ( Tc or zc ) and xS or MA, speed = lO, holding = false, avoidance = Tc and( kO > 0 and "right" or "left" ) or "clear", waypoints = # fE.points }
    end
end
return { position = tx, speed = 0, holding = true, avoidance = "blocked", waypoints = # fE.points }
end
function ER.Clear() fE, gE, PE, JE, xE = nil, {}, - math.huge, 1, 0
end
function ER.Stop() gH = true;
ER.Clear()
end
return ER
end
return yE
end

end
) return u and type( iR ) == "table" and iR or {}
end
local function pK( rm, Cp ) if not rm then
    return nil
end
local u, iR = pcall( function() return rm:GetAttribute( Cp )
end
) return u and iR or nil
end
local function ZX( H ) if type( typeof ) == "function" and typeof( H ) ~= "Vector3" then
    return false
end
local u, pw = pcall( function() return H ~= nil and w( H.X ) and w( H.Y ) and w( H.Z )
end
) return u and pw
end
local function nK( rm ) if not rm then
    return nil
end
local u, iR = pcall( function() return rm.Position
end
) if u and ZX( iR ) then
    return iR
end
u, iR = pcall( function() return rm:GetPivot().Position
end
) return u and ZX( iR ) and iR or nil
end
local function PS( g, P ) if not ZX( g ) or not ZX( P ) then
    return math.huge
end
return( g - P ).Magnitude
end
function aM.Create( C ) C = C or {} local TI = C.player local ZI = C.workspace local gJ = C.ReplicatedStorage local Ey = C.HttpService local Hp = C.state or {} local Xf = C.vehicle or {} local jc = C.navigation local pg = C.task or task local kX = C.clock or os.clock local n, SM, hm = true, false, 1 local YR, OM, IM, BM, mM = {}, {}, {}, {}, {} local XM, KM, bM = {}, {}, 0 local qM, jP, YM = {}, nil, nil local hM, tM, UM = - math.huge, 0, 0 local lA, lM, sM, wM = nil, nil, 0, nil local HM = 0 local CM = setmetatable( {}, { __mode = "k" } ) local AM = {} local rM, nM, vc, Nc = nil, nil, nil, nil local yM = 0 local fM, QM = nil, 0 local gM, PM = nil, {} local JM, xM, EM = nil, 0, 1 local cM, MM = nil, nil local kM local TM local zM = {} local GM = { Town = Vector3.new( 380.7678527832031, 6.344923973083496, 886.2681884765625 ), Highway = Vector3.new( - 342.096923828125, 1.042485237121582, 594.4317626953125 ) } local jM, iM = 0, false local YW = { mode = "Idle", text = "Ready", request = nil, unavailable = {} } Hp.ConfirmedPumpkins, Hp.ConfirmedRaces = 0, 0 Hp.ConfirmedRewards, Hp.ConfirmedChallenges = 0, 0 local function Ff( x, pp ) Hp[ x ] = pp YW.text = pp
end
local function xW( vI, WA, x ) if vI[ x ] then
    return false
end
bM = bM + 1 vI[ x ] = bM WA[ # WA + 1 ] = { key = x, sequence = bM } if # WA > 128 then
    local zQ = table.remove( WA, 1 ) if vI[ zQ.key ] == zQ.sequence then
        vI[ zQ.key ] = nil
    end
end
return true
end
local function vM( Cp, ... ) local dm = Xf[ Cp ] if type( dm ) ~= "function" then
    return false
end
local u, iR = pcall( dm, ... ) return u and iR ~= false, iR
end
local function NM() vM( "ClearAutomationTarget", "Automation" ) if jc and type( jc.Clear ) == "function" then
    pcall( jc.Clear )
end
fM = nil YW.mode = "Idle"
end
local function oM() hm = hm + 1 lM, wM, rM, nM = nil, nil, nil, nil HM = 0 yM = 0 TM = nil QM = 0 Hp.raceJoinPendingUntil = nil JM, xM, EM = nil, 0, 1 NM()
end
local function HR( CR, AR ) if not CR then
    return
end
local u, uR = pcall( function() return CR:Connect( AR )
end
) if u and uR then
    YR[ # YR + 1 ] = uR
end
end
local function Fs( AB, Cp ) return Cp and nm( nm( gJ, AB ), Cp ) or nm( gJ, AB )
end
local function uM( qR, rm, LM, AR ) if lA or not rm or not pg or type( pg.spawn ) ~= "function" then
    return false
end
local dm = rm.InvokeServer if type( dm ) ~= "function" then
    return false
end
local lE = { generation = hm, label = qR, started = kX() } lA = lE YW.request = qR pg.spawn( function() if not n or SM or Hp.paused or lE.generation ~= hm then
    if lA == lE then
        lA = nil;
        YW.request = nil
    end
    return
end
local u, iR = pcall( dm, rm, ( table.unpack or unpack )( LM or {} ) ) if lA == lE then
    lA = nil;
    YW.request = nil
end
if not n or SM or lE.generation ~= hm then
    return
end
AR( u, iR )
end
) return true
end
local function eM( mK ) if type( mK ) ~= "table" or type( mK.list ) ~= "table" then
    return false
end
if not jP or jP.day ~= mK.day then
    mM = {}
end
local Ls = {} for mp, c in ipairs( mK.list ) do
    if mp > 16 then
        break
    end
    if type( c ) == "table" and type( c.stat ) == "string" and w( c.progress ) and w( c.target ) then
        local h = { stat = c.stat, progress = c.progress, target = c.target, done = c.done == true, text = c.text } Ls[ # Ls + 1 ] = h if Hp.AutoChallenges and not SM and not Hp.paused and mM[ c.stat ] == false and h.done then
            Hp.ConfirmedChallenges = Hp.ConfirmedChallenges + 1
        end
        mM[ c.stat ] = h.done
    end
end
jP = { day = mK.day, list = Ls } return true
end
local function DM( mK ) if type( mK ) ~= "table" then
    return false
end
for Fp, x in ipairs( { "group", "follow", "event" } ) do
    if YM and YM[ x ] == false and mK[ x ] == true then
        Hp.ConfirmedRewards = Hp.ConfirmedRewards + 1
    end
end
local function ZM( x ) if type( mK[ x ] ) == "boolean" then
    return mK[ x ]
end
return YM and YM[ x ] == true or false
end
YM = { group = ZM( "group" ), groupFound = ZM( "groupFound" ), follow = ZM( "follow" ), event = ZM( "event" ), wait = Lp( mK.wait, 0, 0, 86400 ), gwait = Lp( mK.gwait, 0, 0, 86400 ), at = kX() } return true
end
local function dM( CW, aR, H ) if not n then
    return
end
if CW == "set" and type( aR ) == "table" then
    OM = {} local BK = 0 for x, ZK in pairs( aR ) do
        if w( x ) and ZX( ZK ) and BK < 64 then
            OM[ x ] = ZK;
            BK = BK + 1
        end
    end
elseif CW == "add" and w( aR ) and ZX( H ) then
    OM[ aR ] = H IM[ aR ] = nil
elseif( CW == "remove" or CW == "smashed" ) and w( aR ) then
    OM[ aR ] = nil if wM and wM.item.id == aR then
        wM.confirmedRemoved = true
    end
    if CW == "smashed" and xW( IM, XM, aR ) then
        if not SM and not Hp.paused and( Hp.AutoSmashPumpkins or Hp.AutoChallenges ) then
            jM = jM + 1 Hp.ConfirmedPumpkins = jM
        end
    end
end
hM = - math.huge
end
HR( ( Fs( "HalloweenRemotes", "Pumpkins" ) or {} ).OnClientEvent, dM ) HR( ( Fs( "HalloweenChallengeRemotes", "Update" ) or {} ).OnClientEvent, function( mK ) if n then
    eM( mK )
end
end
) HR( ( Fs( "RaceEvent" ) or {} ).OnClientEvent, function( CW, fW, va ) if not n or SM or Hp.paused or not Hp.AutoRace then
    return
end
if CW == "teleport" and ZX( fW ) and w( va ) then
    cM = { position = fW, yaw = va, at = kX(), id = pK( TI, "RaceId" ) } return
end
if CW ~= "result" or type( fW ) ~= "table" then
    return
end
if fW.dnf then
    lM, cM, MM = nil, nil, nil sM = kX() + Lp( Hp.RaceRetryDelay, 12, 8, 120 ) xM = 0;
    NM();
    Ff( "RaceStatus", "Race ended \194\183 waiting before the next attempt" );
    return
end
local aR = fW.raceId if aR ~= nil and( type( aR ) == "string" or w( aR ) ) and xW( BM, KM, tostring( aR ) ) then
    Hp.ConfirmedRaces = Hp.ConfirmedRaces + 1 sM = kX() + Lp( Hp.RaceRetryDelay, 8, 5, 120 ) lM = nil cM, MM = nil, nil xM = 0 NM() Ff( "RaceStatus", "Race finished \194\183 confirmed by the game" )
end
end
) local function FM( IB ) if IB - hM < 0.6 then
    return qM
end
hM = IB local Ls = {} for aR, ZK in pairs( OM ) do
    Ls[ # Ls + 1 ] = { id = aR, position = ZK, source = "native" }
end
for mp, rB in ipairs( QX( nm( ZI, "MyPumpkins" ) ) ) do
    if mp > 64 then
        break
    end
    local ZK = nK( rB ) local pk = false if ZK then
        for Fp, c in ipairs( Ls ) do
            if PS( c.position, ZK ) < 2 then
                pk = true;
                break
            end
        end
        if not pk then
            Ls[ # Ls + 1 ] = { model = rB, position = ZK, source = "clone" }
        end
    end
end
qM = Ls return Ls
end
local function Rk() local u, iR = vM( "GetPosition" ) return u and ZX( iR ) and iR or nil
end
local function qJ( ZK, lO, XJ, Vk, Kx, sR ) local u, UH = vM( "DriveTo", ZK, { speed = lO, wheelie = XJ == true, stopDistance = Vk or 3, ttl = 0.9, pumpkinPass = Kx == true, owner = sR or "Automation" } ) return u and UH == true
end
local function Wk( IB, QE, sR ) sR = sR or "Automation" local tx = Rk() local Mm = FM( IB ) if not tx then
    Ff( "PumpkinStatus", "Waiting for bike position" );
    return false
end
local ak = wM and( wM.confirmedRemoved or wM.item.model and not wM.item.model.Parent ) if wM and( ak or IB > wM.expires or PS( tx, wM.through ) < 4 ) then
    if IB > wM.expires then
        local c = wM.item if c.model then
            CM[ c.model ] = IB + 15
        elseif c.id then
            AM[ c.id ] = IB + 15
        end
    end
    wM = nil HM = IB + Lp( Hp.PumpkinInterval, 1, .2, 10 )
end
if not wM then
    if IB < HM then
        Ff( "PumpkinStatus", "Waiting for the next pumpkin collection interval" );
        return false
    end
    local yK, Sk for Fp, xS in ipairs( Mm ) do
        local up = PS( tx, xS.position ) local dQ = xS.model and CM[ xS.model ] or AM[ xS.id ] local kc = not dQ or IB >= dQ if QE then
            local SV = xS.position kc = kc and SV.X >= tx.X - 1 and SV.X <= math.min( tx.X + 180, QE.last - 25 ) and SV.X >= QE.first + 25 and math.abs( SV.Z - QE.z ) <= math.min( 4.5, QE.width * .3 ) and math.abs( SV.Y - QE.top ) <= 5
        end
        if kc and( not Sk or up < Sk ) then
            yK, Sk = xS, up
        end
    end
    if not yK then
        Ff( "PumpkinStatus", QE and "No pumpkins ahead on this road; cruising continues" or "Waiting for live pumpkins" );
        return false
    end
    local zS = Vector3.new( yK.position.X - tx.X, 0, yK.position.Z - tx.Z ) local ia = QE and Vector3.new( 1, 0, 0 ) or( zS.Magnitude > 0.1 and zS.Unit or Vector3.new( 1, 0, 0 ) ) wM = { item = yK, expires = IB + math.min( 90, 12 + Sk / 12 ), through = yK.position + Vector3.new( 0, 1.3, 0 ) + ia * 11 }
end
if QE and( math.abs( wM.item.position.Z - QE.z ) > 4.5 or wM.item.position.X < tx.X - 13 ) then
    wM = nil;
    return false
end
local up = PS( tx, wM.through ) if not wM.best or up < wM.best - 2 then
    wM.best, wM.progressAt = up, IB
end
if wM.progressAt and IB - wM.progressAt > 5 then
    wM.expires = IB - 1;
    return false
end
fM, YW.mode = "Pumpkins", "Pumpkins" local qS, lO = wM.through, Lp( Hp.PumpkinRideSpeed, 45, 15, 140 ) if QE then
    lO = math.min( lO, Lp( Hp.rideSpeed, 70, 5, 500 ) )
end
if QE and jc and type( jc.Plan ) == "function" then
    local u, DO = pcall( jc.Plan, tx, qS, { course = "Highway", speed = lO, maxOffset = 0, laneZ = wM.item.position.Z, segment = "RoadPumpkin:" .. tostring( wM.item.id or wM.item.model ) } ) if not u or type( DO ) ~= "table" or not ZX( DO.position ) or not w( DO.speed ) then
        return false
    end
    if DO.holding or DO.speed <= 0 then
        qJ( tx, 0, false, 1.5, false, sR ) Ff( "PumpkinStatus", "Waiting for traffic on the pumpkin route" );
        return true
    end
    qS, lO = DO.position, math.min( lO, DO.speed )
end
if not QE and jc and type( jc.Plan ) == "function" then
    local u, DO = pcall( jc.Plan, tx, qS, { course = "Map", speed = lO, maxOffset = 4, segment = "Pumpkin:" .. tostring( wM.item.id or wM.item.model ) } ) if not u or type( DO ) ~= "table" or not ZX( DO.position ) or not w( DO.speed ) then
        Ff( "PumpkinStatus", "Waiting for a supported pumpkin route" );
        return false
    end
    if DO.holding or DO.speed <= 0 then
        qJ( tx, 0, false, 1.5, true, sR ) Ff( "PumpkinStatus", "Waiting for traffic on the pumpkin route" );
        return true
    end
    qS, lO = DO.position, DO.speed
end
local UH = qJ( qS, lO, Hp.autoWheelie == true, 1.5, true, sR ) local ha = UH and "Driving through the selected pumpkin \194\183 waiting for native confirmation" or "Waiting for the occupied bike" if UH then
    local u, N = vM( "GetStatus" ) if u and type( N ) == "table" and type( N.driveReason ) == "string" and N.driveReason ~= "Driving" and N.driveReason ~= "Off" then
        ha = N.driveReason
    end
end
Ff( "PumpkinStatus", ha ) return UH
end
local function Ok( Ik ) local tW = pK( Ik, "Checkpoints" ) if type( tW ) ~= "string" or # tW > 100000 or not Ey then
    return nil
end
local u, yW = pcall( function() return Ey:JSONDecode( tW )
end
) if not u or type( yW ) ~= "table" or # yW == 0 or # yW > 256 then
    return nil
end
local Bk = {} for Fp, c in ipairs( yW ) do
    if type( c ) ~= "table" or not w( c[ 1 ] ) or not w( c[ 2 ] ) or not w( c[ 3 ] ) then
        return nil
    end
    local zE, Vc = w( c[ 4 ] ) and c[ 4 ] or 1, w( c[ 5 ] ) and c[ 5 ] or 0 local da = Vector3.new( zE, 0, Vc ) if da.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        da = Vector3.new( 1, 0, 0 )
    else
        da = da.Unit
    end
    Bk[ # Bk + 1 ] = { position = Vector3.new( c[ 1 ], c[ 2 ], c[ 3 ] ), normal = da }
end
return Bk
end
local function mk( Cp ) local rB = nm( ZI, Cp .. "Race" ) return nm( rB, "Zone" )
end
local function Xk( Cp, IB, ZK ) NM() if not TM or TM.name ~= Cp then
    TM = { name = Cp, since = IB, next = 0 }
end
if IB - TM.since >= 35 then
    Hp.AutoRace = false Ff( "RaceStatus", "Race area did not load; Auto race stopped" ) return
end
if IB >= TM.next then
    TM.next = IB + 3 vM( "RequestGround", ZK or zM[ Cp ] or GM[ Cp ] )
end
Ff( "RaceStatus", "Loading the " .. Cp .. " race area \194\183 waiting for its actual start zone" )
end
local function Kk( ZK, tx, TE ) if jc and type( jc.Nearest ) == "function" then
    local u, iR = pcall( jc.Nearest, ZK, tx, TE ) if u and ZX( iR ) then
        return iR
    end
end
return ZK
end
local function Ug( g, P ) return math.sqrt( ( g.X - P.X ) ^ 2 + ( g.Z - P.Z ) ^ 2 )
end
local function bk( tx ) qJ( tx, 5, false, 1 )
end
local function qk( nE, va ) if not ZX( nE ) or not w( va ) then
    return false
end
local u, UH = vM( "TeleportGround", nE, va ) return u and UH == true
end
local function Yk( IB, tx, ha ) bk( tx ) if kM and kM.quitAt then
    if IB - kM.quitAt > 20 then
        Hp.AutoRace = false;
        NM() Ff( "RaceStatus", "Native race did not exit; Auto race stopped" )
    else
        Ff( "RaceStatus", "Restart requested \194\183 waiting for the native race to end" )
    end
    return
end
local TW = Fs( "RaceEvent" ) if TW and type( TW.FireServer ) == "function" then
    if kM then
        kM.quitAt = IB
    end
    pcall( TW.FireServer, TW, "quit" )
end
Ff( "RaceStatus", ha )
end
local function hk( IB ) local tx = Rk() if not tx then
    Ff( "RaceStatus", "Waiting for bike position" );
    return
end
if pK( TI, "InRace" ) == true then
    Hp.raceJoinPendingUntil = nil local tk = pK( TI, "RaceId" ) if not kM or kM.id ~= tk then
        kM = { id = tk, started = IB }
    end
    if kM.quitAt then
        Yk( IB, tx, "Waiting for race exit" );
        return
    end
    if tk ~= nil and BM[ tostring( tk ) ] then
        bk( tx );
        Ff( "RaceStatus", "Race result confirmed \194\183 waiting for the lobby" );
        return
    end
    local Ik = tk ~= nil and nm( nm( nm( gJ, "RaceState" ), "Races" ), "R" .. tostring( tk ) ) or nil if not lM or lM.id ~= tk then
        local Bk = Ok( Ik ) if not Bk then
            if IB - kM.started > 60 then
                Yk( IB, tx, "Race data unavailable \194\183 requesting restart" )
            else
                bk( tx );
                Ff( "RaceStatus", "Waiting for native race checkpoints" )
            end
            return
        end
        local Uk = math.floor( Lp( pK( Ik, "Laps" ), 1, 1, 20 ) ) local lk = MM and MM.id == tk and MM.count == # Bk and MM.index or 1 lM = { id = tk, gates = Bk, laps = Uk, index = lk, side = "before", entered = IB, radius = Lp( pK( Ik, "ArchRadius" ), 24, 6, 100 ), lastProgress = IB, startRetry = 0, recoveries = 0, course = Hp.RaceChoice == "Highway" and "Highway" or "Town" }
    end
    if pK( TI, "RaceHold" ) == true then
        if IB - kM.started > 90 then
            Yk( IB, tx, "Countdown did not finish \194\183 requesting restart" );
            return
        end
        lM.previous = nil;
        bk( tx );
        Ff( "RaceStatus", "On the starting grid \194\183 waiting for the countdown" );
        return
    end
    if lM.quitting then
        bk( tx );
        Ff( "RaceStatus", "Restart requested \194\183 waiting for the native race to end" );
        return
    end
    if not lM.placed then
        local nE, va = pK( TI, "RaceRespawn" ), pK( TI, "RaceYaw" ) if cM and IB - cM.at < 12 and( cM.id == nil or cM.id == tk ) then
            nE, va = cM.position, cM.yaw
        end
        if not ZX( nE ) or not w( va ) then
            bk( tx );
            Ff( "RaceStatus", "Waiting for the native starting position on the track" );
            return
        end
        if IB < lM.startRetry then
            bk( tx );
            return
        end
        lM.startRetry = IB + 2 if not qk( nE, va ) then
            bk( tx );
            Ff( "RaceStatus", "Track teleport is not ready \194\183 retrying" );
            return
        end
        lM.placed = true;
        lM.previous = nil;
        lM.lastProgress = IB if jc and type( jc.Clear ) == "function" then
            pcall( jc.Clear )
        end
        Ff( "RaceStatus", "Teleported to the native track start \194\183 preparing the route" );
        return
    end
    local sk = lM.gates[ lM.index ] if not sk then
        kM.resultAt = kM.resultAt or IB if IB - kM.resultAt > 45 then
            Yk( IB, tx, "Race result unavailable \194\183 requesting restart" )
        else
            bk( tx );
            Ff( "RaceStatus", "Route crossed \194\183 waiting for the game result" )
        end
        return
    end
    local TE = lM.course local ZK = Kk( sk.position, tx, TE ) local wk = ( tx.X - ZK.X ) * sk.normal.X + ( tx.Z - ZK.Z ) * sk.normal.Z local Fa = math.abs( ( tx.X - ZK.X ) * sk.normal.Z - ( tx.Z - ZK.Z ) * sk.normal.X ) local Hk = false if lM.previous then
        local Ja = Kk( lM.previous, ZK, TE ) local tH = ( Ja.X - ZK.X ) * sk.normal.X + ( Ja.Z - ZK.Z ) * sk.normal.Z if tH <= 0 and wk >= 0 and wk > tH and Ug( Ja, tx ) < 120 then
            local mV = - tH / ( wk - tH ) local mR = Ja.X + ( tx.X - Ja.X ) * mV - ZK.X local qV = Ja.Z + ( tx.Z - Ja.Z ) * mV - ZK.Z local XR = Ja.Y + ( tx.Y - Ja.Y ) * mV - ZK.Y Hk = math.abs( mR * sk.normal.Z - qV * sk.normal.X ) <= lM.radius - 2 and math.abs( XR ) <= lM.radius
        end
    end
    lM.previous = tx if Hk then
        lM.index = lM.index + 1;
        lM.side = "before";
        lM.lastProgress = IB;
        lM.bestDistance = nil MM = { id = tk, count = # lM.gates, index = lM.index } if jc and type( jc.Clear ) == "function" then
            pcall( jc.Clear )
        end
        if lM.index > # lM.gates then
            bk( tx )
        end
        Ff( "RaceStatus", "Checkpoint crossed \194\183 continuing along the track" );
        return
    end
    if wk <= - 1 and wk >= - 32 and Fa <= lM.radius - 3 then
        lM.side = "after"
    end
    local qS = ZK + sk.normal * ( lM.side == "before" and - 9 or 18 ) local wI = Ug( tx, ZK ) if not lM.bestDistance or wI < lM.bestDistance - 1 then
        lM.bestDistance = wI;
        lM.lastProgress = IB
    end
    if IB - lM.lastProgress > 35 then
        local nE, va = pK( TI, "RaceRespawn" ), pK( TI, "RaceYaw" ) if lM.recoveries < 2 and ZX( nE ) and w( va ) and qk( nE, va ) then
            lM.recoveries = lM.recoveries + 1;
            lM.previous = nil;
            lM.side = "before" lM.lastProgress = IB;
            lM.bestDistance = nil if jc and type( jc.Clear ) == "function" then
                pcall( jc.Clear )
            end
            Ff( "RaceStatus", "Returned to the native checkpoint \194\183 retrying the road segment" );
            return
        end
        Yk( IB, tx, "Route blocked \194\183 restarting this race" );
        return
    end
    fM, YW.mode = "Race", "Race" local lO = Lp( Hp.RaceRideSpeed, 75, 20, 200 ) local Ck = "Following the track" if jc and type( jc.Plan ) == "function" then
        local u, DO = pcall( jc.Plan, tx, qS, { speed = lO, course = TE, segment = tostring( tk ) .. ":" .. lM.index .. ":" .. lM.side, gateRadius = lM.radius, maxOffset = math.min( 11, lM.radius - 5 ) } ) if not u or type( DO ) ~= "table" or not ZX( DO.position ) or not w( DO.speed ) then
            bk( tx );
            Ff( "RaceStatus", "Waiting for a safe road segment" );
            return
        end
        qS, lO = DO.position, DO.speed if DO.holding then
            Ck = "Braking for traffic"
        elseif DO.avoidance and DO.avoidance ~= "clear" then
            Ck = "Avoiding a car"
        end

function nW.GetIntent() local JT = { needsGarage = false } if not ks( "upgrade" ) or type( C.activateButton ) ~= "function" then

    return JT

    if Ph( Hp.SelectedUpgrades, c.id ) then
        local Lb = Il and hT( nm( Il.panel, "UPGRADES" ), c, "Buy" ) local OT = Lb and ok( Nk( Lb ) ) or nil local JC = false for Fp, yT in ipairs( aC( Dc.STAGE_PRICES ) ) do
            if OT == yT then
                JC = true;
                break

        if( Lb and XW( Lb, "Active" ) == true and JC and OT <= kg ) or( not Il and w( xT ) and xT <= kg ) then
            return { needsGarage = true, reason = "Selected Garage upgrade is affordable" }
        end
    end
end
local qT = gf( TI, "SelectedBike" ) if not( type( Dc.NO_ENGINE ) == "table" and Dc.NO_ENGINE[ qT ] ) then
    for Fp, c in ipairs( Ls.engines ) do

            local Lb = Il and hT( nm( Il.panel, "ENGINE" ), c, "Fit" ) local qR = Nk( Lb ) local OT = qR == "FIT" and 0 or ok( qR ) if( Lb and XW( Lb, "Active" ) == true and w( OT ) and OT <= kg ) or( not Il and w( c.price ) and c.price <= kg ) then
                return { needsGarage = true, reason = "Selected Garage engine is affordable" }
            end
        end
    end
end
return JT
end
local function ET( IB ) if not iw or dV then
    return
end
local SV = iw local ql = SV.kind == "buy" and WT( SV.bike ) or SV.kind == "select" and gf( TI, "SelectedBike" ) == SV.bike.id if SV.kind == "spawn" then
    local Fp, Wf = mT() ql = Wf ~= nil and gf( TI, "SelectedBike" ) == SV.bike.id
end
if SV.kind == "event" then
    ql = HT( SV.bike )

if SV.kind == "upgrade" or SV.kind == "engine" then
    local Il = XT( dk or {}, true ) local tY = Il and nm( Il.panel, SV.kind == "upgrade" and "UPGRADES" or "ENGINE" ) local Lb = tY and hT( tY, SV.bike, SV.kind == "upgrade" and "Buy" or "Fit" ) or SV.button ql = gf( TI, "SelectedBike" ) == SV.bikeId and gf( TI, "Garage" ) ~= SV.garage and Nk( Lb ) ~= SV.label
end
if ql then
    if SV.kind == "buy" then
        cs.BikesBought = cs.BikesBought + 1
    end
    if SV.kind == "select" then
        cs.BikesSelected = cs.BikesSelected + 1
    end
    if SV.kind == "upgrade" or SV.kind == "engine" then
        cs.UpgradesBought = cs.UpgradesBought + 1
    end
    if SV.kind == "event" then
        cs.EventItemsBought = cs.EventItemsBought + 1
    end
    iw = nil if na.pending == SV then
        na.pending = nil
    end
    YW( SV.kind == "buy" and( "Purchased " .. SV.bike.name ) or( "Selected " .. SV.bike.name ) ) Dk = 0
elseif IB >= SV.deadline then
    if( SV.kind == "spawn" or SV.kind == "select" ) and SV.returned then
        iw = nil;
        if na.pending == SV then
            na.pending = nil
        end
        QM = IB + 5;
        YW( "Selected bike did not arrive; waiting before retry" )
    else
        YW( "Waiting for the previous purchase confirmation; no duplicate request" )
    end
end
end
local function nO( g, P ) if not P then
    return true
end
if g.speedMeasured ~= P.speedMeasured then
    return g.speedMeasured == true
end
if g.speed ~= P.speed then
    return g.speed > P.speed
end
return( g.price or 0 ) > ( P.price or 0 )
end
function nW.Tick( IB ) if gH then
    return
end
IB = YQ( IB ) iw, dV = na.pending, na.busy ~= nil local x = table.concat( { tostring( Hp.Paused == true or Hp.paused == true ), tostring( Hp.AutoBuyBikes ), tostring( Hp.RideBestBike ), tostring( Hp.AutoUpgrade ), tostring( Hp.AutoBuyEventItems ), tostring( Hp.BikeBuyMode ), Lk( Hp.SelectedBikes ), Lk( Hp.SelectedUpgrades ), tostring( Hp.SelectedEngine ), Lk( Hp.SelectedEventItems ) }, "|" ) if ek ~= x then
    ek, wa = x, wa + 1 if iw and not iw.sent then
        VT( iw )
    end
    bO = nil
end
if iw and not dV then
    ET( IB )
end
if Hp.Paused == true or Hp.paused == true then
    YW( "Paused" );
    return
end
local Qm = Hp.AutoBuyBikes == true or Hp.RideBestBike == true or Hp.AutoUpgrade == true or Hp.AutoBuyEventItems == true if not Qm then
    YW( "Off" );
    return
end
if dV then
    YW( "Waiting for the native bike request" );
    return
end
if gf( TI, "JoinLoaded" ) ~= true then
    YW( "Waiting for player inventory" );
    return
end
ET( IB ) if iw or IB < QM then
    return
end
local Ls = dk if not Ls or IB >= Dk then
    Ls = TY( IB )
end
if Hp.garageVisitActive == true then
    if Hp.AutoUpgrade == true then
        local LS, rW = rT( Ls, IB ) if not LS then
            YW( rW or "Waiting for the Garage visit to finish" )
        end
    else
        YW( "Waiting for the Garage visit to finish" )
    end
    return
end
local cT = Fk() if Hp.RideBestBike == true and not cT then
    local oS for Fp, wJ in ipairs( Ls.bikes ) do
        if WT( wJ ) and nO( wJ, oS ) then
            oS = wJ
        end
    end
    if oS then
        if gf( TI, "SelectedBike" ) ~= oS.id then
            fg( "select", oS, IB );
            return
        end
        local nB, Wf = mT() local MT = XW( GW( "Garage" ), "Enabled" ) == true if not MT and not Hp.SeatRecoveryActive and( not w( Hp.ManualDismountUntil ) or IB >= Hp.ManualDismountUntil ) and nB and w( XW( nB, "Health" ) ) and nB.Health > 0 and Wf == nil then
            fg( "spawn", oS, IB );
            return
        end
    end
end
local kT if Hp.AutoBuyBikes == true then
    if Hp.BikeBuyMode ~= "Auto" and Hp.BikeBuyMode ~= "Selected" then
        YW( "Choose Auto or Selected bike purchasing mode" );
        return
    end
    local kg, oS = gf( TI, "Cash" ), nil if not w( kg ) or kg < 0 then
        YW( "Waiting for the Cash balance" );
        return
    end
    for Fp, wJ in ipairs( Ls.bikes ) do
        local rX = Hp.BikeBuyMode == "Auto" or Ph( Hp.SelectedBikes, wJ.id ) if rX and wJ.purchasable and not WT( wJ ) and wJ.price <= kg and( not wJ.luxury or gf( TI, "LuxuryPass" ) == true ) and nO( wJ, oS ) then
            oS = wJ
        end
    end
    if oS then
        fg( "buy", oS, IB );
        return
    end
    kT = Hp.BikeBuyMode == "Selected" and "Waiting for an affordable selected bike" or "Waiting for an affordable unowned bike"
end
if Hp.AutoUpgrade == true then
    local LS, rW = rT( Ls, IB ) if LS then
        return
    end
    kT = rW or kT
end
if Hp.AutoBuyEventItems == true and not cT then
    local LS, rW = QT( Ls, IB ) if LS then
        return
    end
    kT = rW or kT
end
if kT then
    YW( kT )
elseif cT and( Hp.RideBestBike == true or Hp.AutoBuyEventItems == true ) then
    YW( "Waiting for the race to finish before changing bike or opening the shop" )
elseif not bO then
    YW( "Best owned bike selected" )
end
end
function nW.Stop() if gH then
    return
end
if iw and not iw.sent then
    VT( iw )
end
if na.owner == sR then
    na.owner = nil
end
gH, wa = true, wa + 1 Hp.ShopStatus = "Stopped"
end
return nW
end
return vk
end

local TT = ( function() local TT = {} local function w( H ) return type( H ) == "number" and H == H and math.abs( H ) < math.huge
end
local function bK( rm, x ) local u, H = pcall( function() return rm[ x ]
end
) if u then
    return H
end
end
local function dm( rm, Cp, ... ) local Iw = bK( rm, Cp ) if type( Iw ) ~= "function" then
    return nil
end

    return H
end
end

end

end

end
function TT.Create( C ) C = C or {} local Hp, TI, ZI = C.state or {}, C.player, C.workspace local Xf, IT = C.vehicle or {}, C.shop or {} local kX = C.clock or os.clock local gH, zT, CA, Hy, GT, jT = false, nil, 0, nil, false, false local iT local nW = {} Hp.CoordinationStatus = "Garage coordination ready" local function YQ( H ) if w( H ) then
    return H

end

    return nil
end

    return H
end
end
local function vT( IB ) return pK( TI, "InRace" ) == true or pK( TI, "RaceHold" ) == true or Hp.RaceHold == true or( w( Hp.raceJoinPendingUntil ) and IB < Hp.raceJoinPendingUntil )

    return Lb

    return nil
end
local mf, Kt, uT = { Dc }, 1, 0 while Kt <= # mf and uT < 512 do
    local rm = mf[ Kt ];
    Kt = Kt + 1;
    uT = uT + 1 if bK( rm, "Name" ) == "GarageZone" and pX( rm, "BasePart" ) and nK( bK( rm, "Position" ) ) then
        return rm
    end
    local QX = dm( rm, "GetChildren" ) if type( QX ) == "table" then
        for Fp, c in ipairs( QX ) do
            if # mf >= 512 then
                break
            end
            mf[ # mf + 1 ] = c
        end
    end
end
end

Hp.CoordinationStatus = ha

    ZT( IB ) if zT.phase == "opening" and LT() and not MT() then
        iT = { character = zT.character, bike = zT.bike, expires = IB + 2 }
    end

xr( IB, ha )

local function FT( IB, ha ) if not zT then
    return
end
if zT.phase == "opening" and not MT() then
    zT.awaitEntryUntil = math.min( zT.startedAt + 8, IB + 2 )
end
zT.phase, zT.closeAt, zT.message = "closing", IB, ha Hp.CoordinationStatus = "Closing native Garage" ZT( IB )
end
local function A( IB ) if not LT() then
    cK( IB, "Garage visit cancelled: bike or character changed" );
    return
end
if Hp.paused then
    cK( IB, "Garage visit paused; farming can resume after unpausing" );
    return
end
if vT( IB ) then
    cK( IB, "Garage visit cancelled for the active race" );
    return
end
if Hp.AutoUpgrade ~= true and zT.phase ~= "closing" and zT.phase ~= "settling" then
    FT( IB, "Garage visit cancelled; farming resumed" )
end
if zT.phase == "opening" then
    if MT() then
        zT.phase = "servicing" Hp.CoordinationStatus = "Upgrading in native Garage; rewards remain active"
    elseif IB - zT.startedAt >= 8 then
        FT( IB, "Garage did not open; farming resumed" )
    end
elseif zT.phase == "servicing" then
    if not MT() then
        FT( IB, "Garage closed; farming resumed" )
    elseif IB - zT.startedAt >= 20 then
        FT( IB, "Garage visit limit reached; farming resumed" )
    elseif not JT() then
        FT( IB, "Garage jobs complete or waiting for funds; farming resumed" )
    end
end
if not zT then
    return
end
if zT.phase == "closing" then
    if not MT() and( not zT.awaitEntryUntil or IB >= zT.awaitEntryUntil ) then
        zT.phase, zT.settleAt = "settling", IB + 0.5
    elseif IB - zT.closeAt >= 4 then
        xr( IB, "Native Garage did not close; close it manually to ride" )
    else
        ZT( IB )
    end
elseif zT.phase == "settling" then
    if MT() then
        if IB - zT.closeAt >= 4 then
            xr( IB, "Native Garage reopened; close it manually to ride" )
        else
            zT.phase = "closing";
            ZT( IB )
        end
    elseif IB >= zT.settleAt then
        local ha = zT.message or "Garage visit complete; farming resumed" if zT.returnPosition then
            local vt = Zm( Xf, "Teleport", zT.returnPosition, zT.returnYaw ) if vt ~= true then
                ha = "Garage closed; return travel failed, farming resumed"
            end

local function Tr( h ) if type( h ) == "string" then
    return h, h
end

    local aR = h.id or h.name or h.label if type( aR ) == "string" or type( aR ) == "number" then
        return aR, tostring( h.label or h.name or aR )
    end
end
end

end

end

end

local function w( H ) return type( H ) == "number" and H == H and math.abs( H ) < math.huge
end
local function ln( H ) if not w( H ) then
    return "-"
end
for Fp, h in ipairs( { { 1000000000000, "T" }, { 1000000000, "B" }, { 1000000, "M" }, { 1000, "K" } } ) do
    if math.abs( H ) >= h[ 1 ] then
        return string.format( "%.1f", H / h[ 1 ] ):gsub( "%.0$", "" ) .. h[ 2 ]
    end
end
return tostring( math.floor( H ) )
end

function iB.Validate( x, H ) if GP[ x ] or tG[ x ] then
    if type( H ) == "boolean" then
        return H
    end
    ;
    return nil
end
if x == "theme" then
    return type( H ) == "string" and vB[ H ] and H or nil
end
if x == "activeTab" then
    return type( H ) == "string" and Kq[ H ] and H or nil
end
if x == "customAccent" then
    return type( H ) == "string" and H:match( "^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$" ) and H:upper() or nil
end
if x == "TargetMode" then
    return( H == "Nearest" or H == "Lowest health" ) and H or nil
end
if x == "FarmMode" then
    return( H == "Teleport follow" or H == "Legit aim" ) and H or nil
end
if x == "ESPHighlight" then
    return( H == "Outline" or H == "Fill + Outline" or H == "Off" ) and H or nil
end
if x == "SelectedHero" then
    if H == "All affordable" then
        return H
    end
    if type( H ) == "string" and # H > 0 and # H <= 64 and H:match( "^[%w_%- ]+$" ) and H:match( "%S" ) then
        return H
    end
    return nil
end
local iS = xy[ x ] if iS and w( H ) then
    return math.floor( math.max( iS[ 1 ], math.min( iS[ 2 ], H ) ) * 100 + .5 ) / 100
end
end

    return false, "File reading is unavailable."
end

    return false, "No saved preferences."
end
local yW, fW = pcall( function() return Ey:JSONDecode( tW )
end
) if not yW or type( fW ) ~= "table" or fW.version ~= 1 or type( fW.settings ) ~= "table" then
    return false, "Saved preferences could not be read."
end
for Fp, x in ipairs( Jy ) do
    local H = iB.Validate( x, fW.settings[ x ] ) if H ~= nil then
        Hp[ x ] = H
    end
end
return true, "Preferences loaded."
end
function ER.Save( Hp ) if type( Hp ) ~= "table" then
    return false, "Preferences state is unavailable."
end
if type( RR ) ~= "function" then
    return false, "File writing is unavailable in this executor."
end
local oB = {} for Fp, x in ipairs( Jy ) do
    local H = iB.Validate( x, Hp[ x ] ) if H ~= nil then
        oB[ x ] = H
    end
end
local cy, tW = pcall( function() return Ey:JSONEncode( { version = 1, settings = oB } )
end
) if not cy or type( tW ) ~= "string" or # tW > 32768 then
    return false, "Could not encode preferences."
end
local u, iR = pcall( RR, iB.Path, tW ) if not u or iR == false then
    return false, "Could not save preferences."
end
return true, "Preferences saved on this device."
end
return ER
end
return iB
end

local function w( H ) return type( H ) == "number" and H == H and math.abs( H ) < math.huge
end
local function ln( H ) if not w( H ) then
    return "-"
end
for Fp, h in ipairs( { { 1000000000000, "T" }, { 1000000000, "B" }, { 1000000, "M" }, { 1000, "K" } } ) do
    if math.abs( H ) >= h[ 1 ] then
        return string.format( "%.1f", H / h[ 1 ] ):gsub( "%.0$", "" ) .. h[ 2 ]
    end
end
return tostring( math.floor( H ) )
end

local function Tr( h ) if type( h ) == "string" then
    return h, h
end

        return aR, tostring( h.label or h.name or aR )
    end
end
end

if Gr == "highlightModes" then

    return vi
end
return( Hp.lists or {} )[ Gr ]
end

    return "-"

    end
end
return tostring( math.floor( H ) )
end

local function w( H ) return type( H ) == "number" and H == H and math.abs( H ) < math.huge
end
local function ln( H ) if not w( H ) then
    return "-"
end
for Fp, h in ipairs( { { 1000000000000, "T" }, { 1000000000, "B" }, { 1000000, "M" }, { 1000, "K" } } ) do
    if math.abs( H ) >= h[ 1 ] then
        return string.format( "%.1f", H / h[ 1 ] ):gsub( "%.0$", "" ) .. h[ 2 ]
    end
end
return tostring( math.floor( H ) )
end

local
function nv( r )

    if mp > 128 then
        break
    end

        NS[ T.id ] = true
        local h = { id = T.id, name = Zi( T.name, T.id ), cost = w( T.cost ) and T.cost >= 0 and T.cost or nil, currency = type( T.currency ) == "string" and T.currency or nil, available = T.available == true, paid = T.paid == true, groupRequired = T.groupRequired == true, devOnly = T.devOnly == true, progressAction = T.progressAction, automaticUnlock = T.automaticUnlock == true }
        if type( T.owned ) == "boolean" then
            h.owned = T.owned
        end
        iR[ # iR + 1 ] = h
    end
end
return iR
end

    Hp.sessionDefeats = Ov

local
function Qv( cs, IB, yR )
if not Hp.AutoBuyHeroes then
    Hp.heroesStatus = "Off" Hp.heroesDetail = "Earn Hits to unlock abilities. Enable progression to equip the highest unlocked ability or your selection."
    return
end
if Hp.paused then
    Hp.heroesStatus = "Paused";
    Hp.heroesDetail = "Ability progression resumes when you unpause.";
    return
end
if cs.pendingHero then
    Hp.heroesStatus = "Equip requested" Hp.heroesDetail = "Waiting for the game to confirm " .. yv( cs.pendingHero ) .. "."
    return
end
if cs.progressReady ~= true or cs.equipReady ~= true then
    Hp.heroesStatus = "Waiting for ability data";
    Hp.heroesDetail = "Refresh abilities after the game finishes loading.";
    return
end
if Bv then
    Hp.heroesStatus = "Ability unlocked";
    Hp.heroesDetail = yv( Bv ) .. ": ownership confirmed." Bv = nil;
    av = math.max( av, IB + 2 );
    return
end
local Ph = Hp.SelectedHero or "All affordable"
local gv, xS
for Fp, T in ipairs( Hp.heroes ) do
    if T.id == Ph then
        gv = T
    end
    if Ph == "All affordable" and T.owned == true and T.available == true and not T.paid and w( T.cost ) and( not xS or T.cost > xS.cost ) then
        xS = T
    end
end
if Ph ~= "All affordable" and gv and gv.owned == true and gv.available == true then
    xS = gv
end
if xS and xS.id == cs.CurrentAbility then
    Hp.heroesStatus = "Equipped";
    Hp.heroesDetail = xS.name .. " is equipped. Earn Hits to unlock more abilities.";
    return
end
if not xS then
    if gv and gv.owned ~= true and gv.groupRequired then
        Hp.heroesStatus = "Group requirement";
        Hp.heroesDetail = "The game has not confirmed the group requirement for " .. gv.name .. "."
    elseif gv and gv.owned ~= true and gv.paid then
        Hp.heroesStatus = "Ability locked";
        Hp.heroesDetail = gv.name .. " is not confirmed as owned."
    elseif gv and gv.owned ~= true then
        Hp.heroesStatus = "Earning Hits";
        Hp.heroesDetail = gv.name .. " is waiting for its native unlock requirements."
    elseif cs.nextUnlock then
        Hp.heroesStatus = "Earning Hits";
        Hp.heroesDetail = tostring( math.ceil( cs.nextUnlock.remaining or 0 ) ) .. " Hits until the next ability unlock."
    else
        Hp.heroesStatus = "Waiting";
        Hp.heroesDetail = "No unlocked ability change is available."
    end
    return
end
if IB < av or IB < ( mv[ xS.id ] or 0 ) then
    Hp.heroesStatus = "Waiting";
    Hp.heroesDetail = "Waiting between ability progression checks.";
    return
end
if not Pa( yR ) or Hp.paused or not Hp.AutoBuyHeroes then
    return
end
av = IB + 2
local u, UH, rW = pcall( mH.TryProgress, xS.id )
if not Pa( yR ) then
    return
end
if u and UH == true then
    Hp.heroesStatus = "Equip requested";
    Hp.heroesDetail = "Waiting for the game to confirm " .. xS.name .. "."
else
    if rW ~= "equip-pending" and rW ~= "purchase-cooldown" then
        mv[ xS.id ] = IB + 10
    end
    Hp.heroesStatus = "Waiting for ability update" Hp.heroesDetail = "The game has not accepted a new ability change yet."
end
Fz = - math.huge
end

function ER.Plan( mK ) local AO, up, Fu = mK.active, mK.data, mK.exercises local du, bV = Ts( "util" ), mK.weights if not AO or not up or not du or not bV or not Fu or not Fu[ AO.Exercise ] or not w( mK.maxStamina ) or mK.maxStamina <= 0 then
    return nil, "Waiting for exercise data.", "pending"
end
local yu = Fu[ AO.Exercise ] local u, Us = pcall( du.GetWeightedAverageStrength, up, yu.Muscles, AO.MachineConfig.Difficulty ) if not u or not w( Us ) or Us <= 0 then
    return nil, "Lift strength unavailable.", "pending"
end
local Go = Us if yu.Type == "Calisthenics" then
    local BL, hI = pcall( du.GetBaseStrength, up, yu.Muscles, AO.MachineConfig.Difficulty ) if not BL or not w( hI ) then
        return nil, "Bodyweight strength unavailable.", "pending"
    end
    Go = math.min( Go, hI )
elseif yu.Type == "Dumbbells" then
    Go = Go / 2
end

    local sC = type( mL.MaxWeight ) == "function" and mL.MaxWeight( up ) if not w( sC ) or sC <= 0 then
        return nil, "Waiting for the equipped bar limit.", "pending"

        local oG, H = pcall( bV.IsPlateUnlocked, up, aR ) if oG and H == true and type( h ) == "table" then
            ko[ aR ] = h.Weight
        end
    end
    YI = C.Planner.Plates( ko, yu.PlateLimit or 0, AO.MachineConfig.BarWeight or 0, yu.WeightLocation == "Barbell", Go )

    local Vw, XQ = pcall( bV.GetStack, AO.Exercise ) if Vw and type( XQ ) == "table" then
        for aR, s in pairs( XQ ) do
            YI[ # YI + 1 ] = { id = aR, weight = s }
        end
    end
elseif yu.WeightType == "Dumbbells" then
    for aR, h in pairs( bV.Dumbbells or {} ) do

        end

end

    XL = XL + 1
end
return H
end
} ) if iR then
    iR.kind = yu.WeightType
end
if iR then
    return iR
end
if Nv > 0 and XL == 0 then
    return nil, "Waiting for weight calculations.", "pending"
end
return nil, "No liftable weight found. Gain strength or choose another exercise.", "unliftable"
end

if ks() ~= AO or ER.IsRepBusy( AO ) then
    return false
end
local function SH() if ks() ~= AO or ER.IsRepBusy( AO ) then
    return false
end
local mL, up = Ts( "bars" ), fW() if mL and type( mL.UsesBar ) == "function" and mL.UsesBar( AO.Exercise ) then
    local sC = up and type( mL.MaxWeight ) == "function" and mL.MaxWeight( up ) if not w( sC ) or not w( DO.weight ) or DO.weight > sC then
        return false
    end
end
return ks() == AO and not ER.IsRepBusy( AO )
end
if DO.kind == "Plates" and type( DO.plates ) == "table" then
    return Du( "AutoTrain", SH, "ExerciseEvent", "LoadWeight", { TotalWeight = DO.weight, Weights = DO.plates } )
elseif DO.kind == "WeightStack" and DO.id ~= nil then
    return Du( "AutoTrain", SH, "ExerciseEvent", "AddPlate", DO.id )
elseif DO.kind == "Dumbbells" and DO.id ~= nil then
    return Du( "AutoTrain", SH, "DumbbellEvent", "Pickup", DO.id )
end
return false
end
function ER.QuestWeight( mK ) local AO = mK.active;
local yu = AO and mK.exercises and mK.exercises[ AO.Exercise ] if not yu then
    return nil, "Waiting for exercise weight data."
end
if yu.WeightType == "Plates" then
    return { ready = true }
end
if yu.Type == "Treadmill" then
    return { ready = true }
end
if not w( mK.weight ) then
    return nil, "Waiting for current machine weight."
end
local bV = mK.weights;
local oS if bV and yu.WeightType == "WeightStack" and type( bV.GetStack ) == "function" then
    local XQ = bV.GetStack( AO.Exercise ) if type( XQ ) == "table" then
        for aR, s in pairs( XQ ) do
            if w( s ) and s >= 0 and( not oS or s < oS.weight ) then
                oS = { kind = "WeightStack", id = aR, weight = s }
            end
        end
    end
elseif bV and yu.WeightType == "Dumbbells" then
    for aR, h in pairs( bV.Dumbbells or {} ) do
        if type( h ) == "table" and w( h.Weight ) and h.Weight >= 0 and( not oS or h.Weight < oS.weight ) then
            oS = { kind = "Dumbbells", id = aR, weight = h.Weight }
        end
    end
else
    return { ready = true }
end
if not oS then
    return nil, "Waiting for the minimum native weight."
end
if mK.weight <= oS.weight + .001 then
    return { ready = true }
end
return oS
end
function ER.SetQuestWeight( mK, DO, gN, ju ) local yR = wa;
local SL = Ts( "network" );
local AO = mK.active if not AO or not DO or not SL or type( SL.FireServer ) ~= "function" or not Pa( yR, "AutoQuest" ) or ks() ~= AO or ER.IsRepBusy( AO ) or not ER.QuestMatches( gN ) then
    return false
end
local fJ = ER.Snapshot();
local KL = ER.QuestWeight( fJ ) if not KL or KL.ready or KL.kind ~= DO.kind or KL.id ~= DO.id or KL.weight ~= DO.weight or fJ.active ~= AO or not Pa( yR, "AutoQuest" ) or not ER.QuestMatches( gN ) then
    return false
end
if ju then
    ju()
end
if DO.kind == "WeightStack" then
    pcall( SL.FireServer, "ExerciseEvent", "AddPlate", DO.id )
elseif DO.kind == "Dumbbells" then
    pcall( SL.FireServer, "DumbbellEvent", "Pickup", DO.id )
else
    return false
end
return true
end

end
