function ER.CleanupTargets() local iR = {} for Fp, OC in ipairs( { "gym", "oldgym", "2ndgengym" } ) do
    local im = Fm( C.workspace, OC .. ".trash" ) for dR, rm in ipairs( QX( im ) ) do
        if dR > 100 then
            break
        end
        local Cp = bK( rm, "Name" ) if jv( rm, "BasePart" ) and( Cp == "Puddle" or Cp == "Random Trash" ) then
            local OQ = Fm( rm, "ProximityPrompt" ) if jv( OQ, "ProximityPrompt" ) and bK( OQ, "ActionText" ) == "Clean" then
                iR[ # iR + 1 ] = { object = rm, prompt = OQ, puddle = Cp == "Puddle", gym = OC }
            end
        end
    end
end
return iR
end
function ER.Clean( qS ) if type( qS ) ~= "table" or not qS.object then
    return false
end
ER.StopMovement() local yR = wa;
local DV, SB = Sp();
local OQ = qS and qS.prompt if Nu then
    return false, "A cleanup interaction is already held."
end
local ec, PS = bK( OQ, "HoldDuration" ), bK( OQ, "MaxActivationDistance" ) if not w( ec ) or ec < 0 or ec > 10 or not w( PS ) or PS <= 0 then
    return false
end
local function pw() local VL, Hb = Sp() if not Pa( yR, "AutoClean" ) or not DV or VL ~= DV or Hb ~= SB or Fm( DV, "_Exercise" ) or ks() or not bK( qS.object, "Parent" ) or bK( OQ, "Parent" ) ~= qS.object or bK( OQ, "Enabled" ) ~= true or bK( OQ, "ActionText" ) ~= "Clean" or bK( OQ, "HoldDuration" ) ~= ec then
    return false
end
local u, kH = pcall( function() return( SB.Position - qS.object.Position ).Magnitude <= PS
end
) return u and kH
end
if not pw() or not ra or type( ra.wait ) ~= "function" then
    return false, "Clean interaction is not ready."
end
local qL = { prompt = OQ, triggered = false } Nu = qL local CR = bK( OQ, "Triggered" ) local Xu, uR = pcall( function() return CR:Connect( function( ov ) if not qL.released and( ov == nil or ov == C.player ) then
    qL.triggered = true
end
end
)
end
) if Xu then
    qL.connection = uR
end
if not Xu or not uR or not pw() or Nu ~= qL then
    ou( qL );
    return false, "Clean prompt observation is unavailable."
end
local wy = false if type( bK( OQ, "InputHoldBegin" ) ) == "function" and type( bK( OQ, "InputHoldEnd" ) ) == "function" then
    qL.holding = true local u, iR = pcall( OQ.InputHoldBegin, OQ ) wy = u and iR ~= false
elseif type( C.fireproximityprompt ) == "function" then
    local u, iR = pcall( C.fireproximityprompt, OQ, ec ) wy = u and iR ~= false
end
if not wy then
    ou( qL );
    return false, "Clean input could not start."
end
local LS = kX() local YL, hL = 0, true while Pa( yR, "AutoClean" ) and Nu == qL and pw() and not qL.triggered and kX() - LS < ec + .15 and YL < ec + .2 do
    local hs = math.min( .05, ec + .2 - YL ) local u = pcall( ra.wait, hs ) YL = YL + hs if not u then
        hL = false;
        break
    end
end
local dT = qL.triggered or bK( qS.object, "Parent" ) == nil ou( qL ) if dT then
    return true
end
if not Pa( yR, "AutoClean" ) then
    return false, "Cleanup canceled."
end
if not hL then
    return false, "Clean input was interrupted."
end
return false, "Clean did not activate. Waiting before another attempt."
end
function ER.ItemCount( aR ) local tL = 0 for Fp, Cp in ipairs( { "Backpack", "Character" } ) do
    local NI if Cp == "Backpack" then
        NI = Fm( C.player, "Backpack" )
    else
        NI = bK( C.player, "Character" )
    end
    for Fp, rm in ipairs( QX( NI ) ) do
        if jv( rm, "Tool" ) and bK( rm, "Name" ) == aR then
            local BK = gf( rm, "Count" );
            tL = tL + ( w( BK ) and math.max( 0, BK ) or 1 )
        end
    end
end
return tL
end

function ER.QuestState( mK, ta ) local yR = wa local rL = ta == "halloween" if not rL and ta ~= "daily" then
    return {}
end
local CL = Ts( rL and "halloween" or "quests" ) local up = mK.data;
local iR = { ready = {}, claimed = {} } local vl = up and up.Data[ rL and "HalloweenQuests" or "DailyQuests" ] if not CL or type( vl ) ~= "table" or type( vl.Progress ) ~= "table" or type( vl.Claimed ) ~= "table" then
    return iR
end
local hu, TQ if rL then
    local nL = Ts( "events" ) if not nL or type( nL.IsActive ) ~= "function" or type( CL.GetPeriod ) ~= "function" then
        return iR
    end
    local u, ks = pcall( nL.IsActive, "Halloween" ) local Yo, H = pcall( CL.GetPeriod ) if not u or ks ~= true or not Yo or not w( H ) or vl.Period ~= H then
        return iR
    end
    TQ = H;
    hu = CL.Quests
else
    if type( CL.GetQuests ) ~= "function" or type( CL.GetDay ) ~= "function" then
        return iR
    end
    local Yo, H = pcall( CL.GetDay ) local u, Ls = pcall( CL.GetQuests, up ) if not Yo or not w( H ) or not u then
        return iR
    end
    if vl.Day ~= nil and vl.Day ~= H then
        return iR
    end
    TQ = H;
    hu = Ls
end
if type( hu ) ~= "table" or not Pa( yR ) then
    return iR
end
iR.stamp = TQ local NS, BK = {}, 0 for Fp, gN in pairs( hu ) do
    BK = BK + 1;
    if BK > 64 then
        break
    end
    if type( gN ) == "table" and type( gN.Id ) == "string" and # gN.Id <= 96 and w( gN.Goal ) and gN.Goal > 0 and not NS[ gN.Id ] then
        local aR = gN.Id;
        NS[ aR ] = true if vl.Claimed[ aR ] == true then
            iR.claimed[ aR ] = true
        elseif w( vl.Progress[ aR ] ) and vl.Progress[ aR ] >= gN.Goal then
            iR.ready[ # iR.ready + 1 ] = aR
        end
    end
end
table.sort( iR.ready ) return Pa( yR ) and iR or {}
end

function ER.ProgressionSnapshot() local yR = wa;
local up = fW();
local yL, mL = Ts( "genes" ), Ts( "bars" ) local Il = { byId = {}, choices = {}, data = up, barsReady = false, genesReady = false } if not up then
    return Il
end
local tW = up.Data.Genes if yL and type( yL.ById ) == "table" then
    Il.byId = yL.ById for aR, h in pairs( yL.ById ) do
        if type( aR ) == "string" and type( h ) == "table" and type( h.Name ) == "string" and w( h.Order ) then
            Il.choices[ # Il.choices + 1 ] = { id = aR, label = h.Name .. " (" .. tostring( h.Rarity or "Gene" ) .. ")", order = h.Order }
        end
    end
    table.sort( Il.choices, function( g, P ) if g.order ~= P.order then
        return g.order < P.order
    end
    ;
    return g.id < P.id
end
) if type( tW ) == "table" and type( tW.Slots ) == "table" and type( tW.Locked ) == "table" and w( tW.Selected ) and tW.Selected % 1 == 0 and tW.Selected >= 1 and tW.Selected <= ( yL.SLOT_COUNT or 3 ) and w( tW.Rolls ) and tW.Rolls >= 0 and w( tW.PaidRolls ) and tW.PaidRolls >= 0 then
    Il.slot = tW.Selected;
    Il.slots = {};
    for dR = 1, yL.SLOT_COUNT or 3 do
        Il.slots[ dR ] = tW.Slots[ dR ]
    end
    Il.gene = tW.Slots[ Il.slot ];
    Il.geneName = yL.ById[ Il.gene ] and yL.ById[ Il.gene ].Name or "Empty slot" Il.rolls = tW.Rolls + tW.PaidRolls;
    Il.locked = tW.Locked[ Il.slot ] ~= false Il.open = type( yL.SlotOpen ) == "function" and yL.SlotOpen( up, Il.slot ) == true Il.genesReady = type( Il.gene ) == "string"
end
end
if mL and type( mL.Bars ) == "table" and type( up.Data.Bars ) == "table" then
    Il.barsReady = true;
    Il.equippedBar = up.Data.EquippedBar Il.barName = mL.Bars[ Il.equippedBar ] and mL.Bars[ Il.equippedBar ].Name or "Standard Bar" for aR, h in pairs( mL.Bars ) do
        if up.Data.Bars[ aR ] == true and type( h ) == "table" and w( h.Order ) and type( h.Name ) == "string" and( not Il.bestBar or h.Order > Il.bestBar.order or h.Order == Il.bestBar.order and aR < Il.bestBar.id ) then
            Il.bestBar = { id = aR, name = h.Name, order = h.Order }
        end
    end
end
Il.repBusy = ER.IsRepBusy( ks() );
return Pa( yR ) and Il or nil
end

function ER.BarOffers( mK ) local mL = Ts( "bars" );

    if up.Data.Bars[ aR ] == true and type( h ) == "table" and w( h.Order ) then
        fL = math.max( fL, h.Order )
    end
end
for aR, h in pairs( mL.Bars ) do
    if type( aR ) == "string" and type( h ) == "table" and w( h.Order ) and h.Order > fL and w( h.Price ) and h.Price > 0 and not h.Currency and up.Data.Bars[ aR ] ~= true and type( mL.Unlocked ) == "function" and mL.Unlocked( up, aR ) == true then
        iR[ # iR + 1 ] = { kind = "bar", id = aR, name = h.Name or aR, price = h.Price, order = h.Order }
    end
end
return iR
end

local gL = ( function() local PL = {} local function w( WV ) return type( WV ) == "number" and WV == WV and math.abs( WV ) < math.huge
end

end
) return u and w( H ) and H or math.huge
end
function PL.Create( C ) local Hp, jn = C.state, C.native local kX = C.clock or os.clock local n, wa = true, 0 local Xw, Fz = {}, - math.huge local xL = C.cashLedger or {} local lu, EL, cL, ML, kL ML = xL.request local TL, bP, zL = nil, false, 0 local GL, jL = nil, nil local iL, vL, NL, oL = - math.huge, - math.huge, - math.huge, - math.huge local DO, uL local LL, eL, DL, ZL = {}, xL.blocked or {}, {}, {} xL.blocked = eL local dL = xL.committed or 0 local FL = { round = 1, sets = 0, blocked = {} } local ua = {} local pe local Re = "" local function Pa( yR ) return n and wa == yR and( not C.isCurrent or C.isCurrent() )
end
local function YW( x, QR, VK ) Hp[ x .. "Status" ] = QR;
Hp[ x .. "Detail" ] = VK if x == "training" then
    Re = VK
end
end
local function Qm( x ) return n and not Hp.paused and Hp[ x ] == true
end
local Ve = C.Quests and C.Quests.Create( { state = Hp, native = jn, Planner = C.QuestPlanner, isCurrent = function() return Pa( wa )
end
, clock = kX, ownsExercise = function( AO ) return TL == AO
end
, onOwned = function( AO ) TL = AO
end
} ) local function cw( VB, zP, T ) if jn.MoveTo then
    return jn.MoveTo( VB, zP, T )
end
return jn.Teleport( VB, zP, T )
end
local function We() return Hp.TrainingMode == "Circuit training"
end
local function ae() return Hp.TrainingMode == "Muscle target"
end
local function Se( h, mK ) local yu = mK.exercises and mK.exercises[ h.id ] return h.id ~= "Chest Press" and h.id ~= "Hammer Curls" and h.id ~= "Treadmill" and h.id ~= "Seated Bicep Curl" and h.id ~= "PullUp" and h.name ~= "Chest Press" and h.name ~= "Hammer Curls" and h.name ~= "Treadmill" and h.name ~= "Seated Bicep Curl" and h.name ~= "Pull-Ups" and not( yu and yu.Type == "Treadmill" )
end
local function Oe( h, IB ) return JL( h.model ) and IB >= ( ZL[ h.model ] or - math.huge ) and jn.MachineStatus( h ) == "free"
end
local function Ie( mK, IB ) if not FL.gym then
    if Hp.SelectedGym ~= "Nearest" then
        FL.gym = Hp.SelectedGym
    else
        local oS for Fp, h in ipairs( Xw ) do
            if JL( h.model ) and Se( h, mK ) then
                local up = PS( mK.root, h.config.TeleportPart ) if not oS or up < oS then
                    oS = up;
                    FL.gym = h.gym
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
local iR, NS = {}, {} for Fp, h in ipairs( Xw ) do
    if h.gym == FL.gym and Se( h, mK ) and Oe( h, IB ) and not NS[ h.id ] and IB >= ( FL.blocked[ h.id ] or - math.huge ) then
        NS[ h.id ] = true;
        iR[ # iR + 1 ] = h
    end
end
table.sort( iR, function( g, P ) if g.name == P.name then
    return g.id < P.id
end
;
return tostring( g.name ) < tostring( P.name )
end
) return iR
end
local function Be( me, Ja ) if # me == 0 then
    FL.id = nil;
    return
end
local mp = 1 local Xe for Fp, h in ipairs( Xw ) do
    if h.id == Ja then
        Xe = h.name;
        break
    end
end
if Xe then
    local gw for dR, T in ipairs( me ) do
        if tostring( T.name ) > tostring( Xe ) or( T.name == Xe and T.id > Ja ) then
            gw = dR;
            break
        end
    end
    if gw then
        mp = gw
    else
        FL.round = FL.round + 1
    end
end
FL.id = me[ mp ].id
end
local function Ke( mK, IB ) if IB - Fz < 5 then
    return
end
Fz = IB;
Xw = jn.Catalog( mK ) local YI, NS = {}, {} for Fp, h in ipairs( Xw ) do
    if not NS[ h.id ] then
        NS[ h.id ] = true;
        YI[ # YI + 1 ] = { id = h.id, name = h.name }
    end
end
table.sort( YI, function( g, P ) return tostring( g.name ) < tostring( P.name )
end
) Hp.lists.exercises = YI local UL = { "Equipment" } for aR, h in pairs( mK.items and mK.items.Items or {} ) do
    if type( aR ) == "string" and type( h ) == "table" and w( h.Price ) and not h.Currency then
        UL[ # UL + 1 ] = aR
    end
end
table.sort( UL );
Hp.lists.items = UL
end
local function be( mK, IB ) Hp.cash, Hp.stamina, Hp.maxStamina = mK.cash, mK.stamina, mK.maxStamina Hp.weight = mK.weight local ks = mK.active if ks and w( mK.reps ) then
    if ks == GL and jL and mK.reps >= jL then
        Hp.sessionReps = Hp.sessionReps + mK.reps - jL
    end
    GL, jL = ks, mK.reps
elseif not ks then
    GL, jL = nil, nil
end
if TL and not JL( TL.ExerciseInstance ) then
    TL = nil
end
if lu then
    if ks and ks.Model == lu.record.model and ks.Exercise == lu.record.id then
        TL = ks;
        lu = nil;
        DO = nil
    elseif IB >= lu.deadline then
        ZL[ lu.record.model ] = IB + 10 if We() then
            FL.id = nil
        end
        if ae() and not ua.entered and ua.record == lu.record then
            ua.record = nil
        end
        lu = nil;
        YW( "training", "Entry not confirmed", "The machine may be occupied or locked. Retrying after a delay." );
        vL = IB + 3
    end
end
if EL then
    if ks == EL.exercise and w( mK.weight ) and math.abs( mK.weight - EL.weight ) < .01 then
        EL = nil
    elseif ks ~= EL.exercise or IB > EL.deadline then
        EL = nil;
        DO = nil;
        iL = IB;
        vL = IB + 3 YW( "training", "Weight not confirmed", "Waiting before another attempt." )
    end
end
if cL then
    if not JL( cL.target.object ) then
        Hp.cleaned = Hp.cleaned + 1;
        zL = zL + 1;
        cL = nil
    elseif IB > cL.deadline then
        LL[ cL.target.object ] = IB + 20;
        cL = nil YW( "cleanup", "Cleanup not confirmed", "The object remains. Skipping it briefly." )
    end
end
if ML and mK.data then
    local up = mK.data.Data;
    local lA = ML local ql = ( lA.kind == "gear" and type( up.Inventory ) == "table" and up.Inventory[ lA.id ] == true ) or( lA.kind == "bar" and type( up.Bars ) == "table" and up.Bars[ lA.id ] == true ) or( lA.kind == "item" and jn.ItemCount( lA.id ) > lA.before ) or( lA.kind == "upgrade" and( jn.GearLevel( mK.data, lA.id ) or 0 ) >= lA.level ) or( lA.kind == "equip" and type( up.Equipped ) == "table" and up.Equipped[ lA.id ] == true ) if ql then
        Hp.spent = Hp.spent + lA.price;
        ML = nil;
        xL.request = nil;
        YW( "shop", "Confirmed", lA.id .. " updated by the game." ) if lA.kind == "bar" then
            YW( "barPurchase", "Purchase confirmed", lA.id .. " added to your inventory." )
        end
    elseif IB > lA.deadline then
        eL[ lA.kind .. ":" .. lA.id ] = true if lA.kind ~= "bar" then
            ML = nil;
            xL.request = nil
        else
            YW( "barPurchase", "Purchase outcome unknown", "The original request is held until inventory confirms it. No duplicate purchase." )
        end
        YW( "shop", "Purchase outcome unknown", "This offer is held for this session to prevent duplicate spending." )
    end
end
if kL then
    local qe = jn.RewardState( mK ) local ql = ( kL.kind == "daily" and qe.dailyReady == false ) or( kL.kind == "playtime" and qe.claimed and qe.claimed[ kL.id ] == true ) if kL.kind == "quest" then
        local OV = jn.QuestState( mK, kL.questKind ) ql = OV.stamp == kL.stamp and OV.claimed and OV.claimed[ kL.id ] == true
    end
    if ql then
        Hp.rewardsClaimed = Hp.rewardsClaimed + 1;
        kL = nil;
        YW( "rewards", "Claim confirmed", "Reward received by the game." )
    elseif IB > kL.deadline then
        DL[ kL.key ] = IB + 30;
        kL = nil;
        YW( "rewards", "Claim not confirmed", "Waiting before checking this reward again." )
    end
end
end
local function Ye( mK, IB, yR ) if not Qm( "AutoClean" ) then
    YW( "cleanup", "Off", "Trash and puddle cleanup is disabled." );
    return false
end
if mK.exerciseFlag or mK.active then
    YW( "cleanup", "Queued", "Waiting for training to finish the current set." );
    return false
end
if cL then
    YW( "cleanup", "Waiting for confirmation", "The game must remove the cleaned object before the next teleport." );
    return true
end
if not mK.root then
    YW( "cleanup", "Waiting for character", "Spawn before starting cleanup." );
    return true
end
local qS, oS for Fp, h in ipairs( jn.CleanupTargets() ) do
    if Pa( yR ) and JL( h.object ) and IB >= ( LL[ h.object ] or - math.huge ) and( ( h.puddle and Hp.CleanPuddles ) or( not h.puddle and Hp.CleanTrash ) ) and( Hp.SelectedGym == "Nearest" or Hp.SelectedGym == h.gym ) and( not Qm( "AutoTrain" ) or not We() or not FL.gym or h.gym == FL.gym ) then
        local up = PS( mK.root, h.object ) if not qS or up < oS then
            qS, oS = h, up
        end
    end
end
if not qS then
    YW( "cleanup", "Waiting for spawns", "No selected trash or puddles are currently streamed nearby." );
    return false
end
if not Pa( yR ) or not Qm( "AutoClean" ) then
    return false
end
if oS > 5 then
    local vt, rW = cw( qS.object, "AutoClean" ) YW( "cleanup", vt and( Hp.MovementMode == "Walk" and "Walking" or "Teleporting" ) or "Waiting", rW or( qS.puddle and "Moving to a puddle." or "Moving to trash." ) ) return true
end
cL = { target = qS, deadline = IB + 8 } local u, rW = jn.Clean( qS ) if not u then
    cL = nil if Pa( yR ) then
        LL[ qS.object ] = kX() + 3;
        YW( "cleanup", "Interaction not activated", rW or "Clean did not activate." )
    end
else
    cL.deadline = kX() + 8 if Pa( yR ) then
        YW( "cleanup", "Waiting for confirmation", "Clean activated. Waiting for the game to remove the object." )
    end
end
return true
end
local function he( mK, IB, yR ) local su = ua.leaving if not su then
    return false
end
local AO = mK.active if not AO and not mK.exerciseFlag then
    if su.advance then
        ua.muscle = nil;
        ua.record = nil;
        ua.entered = nil
    end
    ua.leaving = nil;
    bP = true;
    zL = 0;
    DO = nil;
    EL = nil return false
end
if AO == su.exercise and not jn.IsRepBusy( AO ) and IB >= su.retryAt and Pa( yR ) then
    su.retryAt = IB + 3;
    jn.Exit( AO )
end
if Pa( yR ) then
    YW( "training", "Finishing exercise", "Waiting for the game to confirm exercise exit." )
end
return true
end

    return

    return

end

local function Ue( mK, IB, yR ) local le, rW = jn.MuscleState( mK ) if not Pa( yR ) then
    return nil, nil, true
end
if not le then
    Hp.currentMuscleStrength = nil;
    YW( "training", "Waiting for strength data", rW );
    return nil, nil, true
end
local gI, dp = {}, {};
local KH = 0 for Fp, h in ipairs( le ) do
    gI[ h.id ], dp[ h.id ] = h.value, h.name if h.value >= Hp.TargetStrength then
        KH = KH + 1
    end
end
Hp.musclesAtTarget, Hp.musclesTotal = KH, # le ua.complete = false local AO = mK.active if lu and not AO then
    YW( "training", "Entering machine", "Waiting for the previous entry request before selecting a muscle." );
    return nil, nil, true
end
if ua.muscle and not w( gI[ ua.muscle ] ) then
    YW( "training", "Waiting for strength data", "The current muscle value is not available yet." );
    return nil, nil, true

    if AO then
        te( AO, true, IB, yR );
        return nil, nil, true
    end
    if mK.exerciseFlag then
        YW( "training", "Finishing exercise", "Waiting for the game's exercise marker." );
        return nil, nil, true
    end
    ua.muscle = nil;
    ua.record = nil;
    ua.entered = nil;
    DO = nil
end
if not ua.muscle then
    local se for Fp, h in ipairs( le ) do
        if h.value < Hp.TargetStrength and( not se or h.value < se.value or( h.value == se.value and h.id < se.id ) ) then
            se = h
        end
    end
    ua.muscle = se and se.id
end
if not ua.muscle then
    if AO then
        te( AO, false, IB, yR );
        return nil, nil, true
    end
    if mK.exerciseFlag then
        YW( "training", "Finishing exercise", "Waiting for exercise exit." );
        return nil, nil, true
    end
    ua.complete = true;
    ua.completedTarget = Hp.TargetStrength;
    Hp.AutoTrain = false Hp.currentMuscle = nil;
    Hp.currentMuscleName = nil;
    Hp.currentMuscleStrength = nil;
    Hp.currentExercise = nil YW( "training", "Target reached", "All " .. tostring( # le ) .. " muscle groups have reached " .. tostring( Hp.TargetStrength ) .. ". Auto training stopped." ) return nil, nil, true
end
Hp.currentMuscle = ua.muscle;
Hp.currentMuscleName = dp[ ua.muscle ];
Hp.currentMuscleStrength = gI[ ua.muscle ] local function we( h ) if not Se( h, mK ) then
    return
end
local yu = mK.exercises and mK.exercises[ h.id ] local He = yu and yu.Muscles local s = type( He ) == "table" and He[ ua.muscle ] if not w( s ) or s <= 0 then
    return
end
local tL = 0 for aR, H in pairs( He ) do
    if aR ~= "Stamina" and w( H ) and H > 0 then
        tL = tL + H
    end
end
return s / math.max( tL, s ), s * ( w( yu.GainScale ) and yu.GainScale or 1 )
end
if AO then
    local T = ua.record if not T then
        for Fp, h in ipairs( Xw ) do
            if h.model == AO.Model and h.id == AO.Exercise then
                T = h;
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if not T then
        YW( "training", "Waiting for exercise data", "Keeping the active machine while its catalog loads." );
        return nil, nil, true
    end
    if T.model ~= AO.Model or T.id ~= AO.Exercise or not we( T ) or( Hp.SelectedGym ~= "Nearest" and T.gym ~= Hp.SelectedGym ) then
        te( AO, false, IB, yR );
        return nil, nil, true
    end
    ua.record = T;
    ua.entered = true;
    TL = AO
elseif not ua.record then
    local oS, Ce, Ae, kH for Fp, h in ipairs( Xw ) do
        if JL( h.model ) and( Hp.SelectedGym == "Nearest" or h.gym == Hp.SelectedGym ) then
            local re, ne = we( h ) if re and Oe( h, IB ) then
                local up = PS( mK.root, h.config.TeleportPart ) if not oS or re > Ce or( re == Ce and( ne > Ae or( ne == Ae and up < kH ) ) ) then
                    oS, Ce, Ae, kH = h, re, ne, up
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ua.record = oS
end
if not Pa( yR ) then
    return nil, nil, true
end
if not ua.record then
    Hp.currentExercise = nil YW( "training", "Waiting for a matching machine", "No free, loaded exercise for " .. tostring( Hp.currentMuscleName ) .. " in this gym. This muscle remains selected." ) return nil, nil, true
end
Hp.currentExercise = ua.record.id return ua.record.id, ua.record, false
end
local function ye( mK, IB, yR ) local AO = mK.active if not Qm( "AutoTrain" ) then
    if ae() and ua.complete and ua.completedTarget == Hp.TargetStrength then
        YW( "training", "Target reached", "All muscle groups reached the selected strength. Increase the target and enable training to continue." )
    else
        YW( "training", "Off", "Select a machine and enable auto training." )
    end
    if AO and AO == TL and not jn.IsRepBusy( AO ) and not Hp.paused then
        jn.Exit( AO );
        return true
    end
    return false
end
if not mK.data or not mK.root then
    YW( "training", "Waiting for game data", "Spawn and finish the game's initialization." );
    return true
end
if cL then
    YW( "training", "Queued", "Finishing the current cleanup before returning to training." );
    return true

        su.advance = false

    Hp.currentMuscleName = nil;
    Hp.currentMuscleStrength = nil

    return true

    return true

    local su = FL.leaving if not mK.exerciseFlag and not AO then

            FL.sets = FL.sets + 1
        end

        FL.leaving = nil;
        FL.setRef = nil;
        FL.reps = 0;
        FL.repRequest = nil bP = true;
        zL = 0;
        DO = nil;
        EL = nil
    else
        if AO == su.exercise and not jn.IsRepBusy( AO ) and IB >= su.retryAt and Pa( yR ) then
            su.retryAt = IB + 3;
            jn.Exit( AO )
        end
        if Pa( yR ) then
            YW( "training", "Changing exercise", "Waiting for the current exercise to finish exiting." )
        end
        ;
        return true
    end
end
local Ph = Hp.SelectedExercise local Qe if ae() then
    local iA Ph, Qe, iA = Ue( mK, IB, yR ) if iA then
        return true
    end
elseif fe then
    if AO then
        local T for Fp, h in ipairs( Xw ) do
            if h.model == AO.Model and h.id == AO.Exercise then
                T = h;
                break
            end
        end
        local UE = not Se( T or { id = AO.Exercise }, mK ) if UE or( T and T.gym ~= FL.gym ) then
            if not jn.IsRepBusy( AO ) and Pa( yR ) then
                FL.leaving = { exercise = AO, id = AO.Exercise, completed = false, retryAt = IB + 3 };
                jn.Exit( AO )
            end
            if Pa( yR ) then
                YW( "training", UE and "Excluded exercise" or "Changing gym", "Leaving the current machine before continuing the circuit." )
            end
            ;
            return true
        end
        FL.id = AO.Exercise
    elseif lu then
        FL.id = lu.record.id
    else
        local Hx = false for Fp, h in ipairs( me ) do
            if h.id == FL.id then
                Hx = true;
                break
            end
        end
        if not Hx then
            Be( me, FL.id )
        end
    end
    Ph = FL.id Hp.circuitRound, Hp.circuitSets = FL.round, FL.sets Hp.currentExercise = Ph if not Ph then
        YW( "training", "Waiting for a free machine", "Eligible circuit machines are occupied, unavailable or still loading." );
        return false
    end
else
    Hp.currentExercise = Ph
end
local function ge( Pe ) if not Pa( yR ) then
    return true
end
if Pe then
    FL.blocked[ Ph ] = IB + 30
end
FL.leaving = { exercise = AO, id = Ph, completed = not Pe, retryAt = IB + 3 } jn.Exit( AO ) if Pa( yR ) then
    YW( "training", Pe and "Skipping exercise" or "Set complete", Pe and "This exercise is not liftable yet. Moving on after exit." or "Recovering before the next exercise." )
end
return true
end
if AO then
    if AO.Exercise ~= Ph then
        if AO == TL and not jn.IsRepBusy( AO ) then
            jn.Exit( AO )
        else
            YW( "training", "Different exercise active", "Finish or leave the current exercise to use the selected machine." )
        end
        return true
    end
    if fe then
        TL = AO if FL.setRef ~= AO then
            FL.setRef = AO;
            FL.reps = 0;
            FL.repRequest = nil;
            FL.planWaitSince = nil
        end
        local lA = FL.repRequest if lA then
            local Je = lA.accepted and w( lA.beforeReps ) and w( mK.reps ) and mK.reps > lA.beforeReps local Yo = lA.accepted and w( lA.serverTime ) and w( mK.lastRepAt ) and mK.lastRepAt >= lA.serverTime - .1 and( not w( lA.beforeLastRepAt ) or mK.lastRepAt > lA.beforeLastRepAt ) if Je or Yo then
                FL.reps = FL.reps + 1;
                FL.repRequest = nil
            elseif IB >= lA.deadline and not jn.IsRepBusy( AO ) then
                FL.repRequest = nil;
                vL = IB + 1 YW( "training", "Repetition not confirmed", "Retrying on this machine after a short wait." );
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    if jn.IsRepBusy( AO ) then
        YW( "training", "Training", "Waiting for the native repetition cooldown." );
        return true
    end
    if fe and FL.repRequest then
        YW( "training", "Waiting for repetition", "Waiting for the game to confirm the current repetition." );
        return true
    end
    if fe and FL.reps >= Hp.CircuitReps then
        return ge( false )
    end
    if mK.exercises and mK.exercises[ AO.Exercise ] and mK.exercises[ AO.Exercise ].Type == "Treadmill" then
        YW( "training", "Training", "The native treadmill session runs automatically." );
        return true
    end
    if EL then
        YW( "training", "Changing weight", "Waiting for server-confirmed weight." );
        return true
    end
    if Hp.AutoWeight and not Hp.AutoQuest and( uL ~= AO or( not DO and IB - iL >= 1 ) or( not fe and IB - iL >= 5 ) ) then
        DO, Hp.weightDetail, FL.planReason = jn.Plan( mK );
        uL = AO;
        iL = IB
    end
    if not Pa( yR ) then
        return true
    end
    if Hp.AutoWeight and not Hp.AutoQuest then
        if not DO then
            if fe and FL.planReason == "unliftable" then
                FL.planWaitSince = FL.planWaitSince or IB if IB - FL.planWaitSince >= 6 then
                    return ge( true )
                end
            else
                FL.planWaitSince = nil
            end
            YW( "training", "Waiting for weight data", Hp.weightDetail or "The exercise is still loading." );
            return true
        end
        FL.planWaitSince = nil;
        Hp.plannedReps = DO.reps if w( mK.weight ) and math.abs( mK.weight - DO.weight ) > .01 then
            EL = { exercise = AO, weight = DO.weight, deadline = IB + 4 } if not jn.SetWeight( AO, DO ) then
                EL = nil;
                vL = IB + 2
            end
            if Pa( yR ) then
                YW( "training", "Loading weight", tostring( DO.weight ) .. " kg; awaiting confirmation." )
            end
            ;

        end
        return false, ns and "Native training ended; waiting before retry" or ha

function ER.TryEvolve( xD ) if not al( "evolution" ) then

end

    return false, "Session unavailable"

end

    if dR > 512 then
        return nil, nil, "Enemy roster exceeded its inspection bound."
    end
    if bK( rB, "Parent" ) and gf( rB, "Stage" ) == AD and gf( rB, "Bonus" ) == nil and gf( rB, "Tower" ) == nil then

                return nil, nil, "Waiting for native enemy health."

function ER.GetCatalog() local YI = { { id = "All unlocked", name = "All unlocked worlds" }, { id = "Current world", name = "Current world" } } local NS = {};
local fZ = {} if not jH then
    return { choices = YI, worlds = fZ, stages = 0 }
end
for Fp, WV in ipairs( JZ() ) do
    local bV = yZ( WV ) if bV and not NS[ bV ] then
        NS[ bV ] = true;
        fZ[ # fZ + 1 ] = { index = bV, released = DQ( WV ) }
    end
end
table.sort( fZ, function( g, P ) return g.index < P.index
end
) for Fp, bV in ipairs( fZ ) do
    YI[ # YI + 1 ] = { id = "World " .. bV.index, name = "World " .. bV.index .. ( bV.released and "" or " (not released)" ) }
end
return { choices = YI, worlds = fZ, stages = # JZ() }
end

function ER.Stop() gH = true;

    local up = bK( uR, "Disconnect" );
    if type( up ) == "function" then
        pcall( up, uR )
    end

end
local function dZ( oB, IB ) if not Qm( oB ) then
    Qa = false;
    UZ = false;
    return SG( "Off", "Auto stages is off.", false )
end
if not w( IB ) then
    return SG( "Waiting", "Clock unavailable.", false )
end
if not Yj() then
    return SG( "Paused", "Waiting for the hub activity coordinator.", false )
end
local u, gZ = pcall( C.getSnapshot ) if not Pa() or not u or type( gZ ) ~= "table" or gZ.ready ~= true then
    return SG( "Waiting", "Waiting for native player data.", false )
end
local op = gZ.character if gZ.alive ~= true then
    Qa = false;
    UZ = true;
    lZ = IB + 5;
    return SG( "Recovering", "Waiting for respawn.", false )
end
if not op or not Q( op ) then
    return SG( "Waiting", "Waiting for character.", false )
end
if Sp ~= op then
    Sp = op;
    Qa = false;
    lZ = math.max( lZ, IB + 1 )
end
if UZ and oB.AutoRecover == false then
    return SG( "Paused", "Respawned. Re-enable auto stages to resume.", false )
end
if IB < lZ then
    return SG( "Recovering", "Waiting before another stage attempt.", false )
end
UZ = false if gZ.tower == true or w( gZ.tower ) and gZ.tower > 0 then
    return SG( "Waiting", "Leave the separate Tower mode first.", false )
end
if gZ.cutscene or gZ.frozen or gZ.swinging or gZ.pending and gZ.pendingKind ~= "daily" and gZ.pendingKind ~= "playtime" then
    return SG( "Waiting", "Waiting for the native action to finish.", true )
end
if not GG( IB, op ) then
    return SG( "Waiting", "Waiting for initialized native stage controllers.", false )
end
if not Q( op ) or not Yj() then
    return SG( "Paused", "Session changed during native setup.", false )
end
local lD, ks = HZ( kI.encounter, "Active" ) if not Q( op ) then
    return SG( "Waiting", "Character changed.", false )
end
if not lD then
    return SG( "Waiting", "Native fight state unavailable.", false )
end
if not Qa then
    local AD, Ws if w( ks ) and ks >= 1 and ks <= 1000 and DQ( ks ) then
        AD = ks
    else
        AD, Ws = MZ( oB, gZ )
    end
    if not Q( op ) or not Yj() then
        return SG( "Paused", "Session changed.", false )
    end
    if not AD then
        return SG( "Training needed", Ws or "No eligible stage.", false, { wantsTraining = true } )
    end
    Qa = { stage = AD, character = op, started = IB, lastProgress = IB, sawActive = false, sawEnemies = false, serverReady = false, claimRequested = false, won = false, origin = bK( Fm( op, "HumanoidRootPart" ), "Position" ) }
end
if Qa.character ~= op then
    Qa = false;
    return SG( "Waiting", "Character changed.", false )
end
local WV = Qa.stage;
local Hp, VM = nZ( WV ) if not Q( op ) or not Yj() then
    return SG( "Paused", "Session changed.", false )
end
local im = kZ( WV ) if not im or not Hp then
    return SG( "Waiting", "Stage geometry or native encounter is not loaded.", false )
end
if ks and ks ~= WV then
    Qa = false;
    return SG( "Waiting", "Following the current native fight on the next step.", true )
end
if Qa.won then
    local ga = WV;
    Qa = false;
    lZ = IB + 1 if oB.RepeatStages == false then
        return SG( "Complete", "Stage reward confirmed.", false, { completed = true, stage = ga, stopStages = true } )
    end
    return SG( "Complete", "Stage reward confirmed.", false, { completed = true, stage = ga } )
end
if VM and not Qa.claimRequested then
    Qa.replay = true if DZ( op, im, WV ) then
        return SG( "Cooldown", "Waiting for the game to make the next run available.", true )
    end
    return eZ( op, im, "Leaving the completed stage until native replay is ready." )
end
if VM and Qa.claimRequested and Qa.serverReady then
    return SG( "Confirming", "Waiting for the server reward acknowledgement.", true )
end
if ks == WV then
    Qa.sawActive = true
end
local BK, qS, FZ, IZ, pd = vZ( WV, op ) if not Q( op ) or not Yj() then
    return SG( "Paused", "Session changed.", false )
end
if BK == nil then
    return SG( "Waiting", FZ or "Enemy roster unavailable.", true )
end
if BK > 0 then
    Qa.sawEnemies = true
end
if Hp == "cleared" then
    if BK > 0 then
        return SG( "Waiting", "Waiting for every enemy to finish dying.", true )
    end
    if not BZ( gf( TI, "WinReady" ), WV ) then
        return SG( "Confirming", "Waiting for server-confirmed stage clear.", true )
    end
    Qa.serverReady = true local Uw = cZ( oB );
    local Rd = WV + 1 if not Qa.claimRequested and Uw and Rd <= Uw and EZ( oB, gZ, Rd ) and DQ( Rd ) and QZ( Rd, gZ ) then
        local ha, ta = PZ( Rd, gZ ) if ta == nil then
            return SG( "Waiting", "Waiting for the next stage recommendation before ending this run.", true )
        end
        if ta == "ready" then
            local qQ = kZ( Rd ) local PA = qQ and zZ( Rd, qQ, op ) if not PA then
                return SG( "Waiting", "Waiting for a safe platform in stage " .. Rd .. ". Intermediate rewards are skipped.", true )
            end
            local cS = Qa.origin Qa = { stage = Rd, character = op, started = IB, lastProgress = IB, sawActive = false, sawEnemies = false, serverReady = false, claimRequested = false, won = false, origin = cS } return cw( PA, op, "Continuing to stage " .. Rd .. "; collecting only at the end of this run.", { stage = Rd } )
        end
    end
    local Yt = GZ( WV, im ) if not Yt then
        return SG( "Waiting", "Waiting for the free Wins plate to stream in.", true )
    end
    local Za, Z = bK( Yt, "CFrame" ), bK( Yt, "Size" ) if not Za or not Z then
        return SG( "Waiting", "Wins plate geometry unavailable.", true )
    end
    local PA = WZ( WV, im, op, Za.Position + Vector3.new( 0, Z.Y / 2, 0 ), "pad" ) if not PA then

    lq[ c ][ x ] = H
end

    return
end

    e:To( c, M );
    return
end

    pcall( function() Uq[ c ]:Cancel()
end
);

end

end
) if u and z then
    Uq[ c ] = z;
    z:Play();
    return
end
end
for x, H in pairs( M ) do
    c[ x ] = H
end
end

    if math.abs( H ) >= h[ 1 ] then
        return string.format( "%.1f", H / h[ 1 ] ):gsub( "%.0$", "" ) .. h[ 2 ]
    end
end
return tostring( math.floor( H ) )
end

function iB.Validate( x, H ) if ks[ x ] or xo[ x ] then
    if type( H ) == "boolean" then
        return H
    end
    ;
    return
end

end
end
function iB.Create( aV ) local ER = {};

local YF = ( function() local co = {} local function w( KV ) return type( KV ) == "number" and KV == KV and math.abs( KV ) < math.huge
end
function co.ChooseUpgrade( WA, Fu, hF, nz, tF, nC, Cw, UF, eh, fC ) if type( WA ) ~= "table" or type( Fu ) ~= "table" or type( hF ) ~= "table" or not w( nz ) or not w( tF ) or not w( nC ) or not w( Cw ) or not w( UF ) then
    return
end
local Ph, oS for dR, aR in ipairs( WA ) do
    if dR > 64 then
        break
    end
    local yu, SI = Fu[ aR ], hF[ aR ] if type( yu ) == "table" and w( SI ) and SI >= 0 and w( yu.max ) and SI < yu.max and( eh == "All" or eh == aR ) and( yu.requiresStars == nil or w( yu.requiresStars ) and nz >= yu.requiresStars ) then
        local u, OT = pcall( fC, aR, SI ) if u and w( OT ) and OT >= 0 and tF - OT >= nC and( Cw == 0 or UF + OT <= Cw ) and( not oS or OT < oS ) then
            Ph, oS = aR, OT
        end
    end
end
return Ph, oS
end
function co.Target( r, lF, ua, mp ) if type( r ) ~= "table" or not w( lF ) or lF <= 0 then
    return
end
local rX, oS for dR, lp in ipairs( r ) do
    if dR > 4096 then
        break
    end
    if type( lp ) == "table" and w( lp.need ) and lp.need > 0 and lp.need <= lF * .98 and w( lp.distance ) and lp.distance >= 0 and not lp.hidden and not lp.blocked and lp.uid and lp.model then
        local H = w( lp.gain ) and math.max( 0, lp.gain ) or lp.need ^ 3 local ol = ua == "Nearest" and 1 / ( 1 + lp.distance ) or math.log( 1 + H ) / ( 1 + lp.distance / math.max( 10, lF * 2 ) ) if ua == "Index" and type( mp ) == "table" and mp[ lp.id ] == nil then
            ol = ol * 10 + 1
        end
        if not oS or ol > oS or ol == oS and tostring( lp.uid ) < tostring( rX.uid ) then
            rX, oS = lp, ol
        end
    end
end
return rX
end
function co.SameSet( g, P ) if type( g ) ~= "table" or type( P ) ~= "table" or # g ~= # P then
    return false
end

    if type( KV ) ~= "string" or NS[ KV ] then
        return false
    end
    ;
    NS[ KV ] = true
end
for Fp, KV in ipairs( P ) do
    if not NS[ KV ] then
        return false
    end
end
return true
end
return co
end

lq[ c ] = lq[ c ] or {} local v = false for x, H in pairs( M ) do
    if lq[ c ][ x ] ~= H then
        v = true
    end
    lq[ c ][ x ] = H
end
if not v then
    return
end
if e then
    e:To( c, M );
    return
end
if Uq[ c ] then
    pcall( function() Uq[ c ]:Cancel()
end
);
Uq[ c ] = nil
end

    local u, z = pcall( function() return C.TweenService:Create( c, TweenInfo.new( Qq.motion or .16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out ), M )
end
) if u and z then
    Uq[ c ] = z;
    z:Play();
    return
end
end
for x, H in pairs( M ) do
    c[ x ] = H
end
end

local function w( H ) return type( H ) == "number" and H == H and math.abs( H ) < math.huge
end
local function ln( H ) if not w( H ) then
    return "-"
end
for Fp, h in ipairs( { { 1000000000000, "T" }, { 1000000000, "B" }, { 1000000, "M" }, { 1000, "K" } } ) do
    if math.abs( H ) >= h[ 1 ] then
        return string.format( "%.1f", H / h[ 1 ] ):gsub( "%.0$", "" ) .. h[ 2 ]
    end
end
return tostring( math.floor( H ) )
end

local function m2( IV, Kc, WZ, Z ) local X2 = OverlapParams.new();
X2.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude X2.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Kc, IV.character };
X2.RespectCanCollide = false;
X2.MaxParts = 256 local Uj = ZI:GetPartBoundsInBox( WZ, Z + Vector3.new( 1, 0, 1 ), X2 ) if # Uj >= 256 then
    return false, "The destination is too crowded to place this car."
end
for Fp, VB in ipairs( Uj ) do
    if VB.CanCollide then
        return false, "The destination is obstructed."
    end
    local OB = VB.Parent while OB and OB ~= ZI do
        if OB:IsA( "Model" ) and( OB:GetAttribute( "OwnerUID" ) or OB:FindFirstChildOfClass( "Humanoid" ) ) then
            return false, "Another car or character occupies the destination."
        end
        OB = OB.Parent
    end
end
return true
end
local function K2( b2, Nq, Z ) local vQ = N1[ b2 ] if not vQ or vQ.Parent == nil or not vQ:IsDescendantOf( rG ) then
    return false
end
for Fp, mR in ipairs( { - .5, 0, .5 } ) do
    for Fp, qV in ipairs( { - .5, 0, .5 } ) do
        local ZK = Nq:PointToWorldSpace( Vector3.new( mR * ( Z.X + 1 ), 0, qV * ( Z.Z + 1 ) ) ) if H( kI.zones.IsPointInZone, b2.zoneId, ZK ) ~= true then
            return false
        end
    end
end
return true
end
local function q2( IV, Kc, b2, Z ) local ES = RaycastParams.new();
ES.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude ES.FilterDescendantsInstances = { IV.character, Kc };
ES.RespectCanCollide = true local sE = { { b2.Position.X, b2.Position.Z } } for Fp, mR in ipairs( { 0, - .25, .25, - .4, .4 } ) do
    for Fp, qV in ipairs( { 0, - .25, .25, - .4, .4 } ) do
        sE[ # sE + 1 ] = { b2.Position.X + mR * b2.Size.X, b2.Position.Z + qV * b2.Size.Z }
    end
end
local eo = "No supported free space inside the sale polygon fits this car." for Fp, ZK in ipairs( sE ) do
    for Fp, Y2 in ipairs( b2.orientations ) do
        local JA = ZI:Raycast( Vector3.new( ZK[ 1 ], b2.Position.Y + 6, ZK[ 2 ] ), Vector3.new( 0, - 64, 0 ), ES ) if JA and JA.Normal.Y > .9 and JA.Instance and JA.Instance.CanCollide then
            local nE = JA.Position.Y local Nq = CFrame.new( ZK[ 1 ], nE + Z.Y * .5 + .35, ZK[ 2 ] ) * Y2 if K2( b2, Nq, Z ) then
                local Bb = true for Fp, mR in ipairs( { - .5, 0, .5 } ) do
                    for Fp, qV in ipairs( { - .5, 0, .5 } ) do
                        local VI = Nq:PointToWorldSpace( Vector3.new( mR * Z.X, 0, qV * Z.Z ) ) local yk = ZI:Raycast( Vector3.new( VI.X, nE + 4, VI.Z ), Vector3.new( 0, - 10, 0 ), ES ) if not yk or not yk.Instance or not yk.Instance.CanCollide or yk.Normal.Y < .9 or math.abs( yk.Position.Y - nE ) > .6 then
                            Bb = false
                        end
                    end
                end
                if Bb then
                    local bQ, Ws = m2( IV, Kc, Nq, Z ) if bQ then
                        return Nq
                    end
                    ;
                    eo = Ws or eo
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
return nil, eo
end
function fV.MoveCar( IV, Kc, b2 ) if not fV.Same( IV ) or not fV.OwnModel( Kc ) or not b2 then
    return false
end
local h2 = N1[ b2 ] ~= nil if not h2 and( typeof( b2 ) ~= "Instance" or not b2:IsA( "BasePart" ) ) then
    return false
end
if kI.paint.IsUnoccupied( Kc ) ~= true then
    return false
end
local DK, Z = Kc:GetBoundingBox();
local vy = Kc:GetPivot() local kO = DK:ToObjectSpace( vy ) local WZ, Ws if h2 then
    WZ, Ws = q2( IV, Kc, b2, Z )
else
    WZ = CFrame.new( b2.Position.X, b2.Position.Y - b2.Size.Y * .5 + Z.Y * .5 + .35, b2.Position.Z ) * b2.CFrame.Rotation local bQ;
    bQ, Ws = m2( IV, Kc, WZ, Z ) if not bQ then
        WZ = nil
    end
end
if not WZ then
    if h2 then
        fV.Stream( b2.Position )
    end
    return false, Ws
end
if not fV.Same( IV ) or not fV.OwnModel( Kc ) or kI.paint.IsUnoccupied( Kc ) ~= true then
    return false
end
if h2 and not K2( b2, WZ, Z ) then
    return false, "The sale zone changed before placement."
end
Kc:PivotTo( WZ * kO ) for Fp, VB in ipairs( Kc:GetDescendants() ) do
    if VB:IsA( "BasePart" ) then
        VB.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new();
        VB.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new()
    end
end
return true
end
function fV.PrepareInstall( Kc, Sh ) local VB = Sh.model if Sh.family == "Engine" then
    local t2, U2 = VB:GetAttribute( "EngineCategory" ), VB:GetAttribute( "EngineSubId" ) if kI.engineParts.GetMounted( Kc, t2 ) then
        return nil, "The engine slot is occupied."
    end
    local u, Ws = kI.engineParts.CanInstall( Kc, t2, U2 );
    if not u then
        return nil, Ws
    end
    local W2 = kI.loadout.Get( Kc );
    local yu = W2 and kI.engines[ W2.EngineId ] local l2 = yu and kI.engineParts.ResolveParentMount( Kc, yu, t2 ) local s2 = kI.engineParts.GetMountPart( VB ) local qS = l2 and s2 and kI.engineParts.ResolveTargetMountCFrame( yu, t2, U2, s2, l2, Kc ) return qS and { cf = qS * s2.CFrame:Inverse() * VB:GetPivot(), remote = "InstallEngineComponent", slot = t2 } or nil
elseif Sh.family == "ChassisPart" then
    local yu = kI.chassisParts.Get( Sh.id );
    local bw = yu and kI.chassisParts.GetSlotPart( Kc, yu.Slot ) local w2 = VB.PrimaryPart or VB:FindFirstChild( "_MAIN" ) if not yu or not bw or not w2 or kI.chassisParts.GetMounted( Kc, yu.Slot ) then
        return
    end
    local qS = bw.CFrame * kI.chassisParts.ResolveOffset( yu, Kc:GetAttribute( "VehicleId" ) ) return { cf = qS * w2.CFrame:Inverse() * VB:GetPivot(), remote = "InstallChassisPart", slot = yu.Slot }
elseif Sh.family == "BodyPanel" then
    local yu = kI.panels[ Sh.id ];
    local Wf = Kc:FindFirstChild( "DriveSeat" );
    local w2 = VB.PrimaryPart or VB:FindFirstChild( "_MAIN" ) if not yu or not Wf or not w2 or kI.bodyParts.GetMounted( Kc, yu.Slot ) then
        return
    end
    return { cf = Wf.CFrame * yu.MountOffset * w2.CFrame:Inverse() * VB:GetPivot(), remote = "InstallBodyPanel", slot = yu.Slot }
end
end

end

function fV.ZoneArea( aR ) local nk = Fm( rG, "__ZONES." .. aR ) if not nk then
    return
end
local A2 = {} for Fp, nm in ipairs( nk:GetDescendants() ) do
    if nm:IsA( "BasePart" ) then
        return nm
    end
    if nm:IsA( "Configuration" ) and nm.Name == "Polygon" then
        A2[ # A2 + 1 ] = nm
    end
end
for Fp, vQ in ipairs( A2 ) do
    local eE = {} for Cp, ZK in pairs( vQ:GetAttributes() ) do
        local mp = Cp:match( "^Node(%d+)$" ) if mp and typeof( ZK ) == "Vector2" and gV.Finite( ZK.X ) and gV.Finite( ZK.Y ) then
            eE[ # eE + 1 ] = { index = tonumber( mp ), point = ZK }
        end
    end
    table.sort( eE, function( g, P ) return g.index < P.index
end
) if # eE >= 3 then
    local r2, n2, y2, f2 = math.huge, - math.huge, math.huge, - math.huge local oS, wg = nil, 0 for dR, af in ipairs( eE ) do
        local SV, OV = af.point, eE[ dR % # eE + 1 ].point r2, n2 = math.min( r2, SV.X ), math.max( n2, SV.X );
        y2, f2 = math.min( y2, SV.Y ), math.max( f2, SV.Y ) local zE, Vc = OV.X - SV.X, OV.Y - SV.Y;
        local PS = zE * zE + Vc * Vc if gV.Finite( PS ) and PS > wg then
            oS, wg = Vector3.new( zE, 0, Vc ), PS
        end
    end
    local XR = vQ:GetAttribute( "Y" ) if gV.Finite( XR ) and oS and wg > 1 and n2 > r2 and f2 > y2 then
        local nK = Vector3.new( ( r2 + n2 ) * .5, XR, ( y2 + f2 ) * .5 ) local b2 = { zoneId = aR, Position = nK, Size = Vector3.new( n2 - r2, 0, f2 - y2 ), orientations = { CFrame.lookAt( Vector3.new(), oS ), CFrame.lookAt( Vector3.new(), Vector3.new( - oS.Z, 0, oS.X ) ) } } N1[ b2 ] = vQ;
        return b2
    end
end
end
end
function fV.Stream( nK ) local mV = ( aV.clock or os.clock )() if not fV.CanRun() or u1 or mV - o1 < 3 then
    return
end
;
o1 = mV local lA = {};
u1 = lA local ZA, WF = pcall( aV.spawn or task.spawn, function() if fV.CanRun() then
    pcall( TI.RequestStreamAroundAsync, TI, nK, 2 )
end
if u1 == lA then
    u1 = nil
end
end
) if ZA then
    lA.worker = WF
elseif u1 == lA then
    u1 = nil
end
end

    return kI.bodyParts.GetMounted( Kc, bw )
end
end
local function Q2( IV, VB, vy, g2, P2 ) if not fV.Same( IV ) or not VB or not VB.Parent then
    return false
end
vy = vy or VB:GetPivot();
local nK = vy.Position local dD = IV.root.Size;
local QA = IV.humanoid.HipHeight if not gV.Finite( QA ) or not dD or not gV.Finite( dD.Y ) then
    return false
end
local nR = math.max( dD.X, dD.Z ) / 2 + .4 local RI = QA + dD.Y / 2 + .15 local bY = math.max( 5, QA + dD.Y + 1.5 ) local J2 = { IV.character, VB };
local OB = VB.Parent for Fp = 1, 16 do
    if not OB or OB == ZI then
        break
    end
    if OB:IsA( "Model" ) and OB:GetAttribute( "OwnerUID" ) == TI.UserId and( OB:GetAttribute( "VehicleUUID" ) or OB:GetAttribute( "CustomerJobId" ) ) then
        J2[ # J2 + 1 ] = OB;
        break
    end
    OB = OB.Parent
end
local xA = RaycastParams.new();
xA.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude xA.FilterDescendantsInstances = J2;
xA.RespectCanCollide = true;
xA.IgnoreWater = false local x2 = RaycastParams.new();
x2.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude local E2 = {};
for Fp, KV in ipairs( J2 ) do
    E2[ # E2 + 1 ] = KV
end
local a2 = Fm( ZI, "__DEBRIS.PlayerShopInteriors" ) if a2 then
    for Fp, S2 in ipairs( a2:GetChildren() ) do
        local O2 = S2:FindFirstChild( "_MACHINES" );
        if O2 then
            E2[ # E2 + 1 ] = O2
        end
    end
end
for Fp, eC in ipairs( aV.collection:GetTagged( kI.machines.GlobalMachineTag or "GlobalUseRepairMachine" ) ) do
    E2[ # E2 + 1 ] = eC
end
for Fp, zD in ipairs( kI.families.DetachedTags or {} ) do
    for Fp, c2 in ipairs( aV.collection:GetTagged( zD ) ) do
        E2[ # E2 + 1 ] = c2
    end
end
x2.FilterDescendantsInstances = E2;
x2.RespectCanCollide = true;
x2.IgnoreWater = false local sB = OverlapParams.new();
sB.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude sB.FilterDescendantsInstances = { IV.character };
sB.RespectCanCollide = true;
sB.MaxParts = 32 local Vp, M2 = TI:GetAttribute( "ShopInteriorBoundsCFrame" ), TI:GetAttribute( "ShopInteriorBoundsSize" ) local k2, T2 if VB:IsA( "Model" ) and VB:GetAttribute( "OwnerUID" ) == TI.UserId and( VB:GetAttribute( "VehicleUUID" ) or VB:GetAttribute( "CustomerJobId" ) ) and type( VB.GetBoundingBox ) == "function" then
    local Vw, DK, Z = pcall( VB.GetBoundingBox, VB );
    if Vw then
        k2, T2 = DK, Z
    end
end
local function Bb( mR, qV ) local z2 = math.min( nK.Y + 12, IV.root.Position.Y + 3 ) local JA = ZI:Raycast( Vector3.new( mR, z2, qV ), Vector3.new( 0, - 48, 0 ), x2 ) if not JA or not JA.Instance or JA.Instance.CanCollide ~= true or JA.Normal.Y < .75 or tostring( JA.Material ) == "Enum.Material.Water" or math.abs( JA.Position.Y - ( IV.root.Position.Y - RI ) ) > 6 then
    return
end
return JA.Position
end
local function pw( xS ) if k2 and T2 then
    local qI = k2:PointToObjectSpace( xS ) if math.abs( qI.X ) < T2.X / 2 + nR and math.abs( qI.Z ) < T2.Z / 2 + nR then
        return
    end
end
if g2 and IV.inShop and typeof( Vp ) == "CFrame" and typeof( M2 ) == "Vector3" then
    local OV = Vp:PointToObjectSpace( xS ) if math.abs( OV.X ) > M2.X / 2 - nR or math.abs( OV.Z ) > M2.Z / 2 - nR then
        return
    end
end
local yk = Bb( xS.X, xS.Z );
if not yk then
    return
end
for Fp, kO in ipairs( { Vector3.new( nR, 0, 0 ), Vector3.new( - nR, 0, 0 ), Vector3.new( 0, 0, nR ), Vector3.new( 0, 0, - nR ) } ) do
    local HS = Bb( xS.X + kO.X, xS.Z + kO.Z ) if not HS or math.abs( HS.Y - yk.Y ) > .7 then
        return
    end
end
local RS = yk + Vector3.new( 0, .2 + bY / 2, 0 ) for Fp, G2 in ipairs( ZI:GetPartBoundsInBox( CFrame.new( RS ), Vector3.new( nR * 2, bY, nR * 2 ), sB ) ) do
    if G2.CanCollide then
        return
    end
end
local j2 = yk + Vector3.new( 0, RI, 0 ) if P2 and( j2 - nK ).Magnitude > P2 then
    return
end
local QB = j2 + Vector3.new( 0, .5, 0 ) local i2 = ZI:Raycast( QB, nK - QB, xA ) if i2 and i2.Instance and i2.Instance.CanCollide then
    return
end
local mi = Vector3.new( nK.X, j2.Y, nK.Z ) return( mi - j2 ).Magnitude > .1 and CFrame.lookAt( j2, mi ) or CFrame.new( j2 )
end
local BO = Vector3.new( IV.root.Position.X - nK.X, 0, IV.root.Position.Z - nK.Z ).Magnitude local Vb = T2 and math.max( 9, T2.Magnitude * .5 + 4 ) or 9 if BO >= 2.5 and BO <= Vb then
    local qz = pw( IV.root.Position ) if qz and( IV.root.Position - qz.Position ).Magnitude <= 1.5 then
        return true
    end
end
local oS, PS local v2 = { 4, 6, 8 } if T2 then
    v2[ # v2 + 1 ] = math.max( T2.X, T2.Z ) * .5 + nR + 2 v2[ # v2 + 1 ] = math.max( T2.X, T2.Z ) * .5 + nR + 5
end
for Fp, lp in ipairs( v2 ) do
    for Fp, kO in ipairs( { { 0, - 1 }, { 1, 0 }, { - 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { .707, - .707 }, { - .707, - .707 }, { .707, .707 }, { - .707, .707 } } ) do
        local ZK = vy:PointToWorldSpace( Vector3.new( kO[ 1 ] * lp, 0, kO[ 2 ] * lp ) ) local xS = pw( ZK ) if xS then
            local up = ( IV.root.Position - xS.Position ).Magnitude if not oS or up < PS then
                oS, PS = xS, up
            end
        end
    end
end
if not oS then
    return false, "No clear supported approach to the target; move away from the wall or obstruction."
end
if not fV.Same( IV ) then
    return false
end
if( IV.root.Position - oS.Position ).Magnitude <= 1.5 then
    return true
end
return fV.MoveNear( IV, oS, true )
end

function fV.StartRepair( IV, Sh, eC ) if not fV.Same( IV ) or not fV.PartOwned( Sh.model ) or Sh.model:GetAttribute( "Repairing" ) == true or not eC or not eC.model or not eC.model:IsDescendantOf( ZI ) then

local function L2( IV, Sh, ta, Kc, eC ) if not fV.Same( IV ) or not fV.PartOwned( Sh.model ) or Sh.model:GetAttribute( "Repairing" ) == true then
    Z1();
    return false, "Waiting for the released part."
end
if not fV.EquipWrench( IV ) then
    return false, "Equipping the wrench to hold the part."
end
local x = Kc or eC and eC.model if e1[ Sh.model ] then
    return false, e1[ Sh.model ], "stalled"
end
if D1 and D1.part == Sh.model and D1.key == x and D1.kind == ta then
    return true
end
Z1() local lr = Sh.model.PrimaryPart or Sh.model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA( "BasePart", true ) if not lr or lr.Anchored then
    return false, "Waiting for the loose part to be released."
end
if not aV.heartbeat then
    return false, "Physics updates are unavailable for holding the part."
end
local FI = { part = Sh.model, car = Kc, machine = eC, key = x, kind = ta, primary = lr, touchAt = - math.huge } D1 = FI local bu = pcall( function() FI.offset = Sh.model:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace( lr.CFrame ) FI.attachment = Instance.new( "Attachment" );
FI.attachment.Name = "SchoolHubPartAttachment";
FI.attachment.Parent = lr FI.align = Instance.new( "AlignPosition" );
FI.align.Name = "SchoolHubPartPosition" FI.align.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment;
FI.align.Attachment0 = FI.attachment FI.align.MaxForce = 395000;
FI.align.Responsiveness = 50;
FI.align.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true;
FI.align.Parent = lr FI.orient = Instance.new( "AlignOrientation" );
FI.orient.Name = "SchoolHubPartOrientation" FI.orient.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment;
FI.orient.Attachment0 = FI.attachment FI.orient.MaxTorque = 95000;
FI.orient.Responsiveness = 50;
FI.orient.ReactionTorqueEnabled = true;
FI.orient.Parent = lr
end
) if not bu then
    Z1();
    return false, "Unable to create the part holding controls."
end
local function Sb() if D1 ~= FI then
    return
end
if not fV.Same( IV ) or not fV.PartOwned( FI.part ) or FI.part:GetAttribute( "Repairing" ) == true or lr.Anchored then
    Z1();
    return
end
local qS if ta == "assembly" then
    if not fV.OwnModel( Kc ) or FI.part:IsDescendantOf( Kc ) then
        Z1();
        return
    end
    local Os = fV.PrepareInstall( Kc, Sh );
    qS = Os and Os.cf
else
    if not eC or not eC.model:IsDescendantOf( ZI ) then
        Z1();
        return
    end
    local yu = kI.machines.Get( eC.model.Name ) if not yu or yu.Factor ~= eC.factor then
        Z1();
        return
    end
    if eC.global then
        if not aV.collection:HasTag( eC.model, kI.machines.GlobalMachineTag ) then
            Z1();
            return
        end
    else
        local Vp, Z = TI:GetAttribute( "ShopInteriorBoundsCFrame" ), TI:GetAttribute( "ShopInteriorBoundsSize" ) if typeof( Vp ) ~= "CFrame" or typeof( Z ) ~= "Vector3" or not kI.shop.Contains( Vp, Z, eC.model:GetPivot().Position ) then
            Z1();
            return
        end
    end
    qS = kI.machines.DockPivot( eC.model, Sh.model )
end
if not qS or( IV.root.Position - qS.Position ).Magnitude > 10 then
    Z1();
    return
end
local Za = qS * FI.offset local mV = ( aV.clock or os.clock )();
local PS = ( FI.part:GetPivot().Position - qS.Position ).Magnitude if FI.lastTarget and( FI.lastTarget - qS.Position ).Magnitude > .5 then
    FI.bestDistance = nil
end
FI.lastTarget = qS.Position if not FI.bestDistance or PS < FI.bestDistance - .25 then
    FI.bestDistance = PS;
    FI.progressAt = mV
end
if PS > 1 and mV - FI.progressAt >= 10 then
    e1[ FI.part ] = "The loose part did not reach its destination within 10 seconds." Z1();
    return
end
FI.align.Position = Za.Position;
FI.orient.CFrame = Za if mV - FI.touchAt >= 4 and fV.TouchPart( FI.part ) then
    FI.touchAt = mV
end
end
local function XI() local u = pcall( Sb );
if not u and D1 == FI then
    Z1()
end
end
XI() if D1 ~= FI then
    return false, e1[ Sh.model ] or "Waiting for a valid reachable part destination.", e1[ Sh.model ] and "stalled" or nil
end
local Xu, uR = pcall( function() return aV.heartbeat:Connect( XI )
end
) if not Xu then
    Z1();
    return false, "Unable to start the part holding controls."
end
FI.connection = uR return true
end

    return false

local function Is( IV, Rs, Kc ) local DA for Fp, T in ipairs( Rs.records ) do
    if not T.installed and not T.retired then
        local I4 = fV.Mounted( Kc, T.family, T.slot ) if I4 then
            O4( Rs, T, I4 )
        else
            local Sh = R4( IV, T ) if not Sh then
                if V4( IV, T ) then
                    if not fV.StoredAssemblyReady( Kc, T ) then
                        DA = "Waiting for the supporting parts before " .. tostring( T.slot ) .. "."
                    else
                        local kH, Ws = fV.NearAssembly( IV, Kc, fV.StoredAssemblyAnchor( Kc, T ) ) if not kH then
                            N( "Assembling", Ws or "Approaching the car before bringing out its parts." );
                            return true
                        end
                        return Zm( IV, "withdraw", T.itemUUID, "WithdrawPart", { T.itemUUID }, 0, function( KV ) return KV.items[ T.itemUUID ] ~= nil and not KV.looseByItem[ T.itemUUID ]
                    end
                    , function( KV ) if KV.looseByItem[ T.itemUUID ] then
                        T.model = KV.looseByItem[ T.itemUUID ].model;
                        return true
                    end
                    ;
                    return false
                end
                , "bringing back " .. tostring( T.slot ) )
            end
        else
            DA = "The tracked part is not available: " .. tostring( T.slot ) .. "."
        end
    else
        if Sh.model:GetAttribute( "Repairing" ) == true then
            N( "Assembling", "Waiting for the machine to release " .. tostring( T.slot ) .. "." );
            return true
        end
        if T.pendingStorage then
            return W4( IV, Rs, T, Sh )
        end
        local Os, rW = fV.PrepareInstall( Kc, Sh ) if Os then
            if fV.AssemblyTransferNeeded( Sh, Os ) then
                T.snapAt = nil return W4( IV, Rs, T, Sh )
            end
            if not T.snapAt or IB() - T.snapAt > 2 then
                local h4, Ws, xw = fV.SnapPart( IV, Kc, Sh, Os ) if xw == "stalled" then
                    if( T.moveRecoveries and T.moveRecoveries.Assembly or 0 ) < 2 then
                        fV.ReleasePartHold();
                        return W4( IV, Rs, T, Sh, nil, "Assembly" )
                    end
                    N( "Blocked", tostring( T.slot ) .. ": " .. tostring( Ws ) .. " Two pickup recoveries failed; the part is retained." );
                    return true
                end
                if h4 then
                    T.snapAt = IB()
                end
                N( "Assembling", Ws or( "Positioning " .. tostring( T.slot ) .. "." ) );
                return true
            end
            if IB() - T.snapAt < .35 or not fV.EquipWrench( IV ) then
                return true
            end
            if not fV.AssemblyPositioned( Sh, Os ) then
                T.snapAt = nil;
                N( "Assembling", "Waiting for " .. tostring( T.slot ) .. " at its car mount." );
                return true
            end
            return Zm( IV, "install", Rs.id .. ":" .. tostring( T.slot ), Os.remote, { Kc, Sh.model }, 0, function( KV ) return fV.WorkCar( KV, Kc, Rs.jobId ) and fV.PartOwned( Sh.model ) and Sh.model:GetAttribute( "Repairing" ) ~= true and fV.Mounted( Kc, T.family, T.slot ) == nil and fV.AssemblyPositioned( Sh, Os )
        end
        , function() local VB = fV.Mounted( Kc, T.family, T.slot ) if VB and fV.Row( VB ).id == T.id and fV.Row( VB ).class == T.class then
            O4( Rs, T, VB );
            return true
        end
        ;
        return false
    end
    , "installing " .. tostring( T.slot ) )
else
    DA = rW or "Waiting for the next part dependency before reassembly."
end
end
end
end
end
for Fp, T in ipairs( Rs.records ) do
    if not T.installed and not T.retired then
        N( "Assembling", DA or "Waiting for the tracked parts." );
        return true

local function k4( rB ) local VV = fV.Modules();
local tW = VV.junkyard.GetCarData( rB ) if not tW or type( tW.Metadata ) ~= "table" or type( tW.Value ) ~= "table" then
    return nil, "Waiting for native restoration values."
end
local H2, T4 = tW.Metadata, tW.Value;
local Ts = H2.Loadout if not gV.Money( T4.Restored ) or T4.Restored <= 0 or not gV.Money( T4.PartsCost ) then
    return nil, "Waiting for native restoration values."
end
if T4.PartsCost > 0 then
    return nil, "Available cars need replacement parts; waiting for a complete repairable car."
end
if type( Ts ) ~= "table" or type( Ts.SubComponents ) ~= "table" or next( Ts.SubComponents ) == nil then
    return nil, "Waiting for complete engine data."
end
for t2, VB in pairs( Ts.SubComponents ) do
    if type( VB ) ~= "table" or not gV.Money( VB.Damage ) or not gV.Money( VB.Rust ) or VV.condition.IsScrapped( t2, VB.Damage ) then
        return nil, "Available cars need replacement parts; waiting for a complete repairable car."
    end
    if VB.Rust > 0 and not xV.RestoreRust then
        return nil, "Enable rust restoration to use the fully restored valuation."
    end
end
for bw, VB in pairs( H2.ChassisParts or {} ) do
    if bw == "Battery" or bw == "ECU" then
        if type( VB ) ~= "table" or not gV.Money( VB.Damage ) or VV.condition.IsScrapped( bw, VB.Damage ) then
            return nil, "Waiting for repairable chassis data."
        end
        if( VB.Rust or 0 ) > 0 and not xV.RestoreRust then
            return nil, "Enable rust restoration to use the fully restored valuation."
        end
    end
end
if # VV.assembly.GetMissing( tW.DirId, H2 ) > 0 then
    return nil, "Waiting for a car with no missing required parts."
end
if H2.PaintRusted == true and( not xV.RestoreRust or not xV.RestorePaint ) then

local function w( H ) return type( H ) == "number" and H == H and math.abs( H ) < math.huge
end
local function ln( H ) if not w( H ) then
    return "-"
end
for Fp, h in ipairs( { { 1000000000000, "T" }, { 1000000000, "B" }, { 1000000, "M" }, { 1000, "K" } } ) do
    if math.abs( H ) >= h[ 1 ] then
        return string.format( "%.1f", H / h[ 1 ] ):gsub( "%.0$", "" ) .. h[ 2 ]
    end
end
return tostring( math.floor( H ) )
end

function fV.UpdatePrompt( IV ) local FI = h5;
if not FI then
    return
end
if not fV.Same( IV ) then
    z5( "cancelled", true );
    return
end
if not FI.prompt.Parent or not FI.model:IsDescendantOf( ZI ) or not FI.prompt.Enabled then
    FI.finished = true;
    z5( FI.triggered and "inventory" or "target-changed", true );
    return
end
if FI.triggered then
    FI.finished = true;
    z5( "inventory" );
    return
end
if FI.method == "native" then
    if FI.lost then
        FI.finished = true;
        z5( "input-lost" )
    elseif not FI.beganAt and IB() - FI.at >= 1 then
        FI.finished = true;
        z5( "input-not-started" )
    elseif FI.beganAt and IB() - FI.beganAt >= math.max( FI.duration, FI.prompt.HoldDuration ) + 1 then
        FI.finished = true;
        z5( "input-not-confirmed" )
    end
elseif not FI.finished and IB() - FI.at >= math.max( FI.duration, FI.prompt.HoldDuration ) + 2 then
    z5( "input-not-confirmed", true )
end
end

local function Tr( h ) if type( h ) == "string" then
    return h, h
end
if type( h ) == "table" then
    local aR = h.id or h.name or h.label if type( aR ) == "string" or type( aR ) == "number" then
        return aR, tostring( h.label or h.name or aR )
    end
end
end
local function zr( Gr ) if Gr == "themes" then
    return type( C.theme ) == "table" and C.theme.Order or { "Citron", "Mint", "Blue", "Rose", "Violet", "Amber", "Custom" }
end
return( Hp.lists or {} )[ Gr ]
end

end

end

local function w( H ) return type( H ) == "number" and H == H and math.abs( H ) < math.huge
end
local function ln( H ) if not w( H ) then
    return "-"
end
for Fp, h in ipairs( { { 1000000000000, "T" }, { 1000000000, "B" }, { 1000000, "M" }, { 1000, "K" } } ) do
    if math.abs( H ) >= h[ 1 ] then
        return string.format( "%.1f", H / h[ 1 ] ):gsub( "%.0$", "" ) .. h[ 2 ]
    end
end
return tostring( math.floor( H ) )
end
local function sn( mR, XR ) local vr = ZI and ZI.CurrentCamera local Z = vr and vr.ViewportSize if Z and w( Z.X ) and w( Z.Y ) then
    local YB, tB = jW.Size.X.Offset * .5, jW.Size.Y.Offset * .5 mR = math.max( YB + 12, math.min( Z.X - YB - 12, mR ) ) XR = math.max( tB + 12, math.min( Z.Y - tB - 12, XR ) )
end

function gV.Money( WV ) return gV.Finite( WV ) and WV >= 0
end
function gV.Number( WV ) if gV.Finite( WV ) then
    return WV
end
if type( WV ) == "string" and # WV <= 120 then
    local Lp = tonumber( WV );
    if gV.Finite( Lp ) then
        return Lp
    end
    local g, P = WV:match( "^%s*([%+%-]?[%d%.]+)%s*,%s*([%+%-]?%d+)%s*$" ) g, P = tonumber( g ), tonumber( P ) if gV.Finite( g ) and gV.Finite( P ) then
        local H = g * 10 ^ P;
        if gV.Finite( H ) then
            return H
        end
    end
end
if type( WV ) == "table" and gV.Finite( WV.first ) and gV.Finite( WV.second ) then
    local H = WV.first * 10 ^ WV.second;
    if gV.Finite( H ) then
        return H
    end
end
end
function gV.CanSpend( kg, fC, IV, na, n6 ) if not gV.Money( kg ) then
    return false, "Waiting for the native coin balance."
end
if not gV.Money( fC ) then
    return false, "Waiting for a verified coin price."
end
if fC == 0 then
    return true
end
local FI = math.max( 0, ( na.held or 0 ) - ( n6 or 0 ) ) if kg - FI - fC < ( IV.CashReserve or 0 ) and fC > 0 then
    return false, "Keeping your coin reserve."
end
if( IV.MaxPurchase or 0 ) > 0 and fC > IV.MaxPurchase then
    return false, "The single-purchase limit is lower than this price."
end
if( IV.SessionBudget or 0 ) > 0 and( na.spent or 0 ) + FI + fC > IV.SessionBudget then
    return false, "Session spending limit reached."
end
return true
end
function gV.BestWeight( IV, oB, na ) local kC, lL for Fp, bV in ipairs( IV.weights or {} ) do
    if gV.Finite( bV.power ) and bV.power > 0 then
        if bV.owned and( not kC or bV.power > kC.power ) then
            kC = bV
        end
        if not bV.owned and gV.CanSpend( IV.cash, bV.cost, oB, na ) and( not lL or bV.power > lL.power ) then
            lL = bV
        end
    end
end
if lL and kC and lL.power <= kC.power then
    lL = nil
end
return kC, lL
end
function gV.BestUpgrade( IV, oB, na, DA ) local oS for Fp, lp in ipairs( IV.slots or {} ) do
    if lp.kind == "Brainrot" and lp.usable ~= false and lp.guid and gV.Finite( lp.level ) and lp.level < math.min( oB.MaxBrainrotLevel or 75, IV.maxBrainrotLevel or 75 ) and gV.Money( lp.upgradeCost ) and gV.Finite( lp.income ) and gV.Finite( lp.nextIncome ) and lp.nextIncome > lp.income and not( DA and DA[ lp.guid ] ) and gV.CanSpend( IV.cash, lp.upgradeCost, oB, na ) then
        local ol = lp.upgradeCost == 0 and math.huge or( lp.nextIncome - lp.income ) / lp.upgradeCost if not oS or ol > oS.score or ol == oS.score and lp.id < oS.row.id then
            oS = { row = lp, score = ol }
        end
    end
end
return oS and oS.row
end
function gV.BestIncome( IV, DA ) local oS for Fp, lp in ipairs( IV.slots or {} ) do
    if lp.kind == "Brainrot" and lp.usable ~= false and gV.Money( lp.coins ) and lp.coins > 0 and not( DA and DA[ lp.id ] ) and( not oS or lp.coins > oS.coins or lp.coins == oS.coins and lp.id < oS.id ) then
        oS = lp
    end
end
return oS
end
function gV.CanRebirth( IV, oB ) return gV.Finite( IV.rebirth ) and gV.Finite( IV.maxRebirth ) and IV.rebirth < math.min( IV.maxRebirth, oB.MaxRebirth or 10 ) and gV.Finite( IV.kickPower ) and gV.Finite( IV.rebirthRequirement ) and IV.kickPower >= IV.rebirthRequirement and gV.Finite( IV.mastery ) and gV.Money( IV.rebirthMastery ) and IV.mastery >= IV.rebirthMastery
end
function gV.InventorySignature( IV ) local pL = {};
for Fp, lp in ipairs( IV.inventory or {} ) do
    pL[ # pL + 1 ] = table.concat( { tostring( lp.guid ), lp.name or "", tostring( lp.level or 1 ), lp.mutation or "" }, ":" )
end
table.sort( pL );
return tostring( IV.slotCapacity or 0 ) .. "|" .. table.concat( pL, "|" )
end
function gV.NeedsBest( IV, na ) return # IV.inventory > 0 and gV.InventorySignature( IV ) ~= na.bestInventory
end
return gV
end

local y6 = ( function() local PV = {} function PV.Create( aV ) local ER, na = {}, aV.store;
local gH = false na.spent, na.held = na.spent or 0, na.held or 0;
na.cooldowns = na.cooldowns or {} na.unresolved = na.unresolved or {} local function IB() return aV.clock()
end
local function Pa() return not gH and aV.isCurrent() == true
end
local function xr( SV, iR, rW ) local ks = na.pending == SV if not ks and na.unresolved[ SV.key ] ~= SV then
    return
end
if not SV.released then
    na.held = math.max( 0, na.held - SV.cost );
    SV.released = true
end
if iR == "confirmed" then
    na.spent = na.spent + SV.cost
end
na.last = { key = SV.key, kind = SV.kind, target = SV.target, result = iR, reason = rW, at = IB(), before = SV.before } na.cooldowns[ SV.key ] = IB() + ( iR == "confirmed" and( SV.cooldown or .7 ) or 8 ) if ks then
    na.pending = nil
else
    na.unresolved[ SV.key ] = nil
end
end
function ER.Poll( IV ) for Fp, XV in pairs( na.unresolved ) do
    if IV and type( XV.receipt ) == "function" then
        local u, iR, rW = pcall( XV.receipt, IV, XV );
        if u and iR == true then
            xr( XV, "confirmed", rW )
        end
    end
end
local SV = na.pending;
if not SV then
    return false
end
if SV.started and IV and type( SV.receipt ) == "function" then
    local u, iR, rW = pcall( SV.receipt, IV, SV ) if u and iR == true then
        xr( SV, "confirmed", rW );
        return false
    end
    if u and iR == "unchanged" and SV.retrySafe == true and SV.cost == 0 and SV.finished and( SV.result == "awaiting" or SV.result == "uncertain" ) then
        xr( SV, "unconfirmed", rW );
        return false
    end
end
if SV.finished and( SV.result == "cancelled" or SV.result == "rejected" ) then
    xr( SV, SV.result, SV.reason );
    return false
end
if SV.started and SV.finished and IB() - SV.at >= 20 then
    na.unresolved[ SV.key ] = SV;
    na.pending = nil;
    SV.deferredAt = IB();
    return false
end
return true, IB() - SV.at > 20 and "Waiting for authoritative confirmation. This request will not be duplicated." or "Confirming " .. SV.label .. "."
end
function ER.Dispatch( g, IV, oB ) if not Pa() or aV.canRun() ~= true or na.pending then
    return false, "Another action is pending."
end
if type( g ) ~= "table" or type( g.key ) ~= "string" or type( g.run ) ~= "function" or type( g.guard ) ~= "function" or type( g.receipt ) ~= "function" then
    return false, "Incomplete action contract."
end
if na.unresolved[ g.key ] then
    return false, "An earlier request for this target is reserved; no duplicate will be sent."
end
if IB() < ( na.cooldowns[ g.key ] or 0 ) then
    return false, "Waiting before the next request."
end
local lL, Ws = aV.Planner.CanSpend( IV.cash, g.cost, oB, na );
if not lL then
    return false, Ws
end
local u, pw = pcall( g.guard, IV, false );
if not u or pw ~= true then
    return false, "The target changed before dispatch."
end
local SV = { key = g.key, kind = g.kind, target = g.target, label = g.label or g.kind, cost = g.cost, at = IB(), receipt = g.receipt, before = g.before, retrySafe = g.retrySafe, cooldown = g.cooldown, started = false } na.pending = SV;
na.held = na.held + SV.cost aV.spawn( function() if not Pa() or aV.canRun() ~= true then
    SV.result, SV.finished = "cancelled", true;
    return
end
local e0, aj = pcall( g.guard, nil, true, SV.cost ) if not e0 or aj ~= true or not Pa() or aV.canRun() ~= true then
    SV.result, SV.finished = "cancelled", true;
    return
end
SV.started = true;
SV.sentAt = IB() local mF, iR, rW = pcall( g.run ) if mF and iR == "rejected" then
    SV.result, SV.reason = "rejected", rW
elseif mF then
    SV.result = "awaiting"
else
    SV.result, SV.reason = "uncertain", "Transport outcome is unknown; waiting for native data."
end
SV.finished = true
end
) return true
end
function ER.Close() gH = true;
local SV = na.pending if SV and not SV.started then
    SV.result, SV.finished = "cancelled", true;
    ER.Poll( nil )
end
end
function ER.BlockedTargets( ta ) local SG = {} for Fp, SV in pairs( na.unresolved ) do
    if SV.kind == ta then
        if type( SV.before ) == "table" and SV.before.guid then
            SG[ SV.before.guid ] = true
        else
            SG[ SV.target or SV.key ] = true
        end
    end
end
return SG
end
function ER.Locked( x ) return na.unresolved[ x ] ~= nil
end
return ER
end
return PV
end
)()

function tV.Validate( x, H ) if x == "MovementMode" and H == "Walk / climb" then
    return "Tween (test)"
end
if tV.Active[ x ] or xo[ x ] then
    if type( H ) == "boolean" then
        return H
    end
    ;
    return
end
local iS = cP[ x ] if iS and type( H ) == "number" and H == H and math.abs( H ) < math.huge then
    return math.floor( math.max( iS[ 1 ], math.min( iS[ 2 ], H ) ) )
end
if YI[ x ] then
    return type( H ) == "string" and YI[ x ][ H ] and H or nil
end
if x == "TrainingChoice" then
    return type( H ) == "string" and # H > 0 and # H < 80 and H:match( "^[%w _%-]+$" ) and H or nil
end
if x == "customAccent" then
    return type( H ) == "string" and H:match( "^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$" ) and H:upper() or nil
end
end
function tV.Create( aV ) local ER = {} function ER.Load( IV ) for x in pairs( tV.Active ) do
    IV[ x ] = false
end
if type( aV.reader ) ~= "function" then
    return false
end
local u, tW = pcall( aV.reader, tV.Path ) if not u or type( tW ) ~= "string" or # tW > 32768 then
    return false
end
local yW, fW = pcall( aV.HttpService.JSONDecode, aV.HttpService, tW ) if not yW or type( fW ) ~= "table" or fW.version ~= 1 or type( fW.settings ) ~= "table" then
    return false
end
for Fp, x in ipairs( bF ) do
    local H = tV.Validate( x, fW.settings[ x ] );
    if H ~= nil then
        IV[ x ] = H
    end
end
return true
end
function ER.Save( IV ) if type( aV.writer ) ~= "function" then
    return false, "Local saving is unavailable."
end
local oB = {};
for Fp, x in ipairs( bF ) do
    oB[ x ] = tV.Validate( x, IV[ x ] )
end
local u, tW = pcall( aV.HttpService.JSONEncode, aV.HttpService, { version = 1, settings = oB } ) if not u or type( tW ) ~= "string" then
    return false, "Could not encode preferences."
end
local DP, H = pcall( aV.writer, tV.Path, tW ) return DP and H ~= false, DP and H ~= false and "Preferences saved." or "Could not save preferences."
end
return ER
end
return tV
end

function gV.BoulderEnvelope( VB ) local nR, RZ, Oc = VB:GetAttribute( "Radius" ), VB:GetAttribute( "Drop" ), VB:GetAttribute( "SweepHalf" ) local K8, bJ, b8 = VB:GetAttribute( "Land" ), VB:GetAttribute( "RollTo" ), VB:GetAttribute( "SinkTo" ) local function pw( KV ) return KV and gV.Finite( KV.X ) and gV.Finite( KV.Y ) and gV.Finite( KV.Z )

local function h8( g, P, ZR ) local Zp, Zc = 0, 1 for Fp, WB in ipairs( { "X", "Z" } ) do

    local AS = WB == "X" and ZR.x2 or ZR.z2 if math.abs( zS ) < .00001 then
        if g[ WB ] < FX or g[ WB ] > AS then
            return
        end
    else
        local t8, U8 = ( FX - g[ WB ] ) / zS, ( AS - g[ WB ] ) / zS if t8 > U8 then
            t8, U8 = U8, t8
        end
        Zp = math.max( Zp, t8 );

        end
    end
end

function gV.AvoidTransitPad( Kl, La, VB, ez, ua ) local ZR = { x1 = math.huge, x2 = - math.huge, z1 = math.huge, z2 = - math.huge } for Fp, mR in ipairs( { - 1, 1 } ) do

function gV.Overfly( Kl, La, oD, ez ) for Fp, ZR in ipairs( oD ) do

local function H8( g, P, VB ) local Zp, Zc = 0, 1 local SV, OV = VB.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace( g ), VB.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace( P ) for Fp, WB in ipairs( { "X", "Y", "Z" } ) do

        if math.abs( SV[ WB ] ) >= Z then

        end

        end

        end
    end
end

end

local function w( H ) return type( H ) == "number" and H == H and math.abs( H ) < math.huge
end
local function ln( H ) if not w( H ) then
    return "-"
end
for Fp, h in ipairs( { { 1000000000000, "T" }, { 1000000000, "B" }, { 1000000, "M" }, { 1000, "K" } } ) do
    if math.abs( H ) >= h[ 1 ] then
        return string.format( "%.1f", H / h[ 1 ] ):gsub( "%.0$", "" ) .. h[ 2 ]
    end
end
return tostring( math.floor( H ) )
end
