end
function ER.Pulse( IV, ia, j, Lu ) cK();
local yR = Do if not al( IV, Lu ) or ia.Magnitude < .01 then
    return false
end
local FR = { s = IV, direction = ia / ia.Magnitude, untilAt = aV.clock() + math.min( .8, math.max( .1, j ) ), flag = Lu } if not app( FR ) then
    return false
end
while bA == FR and Do == yR and al( IV, Lu ) and aV.clock() < FR.untilAt do
    aV.task.wait( .04 )
end
local pw = Do == yR and al( IV, Lu ) if bA == FR then
    bQ( "pulse finished" )
end
return pw
end
function ER.MoveTo( IV, qS, Lu, j, xr ) cK();
return Bi( IV, { { Position = qS } }, Lu, aV.clock() + math.max( .5, j or 4 ), xr, nil, nil, nil, Do )
end
function ER.Run( IV, qS, Lu, C ) cK();
local yR = Do;
C = C or {} local PS = Ga( qS - IV.root.Position ).Magnitude local lO = math.max( 1, tonumber( IV.humanoid.WalkSpeed ) or 16 ) local eS = aV.clock() + math.min( 240, math.max( 12, PS / lO * 3 + 10 ) ) local rW = "no path" for pi = 1, 3 do
    if yR ~= Do or not al( IV, Lu, C.guard ) then
        return false, "canceled"
    end
    if C.finish then
        local u, H = pcall( C.finish );
        if u and H then
            return true, "arrived"
        end
    end
    local Kl, KW = { { Position = qS } }, nil if aV.pathfinding and type( aV.pathfinding.CreatePath ) == "function" then
        local u, iR = pcall( function() local SV = aV.pathfinding:CreatePath( { AgentRadius = C.mounted and 3 or 2, AgentHeight = 5, AgentCanJump = true, WaypointSpacing = 6 } ) KW = SV;
        SV:ComputeAsync( IV.root.Position, qS ) if not tostring( SV.Status ):match( "Success$" ) then
            return nil
        end
        return SV:GetWaypoints()
    end
    ) if not u or type( iR ) ~= "table" or # iR == 0 then
        Kl = nil
    else
        Kl = iR
    end
end
local function Spp() if KW then
    pcall( KW.Destroy, KW );
    KW = nil
end
end
if yR ~= Do or not al( IV, Lu, C.guard ) then
    Spp();
    return false, "canceled"
end
if aV.clock() >= eS then
    Spp();
    return false, "timeout"
end
if Kl then
    local u;
    u, rW = Bi( IV, Kl, Lu, eS, C.finish, C.guard, KW, C.radius, yR ) Spp() if u then
        return true, "arrived"
    end
    if rW ~= "blocked" and rW ~= "stalled" then
        return false, rW
    end
end
Spp() if pi < 3 then
    aV.task.wait( .15 )
end
end
return false, rW
end
function ER.Stop() cK();
n = false
end
function ER.Diagnostics() return { active = bA ~= nil, reason = eo, point = bA and bA.index or nil }
end
return ER
end
return Rpp
end

function ER.FindCage( IV ) local hu = IV.configs.PathConfig and IV.configs.PathConfig.Paths local opp = IV.configs.CageConfig and IV.configs.CageConfig.Cages if type( hu ) ~= "table" or type( opp ) ~= "table" then
    return nil, "Waiting for the native biome and cage settings."
end
local Ks = nm( ZI, "Paths" ) local dpp = {} local WD, Fpp = false, false for Fp, KW in pairs( QX( Ks ) ) do
    local aR = Zpp( KW ) local pRp = aR and hu[ aR ] local kt = pRp and tonumber( pRp.SpeedNeeded ) or math.huge local Y0 = nm( KW, "Boss" ) local RRp = Y0 and Y0:GetAttribute( "State" ) == "Sleeping" local Ph = Hp.CageMode ~= "Selected biome" or Hp.SelectedPath == aR if aR and pRp and Ph and IV.speed >= kt then
        if not Y0 then
            WD = true
        elseif not RRp then
            Fpp = true
        end
    end
    if aR and pRp and RRp and Ph and IV.speed >= kt then
        local oS = nil for Fp, VRp in pairs( QX( nm( KW, "Cages" ) ) ) do
            local SB = nm( VRp, "Root" ) local OQ = nm( SB, "StealPrompt" ) local ta = VRp:GetAttribute( "Kind" ) or VRp.Name:gsub( "Cage$", "" ) local WRp = opp[ ta ] local aRp = true;
            local fZ = IV.configs.WorldConfig and IV.configs.WorldConfig.Worlds if SB and SB:IsA( "BasePart" ) and type( fZ ) == "table" then
                local yK, SRp for YD, bV in pairs( fZ ) do
                    if bV.Origin then
                        local up = ( SB.Position - bV.Origin ).Magnitude if not SRp or up < SRp then
                            yK = tonumber( YD );
                            SRp = up
                        end
                    end
                end
                if yK then
                    aRp = yK == ( IV.world or 1 )
                end
            end
            if not SB or not SB:IsA( "BasePart" ) or not OQ then
                WD = true
            end
            if SB and SB:IsA( "BasePart" ) and aRp and OQ and OQ:IsA( "ProximityPrompt" ) and WRp and Epp( OQ, "Steal" ) then
                local WA = tonumber( WRp.Order ) or 0 if not oS or WA > oS.order then
                    oS = { cage = VRp, root = SB, prompt = OQ, kind = ta, order = WA, path = aR, needed = kt }
                end
            end
        end
        if oS then
            dpp[ aR ] = oS
        end
    end
end
if Hp.CageMode == "Selected biome" and dpp[ Hp.SelectedPath ] then
    return dpp[ Hp.SelectedPath ]
end
local pL = {} for aR in pairs( dpp ) do
    pL[ # pL + 1 ] = aR
end
table.sort( pL, function( g, P ) return g > P
end
) if # pL > 0 then
    return dpp[ pL[ 1 ] ]
end
return nil, WD and "Waiting for the cage root and its native Steal prompt to load." or Fpp and "Waiting for an eligible boss to fall asleep." or "No eligible cage is ready for your current speed and biome selection."
end
function ER.Steal( IV, qS ) local Lu = Hp.AutoFarm and "AutoFarm" or "AutoSteal" if not ER.Same( IV, Lu ) then
    return false, "Stealing is disabled."
end
ER.ObserveCarry( IV ) if ER.CarryStatus( IV ) ~= "none" then
    return false, "Finish the existing carry transition first."
end
local mp if Hp.AutoFarm then
    if tpp.opening or tpp.placement or tpp.taking or ER.Unplaced( IV, "Cage" ) then
        return false, "Finish the current inventory item first."
    end
    local bw, Ws = ER.FreeStall( IV ) if not bw then
        return false, Ws
    end
    mp = Ws
end
if not qS or not qS.cage.Parent or not qS.prompt.Parent or qS.root.Parent ~= qS.cage then
    return false, "The cage changed."
end
xpp( IV ) local im = nm( TI, "Cages" ) if not im then
    return false, "Waiting for the owned cage inventory."
end
local KW = nm( nm( ZI, "Paths" ), "Path" .. tostring( qS.path ) );
local Y0 = nm( KW, "Boss" ) local EB = qS.root.Position local function kk() return ER.Same( IV, Lu ) and qS.cage.Parent ~= nil and qS.root.Parent == qS.cage and qS.prompt.Parent == qS.root and Epp( qS.prompt, "Steal" ) and Y0 and Y0.Parent == KW and Y0:GetAttribute( "State" ) == "Sleeping" and( tonumber( TI:GetAttribute( "Speed" ) ) or - 1 ) >= qS.needed and( qS.root.Position - EB ).Magnitude < 3
end
if not kk() then
    return false, "The cage, boss or biome eligibility changed."
end
local aj, Ws = ER.PrepareRun( IV, Lu ) if not aj then
    return false, Ws
end
if not cpp( IV, qS.prompt ) then
    local cS = KW and KW:GetAttribute( "Origin" ) if typeof( cS ) == "CFrame" then
        local ORp = cS:PointToObjectSpace( EB ) local Rp = math.max( 3, ( Lp( IV.humanoid.HipHeight ) or 2 ) + IV.root.Size.Y * .5 ) local IRp = ( cS * Ipp.new( 0, Rp, ORp.Z ) ).Position local ON, rW = ER.RunTo( IV, IRp, Lu, { guard = kk, finish = function() return cpp( IV, qS.prompt )
    end
    } ) if not ON then
        return false, "Center approach stopped: " .. tostring( rW ) .. "."
    end
end
end
local zS = EB - IV.root.Position;
local Ga = MV.new( zS.X, 0, zS.Z ) local ia = Ga.Magnitude > .01 and Ga / Ga.Magnitude or MV.new( 0, 0, - 1 ) local nK = EB - ia * 4.5 local ON, rW = ER.RunTo( IV, nK, Lu, { guard = kk, radius = 1.2, finish = function() return cpp( IV, qS.prompt )
end
} ) if not ON then
    return false, "Cage approach stopped: " .. tostring( rW ) .. "."
end
if not kk() then
    return false, "The cage, boss or biome eligibility changed."
end
if Hp.AutoFarm and not ER.FreeStall( IV ) then
    return false, "Barn capacity changed before pickup; no prompt was sent."
end
if jpp( IV ) then
    return false, "A carry appeared while approaching; checking its native receipt."
end
local tH = Tpp( nm( TI, "Cages" ) ) local BRp = IV.character:GetAttribute( "HoldingCage" ) local mRp = TI:GetAttribute( "CarryingCage" ) local function MF() local epp = IV.character:GetAttribute( "HoldingCage" ) local aR = TI:GetAttribute( "CarryingCage" ) return zpp( nm( TI, "Cages" ), tH ) or( Gpp( epp ) and epp ~= BRp and not qS.cage.Parent ) or( Gpp( aR ) and aR ~= mRp )
end
local lA = upp( IV, false, qS.kind, tH );
lA.target = qS.cage;
lA.index = mp;
Upp( lA ) local u, ha = Mpp( IV, qS.prompt, "Steal", Lu, MF ) ER.ObserveCarry( IV ) if u then
    if jpp( IV ) then
        return true, "Cage picked up; returning home before claiming it."
    end
    return u, ha
end
if jpp( IV ) then
    lA.provisional = true;
    return false, "Pickup has no owned cage receipt yet.", "confirming"
end
if Ypp == lA then
    Upp( nil )
end
return u, ha
end
function ER.FieldGate( IV ) local xZ = IV.configs.PathConfig or {};
local fZ = xZ.Worlds or {} local Sh = fZ[ IV.world ] or fZ[ tostring( IV.world ) ] local Zp = type( Sh ) == "table" and tonumber( Sh.First ) if not Zp then
    for aR, yu in pairs( xZ.Paths or {} ) do
        local WV = tonumber( aR ) if WV and type( yu ) == "table" and( tonumber( yu.World ) or 1 ) == IV.world and( not Zp or WV < Zp ) then
            Zp = WV
        end
    end
end
local KW = Zp and nm( nm( ZI, "Paths" ), "Path" .. tostring( Zp ) ) local cS = KW and KW:GetAttribute( "Origin" ) if typeof( cS ) ~= "CFrame" then
    return nil
end
local Fc = xZ.Lanes and( xZ.Lanes[ IV.world ] or xZ.Lanes[ tostring( IV.world ) ] ) local d = Lp( Fc and Fc.Width ) or Lp( xZ.LaneWidth ) if not d or d <= 8 then
    return nil
end
local Rp = math.max( 3, ( Lp( IV.humanoid.HipHeight ) or 2 ) + IV.root.Size.Y * .5 ) local nK = ( cS * Ipp.new( 0, Rp, - 6 ) ).Position return { position = nK, valid = function() return KW.Parent == nm( ZI, "Paths" ) and KW:GetAttribute( "Origin" ) == cS
end
, crossed = function() local SV = cS:PointToObjectSpace( IV.root.Position ) return math.abs( SV.X ) < d * .5 and SV.Z < - 1 and TI:GetAttribute( "InSafeZone" ) == true
end
}
end
function ER.HomeRoute( IV ) local lr = IV.plot.PrimaryPart;
local XRp = nm( IV.plot, "Barn" ) if not lr or not lr:IsA( "BasePart" ) or not XRp then
    return nil, "Waiting for your barn entrance."
end
local KRp, KS = Lp( XRp:GetAttribute( "Front" ) ), Lp( XRp:GetAttribute( "Back" ) ) local NE = Lp( XRp:GetAttribute( "Half" ) );
local RS = Lp( XRp:GetAttribute( "CentreX" ) ) or 0 if not KRp or not KS or not NE or NE < 3 or KS - KRp < 6 then
    return nil, "Waiting for the native barn boundaries."
end
local Rp = lr.Size.Y * .5 + ( Lp( IV.humanoid.HipHeight ) or 2 ) + IV.root.Size.Y * .5 + .2 local h = lr.CFrame * Ipp.new( RS, Rp, KRp - 3 ) local qI = lr.CFrame * Ipp.new( RS, Rp, KRp + math.min( 8, ( KS - KRp ) * .35 ) ) return { entry = Ipp.lookAt( h.Position, qI.Position ), inside = qI.Position, primary = lr, barn = XRp, center = RS, half = NE, front = KRp, back = KS }
end
function ER.InBarn( IV, fE ) local lr = IV.plot.PrimaryPart if not lr or( fE and( fE.primary ~= lr or fE.barn.Parent ~= IV.plot ) ) then
    return false
end
local SV = lr.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace( IV.root.Position ) for Fp, Cp in ipairs( { "Barn", "Barn2" } ) do
    local XRp = nm( IV.plot, Cp ) local NE = XRp and Lp( XRp:GetAttribute( "Half" ) );
    local KRp = XRp and Lp( XRp:GetAttribute( "Front" ) ) local KS = XRp and Lp( XRp:GetAttribute( "Back" ) );
    local RS = XRp and Lp( XRp:GetAttribute( "CentreX" ) ) or 0 if NE and KRp and KS and math.abs( SV.X - RS ) < NE + 1 and SV.Z > KRp + 1 and SV.Z < KS + 1 then
        return true
    end
end
return false
end
function ER.AcknowledgeCarry( IV ) if not ER.Same( IV ) then
    return nil
end
ER.ObserveCarry( IV ) local YW = ER.CarryStatus( IV ) if YW == "received" or YW == "settled" or YW == "lost" then
    if YW == "lost" and Ypp and( Ypp.provisional or Ypp.knockedUntil ) then
        tpp.ignorePose = true
    end
    Upp( nil );
    return YW
end
return nil
end
function ER.ReturnHome( IV ) local Lu = Hp.AutoFarm and "AutoFarm" or "AutoSteal" if not ER.Same( IV, Lu ) then
    return false, "Return was canceled."
end
ER.ObserveCarry( IV ) local YW = ER.CarryStatus( IV ) if YW == "received" then
    Upp( nil );
    return true, "Owned cage received; continuing the cycle.", "received"
end
if YW == "settled" or YW == "lost" then
    if Ypp and( Ypp.provisional or Ypp.knockedUntil ) then
        tpp.ignorePose = true
    end
    Upp( nil );
    return false, "Carry ended without a new owned cage. Rechecking barn capacity.", YW
end
if YW == "confirming" then
    return false, "Pickup has not been confirmed by native ownership.", "pending"
end
if YW == "none" then
    return false, "No carried cage is pending."
end
if YW == "carrying" then
    local sk = ER.FieldGate( IV ) if sk then
        if not sk.crossed() then
            local aj, Ws = ER.PrepareRun( IV, Lu ) if not aj then
                return false, Ws
            end
            local ON, rW = ER.RunTo( IV, sk.position, Lu, { guard = sk.valid, finish = function() return not jpp( IV ) or sk.crossed()
        end
        } ) if not ON then
            return false, "Run to the field exit stopped: " .. tostring( rW ) .. "."
        end
    end
else
    local fE, Ws = ER.HomeRoute( IV ) if not fE then
        return false, Ws
    end
    if not ER.InBarn( IV, fE ) then
        local aj, Ws = ER.PrepareRun( IV, Lu ) if not aj then
            return false, Ws
        end
        local C = { guard = function() return fE.primary == IV.plot.PrimaryPart and fE.barn.Parent == IV.plot
    end
    , finish = function() return not jpp( IV )
end
} local ON, rW = ER.RunTo( IV, fE.entry.Position, Lu, C ) if not ON then
    return false, "Run to your barn stopped: " .. tostring( rW ) .. "."
end
local ic = true if jpp( IV ) then
    ic = ER.RunTo( IV, fE.inside, Lu, C )
end
if not ic and jpp( IV ) then
    return false, "Could not cross your barn entrance; movement stopped."
end
end
end
end
local eS = kX() + 3 while ER.Same( IV, Lu ) and kX() < eS do
    ER.ObserveCarry( IV );
    local IB = ER.CarryStatus( IV ) if IB == "received" then
        Upp( nil );
        return true, "Owned cage received; continuing the cycle.", "received"
    end
    if IB == "settled" or IB == "lost" then
        if Ypp and( Ypp.provisional or Ypp.knockedUntil ) then
            tpp.ignorePose = true
        end
        Upp( nil );
        return false, "Carry ended without a new owned cage. Rechecking barn capacity.", IB
    end
    Hpp( .08 )
end
return false, jpp( IV ) and "Inside your barn; delivery is not confirmed yet." or "Carry cleared; waiting for owned inventory data.", "pending"
end
local function bRp( IV, qRp ) local AI = {} local YRp = qRp and { qRp } or { "Barn", "Barn2" } for Fp, Cp in pairs( YRp ) do
    local XRp = nm( IV.plot, Cp ) for Fp, hRp in pairs( QX( nm( XRp, "Stalls" ) ) ) do
        AI[ # AI + 1 ] = hRp
    end
end
table.sort( AI, function( g, P ) return( tonumber( g:GetAttribute( "Index" ) ) or tonumber( g.Name:match( "%d+" ) ) or 0 ) < ( tonumber( P:GetAttribute( "Index" ) ) or tonumber( P.Name:match( "%d+" ) ) or 0 )
end
) return AI
end
local function BJ( IV, tRp ) local wC, qw, URp = {}, {}, 0 for Fp, im in pairs( { nm( TI, "Pets" ), nm( TI, "Cages" ) } ) do
    for Fp, c in pairs( QX( im ) ) do
        local hRp = tonumber( c:GetAttribute( "Stall" ) ) if hRp then
            wC[ hRp ] = true;
            qw[ c.Name ] = hRp
        end
    end
end
local AI = bRp( IV ) for Fp, im in pairs( { nm( IV.plot, "Pets" ), nm( IV.plot, "Cages" ) } ) do
    for Fp, c in pairs( QX( im ) ) do
        local mp = tonumber( c:GetAttribute( "Stall" ) ) or qw[ c.Name ] if not mp then
            local Pr = c:GetAttribute( "Home" );
            local LZ = typeof( Pr ) == "CFrame" and Pr.Position or nil if LZ then
                for Fp, hRp in pairs( AI ) do
                    local zS = LZ - hRp.Position if math.abs( zS.X ) < hRp.Size.X * .5 + .2 and math.abs( zS.Z ) < hRp.Size.Z * .5 + .2 then
                        mp = tonumber( hRp:GetAttribute( "Index" ) ) or tonumber( hRp.Name:match( "%d+" ) );
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if mp then
            wC[ mp ] = true
        else
            URp = URp + 1
        end
    end
end
for Fp, lA in pairs( { tpp.opening or false, tpp.placement or false, tpp.transfer or false, tpp.taking or false } ) do
    if type( lA ) == "table" and lA.index and lA.id ~= tRp then
        wC[ lA.index ] = true
    end
end
return wC, URp
end
function ER.FreeStall( IV, tRp ) local wC, URp = BJ( IV, tRp ) if URp > 0 then
    return nil, "Waiting for the native stall assignment of a placed pet."
end
local AI = bRp( IV ) for Fp, hRp in pairs( AI ) do
    local mp = tonumber( hRp:GetAttribute( "Index" ) ) or tonumber( hRp.Name:match( "%d+" ) ) if mp and hRp:GetAttribute( "Owned" ) == true and not wC[ mp ] then
        return hRp, mp
    end
end
return nil, "Barn full. All owned stalls are occupied; no pet is replaced."
end
local function lRp( hRp, CW ) if CW then
    for Fp, iQ in pairs( QX( hRp ) ) do
        if iQ.Name == "PenPromptAnchor" then
            for Fp, OQ in pairs( QX( iQ ) ) do
                if OQ:IsA( "ProximityPrompt" ) and OQ.Name == "PenPrompt" and OQ.ActionText == CW then
                    return OQ
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local iQ = nm( hRp, "PenPromptAnchor" ) local OQ = nm( iQ, "PenPrompt" ) if OQ and OQ:IsA( "ProximityPrompt" ) then
    return OQ
end
return nil
end
function ER.PrepareTake( IV ) local Lu = Hp.AutoFarm and "AutoFarm" or "AutoTakePets" if not ER.Same( IV, Lu ) then
    return false, "Taking pets is disabled."
end
if Hp.AutoFarm or Hp.AutoTrain or Hp.AutoRide or Hp.AutoSteal then
    local u, Ws, rW = ER.RideBest( IV, Lu ) if not u and rW ~= "noPet" then
        return false, Ws
    end
end
return true
end
function ER.FindTakePet( IV ) local Ppp = TI:GetAttribute( "RidingPet" ) local rX, fx local AI = bRp( IV ) for Fp, c in pairs( QX( nm( TI, "Pets" ) ) ) do
    local mp = tonumber( c:GetAttribute( "Stall" ) ) if mp and c:GetAttribute( "Kind" ) then
        if c.Name == Ppp then
            fx = true
        else
            for Fp, hRp in pairs( AI ) do
                local aR = tonumber( hRp:GetAttribute( "Index" ) ) or tonumber( hRp.Name:match( "%d+" ) ) if aR == mp and hRp:GetAttribute( "Owned" ) == true then
                    if not rX or mp < rX.index or( mp == rX.index and c.Name < rX.id ) then
                        rX = { id = c.Name, item = c, index = mp, stall = hRp }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
return rX, fx and "Your riding pet stays placed; other pets are kept in inventory." or "No placed pets are ready to take."
end
function ER.PetTaken( IV, aR ) local c = nm( nm( TI, "Pets" ), aR ) if not c or not c:GetAttribute( "Kind" ) or c:GetAttribute( "Stall" ) ~= nil then
    return false
end
if nm( nm( IV.plot, "Pets" ), aR ) then
    return false
end
local Ij = nm( TI:FindFirstChildOfClass( "Backpack" ), aR ) or nm( IV.character, aR ) return Ij and Ij:IsA( "Tool" ) and Ij:GetAttribute( "PetKind" ) == c:GetAttribute( "Kind" ) or false
end
function ER.TakePet( IV, qS ) local Lu = Hp.AutoFarm and "AutoFarm" or "AutoTakePets" if not ER.Same( IV, Lu ) or not qS then
    return false, "Taking pets was canceled."
end
local function sRp() return ER.Same( IV, Lu ) and qS.item == nm( nm( TI, "Pets" ), qS.id ) and tonumber( qS.item:GetAttribute( "Stall" ) ) == qS.index and qS.stall.Parent and qS.stall:IsDescendantOf( IV.plot ) and qS.stall:GetAttribute( "Owned" ) == true and( tonumber( qS.stall:GetAttribute( "Index" ) ) or tonumber( qS.stall.Name:match( "%d+" ) ) ) == qS.index and TI:GetAttribute( "RidingPet" ) ~= qS.id
end
if not sRp() then
    return false, "The owned pet or stall changed."
end
xpp( IV ) if TI:GetAttribute( "OnTreadmill" ) == true and not ER.LeaveTrain() then
    return false, "Waiting to leave training."
end
local ON, rW = ER.RunTo( IV, qS.stall.Position, Lu, { guard = sRp, radius = 2 } ) if not ON then
    return false, "Pet approach stopped: " .. tostring( rW ) .. "."
end
local eS = kX() + 1.5;
local OQ repeat
    if not sRp() then
        return false, "The owned pet or stall changed."
    end
    OQ = lRp( qS.stall, "Take" ) if Epp( OQ, "Take" ) then
        break
    end
    Hpp( .08 )
until
kX() >= eS if not Epp( OQ, "Take" ) then
    return false, "Waiting for this pet stall's native Take prompt."
end
local u, ha = Mpp( IV, OQ, "Take", Lu, function() return ER.PetTaken( IV, qS.id )
end
) return u, ha, true
end
local function wRp( IV, c, ta, Lu ) local E5 = TI:FindFirstChildOfClass( "Backpack" ) local eS = kX() + 1.5 while ER.Same( IV, Lu ) and kX() < eS do
    local Ij = nm( E5, c.Name ) or nm( IV.character, c.Name ) local pK = ta == "Cage" and "CageKind" or "PetKind" if Ij and Ij:IsA( "Tool" ) and Ij:GetAttribute( pK ) == c:GetAttribute( "Kind" ) then
        qpp = { tool = Ij, character = IV.character, humanoid = IV.humanoid } pcall( IV.humanoid.EquipTool, IV.humanoid, Ij ) Hpp( .18 ) if ER.Same( IV, Lu ) and nm( IV.character, c.Name ) == Ij then
            return true
        end
    end
    Hpp( .08 )
end
return false
end
local function HRp( IV, hRp, Lu ) local nK = hRp.Position + MV.new( 0, hRp.Size.Y * .5 + 3.15, 0 ) if TI:GetAttribute( "Mounted" ) == true then
    if TI:GetAttribute( "OnTreadmill" ) == true and not ER.LeaveTrain() then
        return false
    end
    return ER.RunTo( IV, nK, Lu, { guard = function() return hRp.Parent ~= nil and hRp:IsDescendantOf( IV.plot ) and hRp:GetAttribute( "Owned" ) == true
end
} )
end
if not ER.Teleport( IV, Ipp.new( nK, nK + hRp.CFrame.LookVector ), Lu ) then
    return false
end
Hpp( .22 ) return true
end
function ER.Place( IV, c, ta ) local Lu = Hp.AutoFarm and "AutoFarm" or "AutoPlace" if not ER.Same( IV, Lu ) then
    return false, "Placement is disabled."
end
if not c or not c.Parent or c:GetAttribute( "Stall" ) then
    return false, "Already placed or unavailable."
end
local hRp, mp = ER.FreeStall( IV, c and c.Name ) if not hRp then
    return false, mp
end
if not wRp( IV, c, ta, Lu ) then
    return false, "Waiting for the exact item in the QuickBar."
end
if not HRp( IV, hRp, Lu ) then
    xpp( IV );
    return false, "Could not reach the owned stall."
end
local CRp, ARp = ER.FreeStall( IV, c.Name ) if not ER.Same( IV, Lu ) or CRp ~= hRp or ARp ~= mp then
    xpp( IV );
    return false, "The stall changed while approaching."
end
local OQ = lRp( hRp ) local eS = kX() + 1.2 while not Epp( OQ, "Place" ) and ER.Same( IV, Lu ) and kX() < eS do
    OQ = lRp( hRp );
    Hpp( .08 )
end
local function MF() local oH = nm( IV.plot, ta == "Cage" and "Cages" or "Pets" ) return c:GetAttribute( "Stall" ) ~= nil or( oH and nm( oH, c.Name ) ~= nil )
end
local u, ha = Mpp( IV, OQ, "Place", Lu, MF ) xpp( IV ) return u, ha, mp
end
function ER.Unplaced( IV, ta ) local im = ta == "Cage" and IV.cages or IV.pets local oS, rRp = nil, - math.huge for Fp, c in pairs( QX( im ) ) do
    if c:GetAttribute( "Kind" ) and not c:GetAttribute( "Stall" ) then
        local H = 0 if ta == "Pet" and IV.configs.PetStats and type( IV.configs.PetStats.Get ) == "function" then
            local u, y5 = pcall( IV.configs.PetStats.Get, c:GetAttribute( "Kind" ), c:GetAttribute( "Quality" ), TI ) H = u and tonumber( y5 ) or 0
        end
        if H > rRp or( H == rRp and oS and c.Name < oS.Name ) then
            oS, rRp = c, H
        end
    end
end
return oS
end
function ER.InventoryKeys( IV, ta ) return Tpp( nm( TI, ta == "Cage" and "Cages" or "Pets" ) )
end
function ER.Item( IV, ta, aR ) return nm( nm( TI, ta == "Cage" and "Cages" or "Pets" ), aR )
end
function ER.ItemPlaced( IV, ta, aR, mp ) local c = ER.Item( IV, ta, aR ) local hRp = c and tonumber( c:GetAttribute( "Stall" ) ) if hRp then
    return not mp or hRp == mp
end
local rB = nm( nm( IV.plot, ta == "Cage" and "Cages" or "Pets" ), aR ) return rB and tonumber( rB:GetAttribute( "Stall" ) ) == mp or false
end
function ER.OpenResult( IV, lA ) for Fp, nRp in pairs( QX( nm( TI, "Pets" ) ) ) do
    local mp = tonumber( nRp:GetAttribute( "Stall" ) ) if not lA.before[ nRp.Name ] and nRp:GetAttribute( "Kind" ) and( mp == lA.index or mp == nil ) then
        return nRp
    end
end
return nil
end
function ER.OpenStillActive( IV, lA ) local c = ER.Item( IV, "Cage", lA.id ) local rB = nm( nm( IV.plot, "Cages" ), lA.id ) local rm = rB or c return rm and( rm:GetAttribute( "Opening" ) == true or rm:GetAttribute( "Result" ) ~= nil ) or false
end
local function yRp( VRp ) local H = VRp:GetAttribute( "Result" ) return H ~= nil and H ~= false and H ~= ""
end
function ER.ReadyCage( IV ) local iR = nil for Fp, VRp in pairs( QX( nm( IV.plot, "Cages" ) ) ) do
    local fRp = tonumber( VRp:GetAttribute( "ReadyAt" ) ) local Cr = VRp:GetAttribute( "Opening" ) == true local aj = ( fRp and IV.serverTime > 0 and fRp <= IV.serverTime ) or yRp( VRp ) if not Cr and not yRp( VRp ) and aj then
        if not iR or( fRp or math.huge ) < ( iR.readyAt or math.huge ) then
            iR = { cage = VRp, readyAt = fRp }
        end
    end
end
return iR and iR.cage or nil
end
local function QRp( IV, VRp ) local T = nm( IV.cages, VRp.Name ) local mp = tonumber( VRp:GetAttribute( "Stall" ) ) or( T and tonumber( T:GetAttribute( "Stall" ) ) ) local AI = bRp( IV ) for Fp, hRp in pairs( AI ) do
    local WV = tonumber( hRp:GetAttribute( "Index" ) ) or tonumber( hRp.Name:match( "%d+" ) ) if mp and WV == mp then
        return hRp
    end
end
return nil
end
function ER.Hatch( IV, VRp ) local Lu = Hp.AutoFarm and "AutoFarm" or "AutoHatch" if not ER.Same( IV, Lu ) then
    return false, "Hatching is disabled."
end
if not VRp or not VRp.Parent or VRp:GetAttribute( "Opening" ) == true or yRp( VRp ) then
    return false, "This cage is not ready."
end
local fRp = tonumber( VRp:GetAttribute( "ReadyAt" ) ) if fRp and( IV.serverTime <= 0 or fRp > IV.serverTime ) then
    return false, "The cage is still charging."
end
local hRp = QRp( IV, VRp ) if not hRp then

        oH = true if type( IV.configs.PetStats.Get ) == "function" then
            local u, y5, ez = pcall( IV.configs.PetStats.Get, nRp:GetAttribute( "Kind" ), nRp:GetAttribute( "Quality" ), TI ) ez = u and Lp( tonumber( ez ) ) or nil if ez and( ez > PRp or( ez == PRp and oS and nRp.Name < oS ) ) then
                oS, PRp = nRp.Name, ez
            end

    return true, "Already riding the best pet."

end
return false, "No ride receipt."

function ER.IndexReady( IV ) local mp = nm( TI, "Index" ) local NRp = nm( TI, "IndexPrizes" ) for Fp, c in pairs( QX( mp ) ) do
    if c:GetAttribute( "Claimed" ) == false then
        return { item = c }
    end
end
local dpp = IV.configs.PetConfig.KindsByPath or {} for KW, opp in pairs( dpp ) do
    if type( opp ) == "table" and not nm( NRp, tostring( KW ) ) then
        local KH = type( opp ) == "table" and # opp > 0 for Fp, ta in pairs( opp ) do
            if not nm( mp, ta ) then
                KH = false;
                break
            end
        end
        if KH then
            return { prize = KW }
        end
    end
end
local oRp = nm( TI, "SpookyIndex" ) local uRp = nm( TI, "SpookyPrizes" ) if oRp and type( IV.configs.IndexConfig.Spooky ) == "table" then
    for Fp, c in pairs( QX( oRp ) ) do
        if c:GetAttribute( "Claimed" ) == false then
            return { item = c, spooky = true }
        end
    end
    for KW, opp in pairs( dpp ) do
        if type( opp ) == "table" and # opp > 0 and not nm( uRp, tostring( KW ) ) then
            local KH = true for Fp, ta in pairs( opp ) do
                if not nm( oRp, ta ) then
                    KH = false;
                    break
                end
            end
            if KH then
                return { prize = KW, spooky = true }
            end
        end
    end
end
return nil
end
function ER.ClaimIndex( IV, qS ) if qS.item then
    local im = qS.spooky and nm( TI, "SpookyIndex" ) or nm( TI, "Index" ) local c = im and nm( im, qS.item.Name ) if not c or c:GetAttribute( "Claimed" ) ~= false then
        return true
    end
    if qS.spooky then
        local Fs = nm( IV.remotes, "ClaimIndexReward" ) if not Fs then
            return false
        end
        if not pcall( Fs.FireServer, Fs, c.Name, "Spooky" ) then
            return false
        end

        return false
    end
    local eS = kX() + 2 while ER.Same( IV, "AutoIndex" ) and kX() < eS do
        if c:GetAttribute( "Claimed" ) == true then
            return true
        end
        Hpp( .08 )
    end
    return false
end
local im = qS.spooky and nm( TI, "SpookyPrizes" ) or nm( TI, "IndexPrizes" ) if nm( im, tostring( qS.prize ) ) then
    return true

    return false

    end
    Hpp( .08 )

end

gH = true for Fp, uR in pairs( YR ) do

return ER
end
return fV

local LRp = ( function() local eRp = {} function eRp.Create( aV ) local Hp, fV, na = aV.state, aV.Native, aV.workflow local ER = {};
local VA, DRp, ZRp = 0, 0, 0 local HI = {};
local n = true local function Qm( x ) return Hp.AutoFarm or Hp[ x ]
end
local function Pa() return n and not Hp.paused and aV.isCurrent()
end
local function ng( Cp, VK, x ) if Hp.phase ~= Cp then
    Hp.phaseSince = aV.clock()
end
Hp.phase = Cp;
Hp.status = Cp;
Hp.detail = VK Hp.farmStatus = Cp;
Hp.farmDetail = VK if x then
    Hp[ x .. "Status" ] = Cp;
    Hp[ x .. "Detail" ] = VK
end
end
local function dRp( IV ) return fV.CarryStatus and fV.CarryStatus( IV ) or "none"
end
local function FRp( c ) return c and c.Name
end
function ER.IsBusy( IV ) return na.opening ~= nil or na.placement ~= nil or na.taking ~= nil or dRp( IV ) ~= "none"
end
local function pVp( IV, OV, mV ) if fV.ItemPlaced( IV, OV.kind, OV.id, OV.index ) then
    na.placement = nil;
    Hp.itemsPlaced = ( Hp.itemsPlaced or 0 ) + 1 ng( "Placed", OV.kind .. " confirmed in owned stall " .. tostring( OV.index ) .. ".", "place" );
    return true
end
local c = fV.Item( IV, OV.kind, OV.id ) if not c then
    ng( "Waiting for item data", "The exact " .. OV.kind:lower() .. " is updating. Its stall remains reserved.", "place" );
    return true
end
if mV - OV.at >= 8 then
    na.placement = nil;
    HI[ "place:" .. OV.id ] = mV + 4 ng( "Placement not confirmed", "The item is still owned. Rechecking its native tool and stall before another attempt.", "place" ) return true
end
ng( "Confirming placement", "Waiting for " .. OV.id .. " in stall " .. tostring( OV.index ) .. ".", "place" );
return true
end
local function RVp( IV, OV, mV ) local nRp = fV.OpenResult( IV, OV ) if nRp then
    na.opening = nil;
    Hp.cagesOpened = ( Hp.cagesOpened or 0 ) + 1 ng( "Pet received", "The cage result is now an owned pet.", "hatch" );
    return true
end
if mV - OV.at >= OV.wait and not fV.OpenStillActive( IV, OV ) and fV.Item( IV, "Cage", OV.id ) then
    na.opening = nil;
    HI[ "open:" .. OV.id ] = mV + 5 ng( "Opening not confirmed", "The cage is still owned and has not started opening. Rechecking its native prompt.", "hatch" );
    return true
end
ng( "Waiting for pet", "Opening the cage; stall " .. tostring( OV.index ) .. " stays reserved until its pet arrives.", "hatch" );
return true
end
function ER.Tick( IV, mV ) if not Pa() then
    return false
end
if fV.ObserveCarry then
    fV.ObserveCarry( IV )
end
local VVp = dRp( IV ) if VVp ~= "none" then
    if VVp == "received" or VVp == "lost" or VVp == "settled" then
        local iR = fV.AcknowledgeCarry( IV ) if not iR then
            ng( "Waiting for character", "The current character or plot changed during carry reconciliation.", "steal" );
            return true
        end
        if iR == "received" then
            Hp.cagesRecovered = ( Hp.cagesRecovered or 0 ) + 1;
            ng( "Cage received", "New owned cage confirmed.", "steal" )
        else
            if iR == "lost" then
                Hp.cagesLost = ( Hp.cagesLost or 0 ) + 1
            end
            ZRp = aV.clock() + 4;
            ng( "Carry resolved", "The carry has ended; continuing from the current inventory.", "steal" )
        end
        return true
    end
    if not Qm( "AutoSteal" ) then
        ng( "Carry pending", "Enable Auto Farm or Auto Steal to finish the existing carry.", "steal" );
        return false
    end
    if VVp == "confirming" then
        ng( "Confirming pickup", "Waiting for native cage ownership; the carry pose alone is not a theft receipt.", "steal" );
        return true
    end
    if VVp == "waiting" then
        ng( "Waiting for cage", "The carry has cleared. Waiting briefly for owned inventory before resolving the attempt.", "steal" ) return true
    end

        return true

        Hp.cagesRecovered = ( Hp.cagesRecovered or 0 ) + 1;
        ng( "Cage received", VK, "steal" )

        if iR == "lost" then
            Hp.cagesLost = ( Hp.cagesLost or 0 ) + 1
        end
        ZRp = aV.clock() + 4;
        ng( "Carry resolved", VK, "steal" )

        ng( "Delivering cage", VK or "Waiting for the native barn delivery.", "steal" )
    end
    return true

    return pVp( IV, na.placement, mV )
end
if na.opening then
    return RVp( IV, na.opening, mV )
end

        return true

        return true

    return true

    return false

            ng( "Waiting for pet inventory", ha, "take" )

    Hp.takeDetail = VK

    Hp.takeStatus = "Off";
    Hp.takeDetail = "This activity is off."
end

            return false

        if fV.Unplaced( IV, "Cage" ) then
            ng( "Inventory waiting", "Place the currently owned egg before stealing another cage.", "steal" );
            return false
        end
        local hRp, rW = fV.FreeStall( IV ) if not hRp then
            ng( "Barn full", rW, "steal" );
            return false
        end

        return false
    end

            return true

    return false
end
if aVp then
    ng( "Barn full", aVp, "place" )
elseif Hp.AutoTakePets then
    ng( "Ready to take pets", Hp.takeDetail or "No placed pets are ready.", "take" )
else
    ng( "Farm ready", "No enabled farm action is currently ready." )
end
return false
end
function ER.Stop() n = false
end
function ER.Diagnostics() return { phase = Hp.phase, item = na.opening and na.opening.id or na.placement and na.placement.id, slot = na.opening and na.opening.index or na.placement and na.placement.index or na.taking and na.taking.index, opening = na.opening ~= nil, placement = na.placement ~= nil, taking = na.taking ~= nil }
end
return ER
end
return eRp
end

local function w( H ) return type( H ) == "number" and H == H and math.abs( H ) < math.huge
end
local function ln( H ) if not w( H ) then
    return "-"
end
for Fp, h in ipairs( { { 1000000000000, "T" }, { 1000000000, "B" }, { 1000000, "M" }, { 1000, "K" } } ) do
    if math.abs( H ) >= h[ 1 ] then
        return string.format( "%.1f", H / h[ 1 ] ):gsub( "%.0$", "" ) .. h[ 2 ]
    end
end
return tostring( math.floor( H ) )
end

            return

            return
        end

        OV.key = "Conveyor:" .. tostring( aR ) OV.phase = AD == 0 and "Buy" or "Upgrade";
        OV.receipt = { mode = "belt", id = aR, baseline = AD }
    elseif ta == "SolarSlot" then
        local bw = OB( SV, "SolarBuilt" ) if not bw or bw:GetAttribute( "SolarBuilt" ) ~= false then
            return
        end

        OV.key = "Solar:" .. bw:GetFullName();
        OV.phase = "Buy" OV.receipt = { mode = "true", ref = bw, attr = "SolarBuilt" }

        local BK = rB and w( rB:GetAttribute( "RobotsOwned" ) ) if not BK then
            return
        end

    end

    return
end

end
function ER.Enabled( OV, Hp ) if OV.category == "Converter" then
    return Hp.AutoUpgradeConverter == true
end
if Hp.ObjectType ~= "All" and Hp.ObjectType ~= OV.category then
    return false
end

function ER.Quotes( IV, Hp, mV ) if mV - PVp >= 2 then
    PVp = mV;
    gVp = {} for Fp, SV in ipairs( ZI:GetDescendants() ) do
        if SV:IsA( "ProximityPrompt" ) and QVp[ SV:GetAttribute( "PromptKind" ) ] then
            gVp[ # gVp + 1 ] = SV
        end
        if # gVp >= 600 then
            break
        end
    end
end

    local u, OV = pcall( ER.Quote, SV, IV ) if u and OV and ER.Enabled( OV, Hp ) then
        local zQ = cVp[ OV.key ] if not zQ or( OV.position - IV.position ).Magnitude < ( zQ.position - IV.position ).Magnitude then
            cVp[ OV.key ] = OV
        end
    end
end

for Fp, OV in pairs( cVp ) do
    iR[ # iR + 1 ] = OV
end
return iR
end
function ER.Refresh( OV, IV ) local fJ = ER.Quote( OV.prompt, IV ) if fJ and fJ.key == OV.key and fJ.ref == OV.ref and fJ.phase == OV.phase and fJ.cost == OV.cost and fJ.receipt.baseline == OV.receipt.baseline then
    return fJ
end
end
function ER.Receipt( OV ) local lp = OV.receipt if not lp then
    return false
end

    local AD = JVp( lp.id );
    return AD ~= nil and AD > lp.baseline
end
if not lp.ref or not lp.ref.Parent and lp.ref ~= ZI then
    return false
end
local H = lp.ref:GetAttribute( lp.attr ) if lp.mode == "true" then
    return H == true
end
return w( H ) ~= nil and H > lp.baseline
end
function ER.Buy( OV, IV, AR ) local fJ = ER.Refresh( OV, IV ) if not fJ then
    return false
end
local op, r5 = fR( OV.prompt ) if not op or op.canPress ~= true or op.tone ~= "buy" or op.cost ~= OV.cost or op.gems ~= nil or not r5 or type( r5.buy ) ~= "function" then
    return false
end
return r5.buy( function( u, ha ) AR( u == true, false, ha )
end
)
end
return ER
end
return QV
end

local function w( H ) return type( H ) == "number" and H == H and math.abs( H ) < math.huge
end
local function ln( H ) if not w( H ) then
    return "-"
end
for Fp, h in ipairs( { { 1000000000000, "T" }, { 1000000000, "B" }, { 1000000, "M" }, { 1000, "K" } } ) do
    if math.abs( H ) >= h[ 1 ] then
        return string.format( "%.1f", H / h[ 1 ] ):gsub( "%.0$", "" ) .. h[ 2 ]
    end
end
return tostring( math.floor( H ) )
end

    uWp.GetSchoolHubAntiAFKStatus = nil
end
if uWp._SchoolHubSessionOwner == LWp then
    uWp._SchoolHubSessionOwner = nil
end
end
local
function ks()
return n and uWp.StopSchoolHubAntiAFK == Kap and uWp._SchoolHubSessionOwner == LWp and uWp[ mU.stop ] == Xap and bT.Parent ~= nil
end
uWp.StopSchoolHubAntiAFK = Kap bap = function()
if Nb then
    return Nb.GetStatus()
end
return { running = false, reason = n and "Starting" or "Stopped" }
end
uWp.GetSchoolHubAntiAFKStatus = bap
local Xu, uR = pcall( function() return bT.Destroying:Connect( Kap )
end
)
if not Xu or not uR then
    Kap();
    return
end
VG = uR
if not ks() then
    Kap();
    return
end
local bu, H = pcall( wWp.Create, { player = DWp, isActive = ks, clock = os.clock, getUserInputService = function() return game:GetService( "UserInputService" )
end
, getVirtualInputManager = function() return game:GetService( "VirtualInputManager" )
end
, getHeartbeat = function() return game:GetService( "RunService" ).Heartbeat
end
, keyCode = Enum.KeyCode.F15, inputTarget = game, keyclick = uWp.keyclick or keyclick, isrbxactive = uWp.isrbxactive or isrbxactive, isKeyBound = function( x ) local hR = game:GetService( "ContextActionService" ):GetAllBoundActionInfo() if type( hR ) ~= "table" then
    return nil
end
local BK = 0 for Fp, N in pairs( hR ) do
    BK = BK + 1;
    if BK > 512 then
        return nil
    end
    if type( N ) == "table" then
        for Fp, DW in pairs( N.inputTypes or {} ) do
            if DW == x then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
end
return false
end
, onUnavailable = function( rW ) warn( "School Hub Anti-AFK: " .. tostring( rW ) .. ". Idle protection is not confirmed." )
end
} )
if not bu or type( H ) ~= "table" then
    Kap();
    return
end
Nb = H
if not ks() or not Nb.IsRunning() then
    pcall( Nb.Stop );
    Kap()
end
end
local
function qap()
local mU = Bap[ t ]
if not mU or uWp._SchoolHubSessionOwner ~= LWp then
    return
end
mU.launch()
if uWp._SchoolHubSessionOwner ~= LWp then
    return
end
map( mU )
end
Ua.Start( { env = uWp, player = DWp, HttpService = eWp, UI = PW, Auth = iV, digest = LR, brand = xp, theme = Iap, service = jV.service, secret = jV.secret, request = Rap, requestName = Vap, clock = os.time, task = task, getIdentifier = uWp.gethwid or gethwid, nonce = function() return( eWp:GenerateGUID( false ):gsub( "-", "" ) )
end
, reader = Wap, writer = aap, clipboard = uWp.setclipboard or setclipboard or uWp.toclipboard or toclipboard, launch = qap, onLaunchError = function() warn( "School Hub could not start. Reexecute the complete file." )
end
} )
